examples.en: The museum displays ninety precious artifacts from the ancient dynasty.
examples.zh: 该博物馆展出了九十件来自该古老王朝的珍贵文物。

lemmas.usage_note: 数词作定语修饰复数名词，表示数量为九十，用于日常口语及正式书面语境中。

lemmas.def_en: the cardinal number that is the product of ten and nine

examples.en: Ninety of the participants agreed to sign the updated consent form.
examples.zh: 九十名参与者同意签署更新后的知情同意书。

lemmas.usage_note: 指数字九十或九十年代（多用 the nineties），复数或带有介词短语修饰时作代词性名词使用。

family_guide.root_logic: 古英语词源，由 nine（九）+ -ty（十的倍数）构成，表示九十。

lemmas.def_en: very bad

examples.en: The humid weather caused the wooden fence to become completely rotten.
examples.zh: 潮湿的天气导致木篱笆彻底腐烂了。

lemmas.usage_note: 可修饰具体事物表‘腐烂的’，亦用于非正式口语表达极差的心情或运气，常作定语或表语。

lemmas.def_en: in a state of progressive putrefaction
lemmas.def_zh: [医]腐败, 腐烂, 败坏; 易碎性

examples.en: The foul smell in the abandoned basement revealed the extreme rottenness of the old timber.
examples.zh: 废弃地下室里的恶臭暴露了那些旧木材的极度腐朽。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古诺斯语 rotinn，由 rot（腐烂）演变而来，核心义为腐败变质的，引申指糟糕的、道德败坏的。

lemmas.def_en: expel or eject without recourse to legal process

examples.en: The landlord decided to evict the tenant for failing to pay the rent for months.
examples.zh: 房东因租客数月拖欠房租而决定依法将其驱逐出去。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，具有法律或正式公文语体色彩，常见结构为 evict sb from a house/flat。

lemmas.def_en: action by a landlord that compels a tenant to leave the premises (as by rendering the premises unfit for occupancy); no physical expulsion or legal process is involved

examples.en: The struggling family faced sudden eviction after failing to pay the monthly apartment rent.
examples.zh: 由于未能按月支付公寓租金，这个陷入困境的家庭面临着突然被驱逐的境地。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 evincere（通过法律手段彻底驱逐或胜诉），现代主要指通过法律程序将房客等赶走。

lemmas.def_en: oust politically

examples.en: The committee sought to purge the department of all corrupt officials.
examples.zh: 委员会试图清除该部门内所有的腐败官员。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于政治清洗或身心净化的庄重语境，常见搭配为 purge sb/sth of/from sth。

lemmas.def_en: a purging medicine; stimulates evacuation of the bowels

examples.en: The physician prescribed a gentle herbal purgative to relieve the patient's severe chronic constipation.
examples.zh: 医生开了一种温和的草本泻剂，以缓解该患者严重的慢性便秘。

lemmas.def_en: purging the body by the use of a cathartic to stimulate evacuation of the bowels
lemmas.def_zh: 清洁, 净化, 洗罪, 通便

examples.en: Ancient rituals often involved fasting as a symbolic purgation of past moral transgressions.
examples.zh: 古代仪式常通过禁食来象征性地清洗过去的道德罪过。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 purgare（净化、清除），引申为清除异己或排空体内杂质。

lemmas.def_en: freshwater or marine or terrestrial gastropod mollusk usually having an external enclosing spiral shell
lemmas.def_zh: 蜗牛, 行动迟缓的人, 脑筋迟钝的人, 蜗形凸轮

examples.en: Due to heavy construction, morning traffic was moving at a snail's pace.
examples.zh: 由于大规模施工，早高峰的交通正以蜗牛般的速度缓慢蠕动。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指软体动物；常用于固定搭配 at a snail's pace 形容行动极度缓慢。

lemmas.def_en: gather snails
lemmas.def_zh: (蜗牛般)缓慢地打发(时间)；缓慢移动

examples.en: The old freight train snailed along the rusty tracks toward the distant station.
examples.zh: 老旧的货运列车沿着生锈的铁轨向远方的车站缓慢行驶。

lemmas.usage_note: 不及物动词，书面或文学色彩较浓，常与 along、forward 等副词连用表示‘缓慢前行’。

family_guide.root_logic: 古英语原始词汇，本义为爬行缓慢的有壳软体动物，作动词时借指缓慢行进。

lemmas.def_en: in mental comfort; without stress

examples.en: They can easily afford to live comfortably in retirement.
examples.zh: 他们完全负担得起退休后过上舒适的生活。

lemmas.usage_note: 修饰状态或动作，常见搭配 live comfortably（生活宽裕）、comfortably off（小康）及 sit comfortably。

lemmas.def_en: in physical discomfort
lemmas.def_zh: 不舒适地, 不自在地, 令人不快地

examples.en: The tiny attic bedroom was uncomfortably hot during the long summer afternoons.
examples.zh: 在漫长的夏日午后，那间狭小的阁楼卧室热得令人难受。

family_guide.root_logic: 来自 comfort（安慰、舒适）+ -able（能……的）+ -ly（副词后缀），表示舒适、安逸地。

lemmas.def_en: a silky densely piled fabric with a plain back

examples.en: She wore an elegant evening gown tailored from black velvet.
examples.zh: 她身穿一件用黑色天鹅绒裁剪而成的优雅晚礼服。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，表示丝绒织物；也用于比喻柔和的事物，如 an iron hand in a velvet glove。

lemmas.def_en: smooth and soft to sight or hearing or touch or taste
lemmas.def_zh: 像天鹅绒的, 轻软光滑的, 柔和的, 平和的

examples.en: The chef prepared a rich soup with an exceptionally smooth, velvety texture.
examples.zh: 大厨制作了一道口感极其柔滑、宛如天鹅绒般的浓汤。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 villus（粗毛、绒毛），后专指表面有致密细绒的丝织品。

lemmas.def_en: bring about abruptly
lemmas.def_zh: 猛抛, 使陷入, 促成, 使沉淀；猛地落下

examples.en: A sudden market crash may precipitate a severe international financial crisis.
examples.zh: 市场的突然暴跌可能会促成一场严重的国际金融危机。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，多用于书面语，表示促成不良事态；化学语境中表示‘使沉淀’，常接名词作宾语。

lemmas.def_en: the quantity of water falling to earth at a specific place within a specified period of time
lemmas.def_zh: 坠落, 沉淀, 降水, 轻率, 急速, 猛冲, 突如其来

examples.en: The arid desert region receives very little annual precipitation.
examples.zh: 这片干旱的沙漠地区年降水量极低。

lemmas.usage_note: 专业及气象学常用词，多作不可数名词表示‘降水量/沉淀’，常见搭配 annual precipitation。

lemmas.def_en: removes dust particles from gases by electrostatic precipitation
lemmas.def_zh: 引发者, 沉淀器, 沉淀器操作者

examples.en: The steel plant installed an electrostatic precipitator to capture fine industrial dust.
examples.zh: 该钢厂安装了静电除尘器以捕集微细的工业粉尘。

lemmas.def_en: at breakneck speed

examples.en: The general retreated precipitately after realizing his troops were completely outflanked.
examples.zh: 将军意识到部队已被完全包抄后，匆忙仓皇撤退。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 pre-（向前）+ cipit（头）+ -ate，字面为“头朝前跌落”，引申为使骤然降临、沉淀或凝结降水。
family_guide.core_distinction: precipitate作动词侧重促成或沉淀；precipitation主要作名词表示降水或降水量。

lemmas.def_en: the father of your father or mother

examples.en: My grandpa still tends to his vegetable garden every morning.
examples.zh: 我爷爷每天早上仍然照料他的菜园。

lemmas.usage_note: 口语常用非正式称呼，口吻亲切，在正式写作或官方文件中建议替换为 grandfather。

family_guide.root_logic: grand-（上一代的，辈分尊的）+ pa（爸爸的口语形式），口语中指祖父或外祖父。

lemmas.def_en: put an end to a state or an activity

examples.en: The manufacturer decided to discontinue the outdated software after next month.
examples.zh: 制造商决定自下个月起停用并终止支持这款过时的软件。

lemmas.usage_note: 商务和法律等正式语境的高频词，及物动词，后接名词或 doing sth，常用于产品停产。

lemmas.def_en: the act of discontinuing or breaking off; an interruption (temporary or permanent)
lemmas.def_zh: 停止, 中止, 废止

examples.en: Patients were warned about side effects following the sudden discontinuation of the drug.
examples.zh: 患者被警告称突然停药可能会引发不良反应。

lemmas.def_en: the act of discontinuing or breaking off; an interruption (temporary or permanent)
lemmas.def_zh: 停止, 中止, 废止

examples.en: The legal notice announced the formal discontinuance of the company's delivery services.
examples.zh: 法律通告宣布正式终止该公司的配送服务。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 dis-（停止、相反）+ continue（继续），字面即“中止、不再继续”。

lemmas.def_en: having the sticky properties of an adhesive

examples.en: The negotiations reached a sticky point when neither side would compromise on pricing.
examples.zh: 当双方都不愿在定价上妥协时，谈判陷入了棘手的僵局。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰物体表面、天气或两难局面；常见搭配如 sticky tape（胶带）、sticky situation（棘手处境）。

lemmas.def_en: the property of sticking to a surface

examples.en: High humidity increased the stickiness of the freshly applied varnish on wood.
examples.zh: 高湿度加重了木头上新刷清漆的黏滞感。

family_guide.root_logic: 词根 stick（黏附）+ -y（形容词后缀，具……特性的），本义为有粘性的，引申指棘手的或闷热的。

lemmas.def_en: come into existence; take on form or shape
lemmas.def_zh: 上升, 起义, 出现

examples.en: The oppressed villagers decided to uprise against the tyrannical landlord.
examples.zh: 被压迫的村民们决定奋起反抗残暴的地主。

lemmas.usage_note: 文雅或文学用词，指大众起义反抗压迫，或物体、地势向上升起；常与 against 连用。

lemmas.def_en: organized opposition to authority; a conflict in which one faction tries to wrest control from another

examples.en: The government deployed troops to crush the armed uprising in the capital.
examples.zh: 政府调动军队以平息首都的武装起义。

lemmas.usage_note: 表示局部的、针对统治者的暴力起义或暴动；常与 stage、crush、suppress 等动词搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 up-（向上）+ rise（升起），字面为“站起来、升起”，引申为群众起义或反抗。
family_guide.core_distinction: uprise多作动词表示升起或反抗；uprising为常用名词，专指暴动、起义。

lemmas.def_en: to compress with violence, out of natural shape or condition

examples.en: Boil the potatoes until tender, then mash them with a splash of milk and butter.
examples.zh: 把土豆煮至软烂，然后加入少许牛奶和黄油将其捣成泥。

lemmas.usage_note: 烹饪语境下指将食物捣成泥状，常接 potatoes 等，亦可指重压捣烂；常与 up 连用。

lemmas.def_en: a man who is aggressive in making amorous advances to women
lemmas.def_zh: 捣碎者, 捣碎器, 调情求爱者

examples.en: She used a sturdy stainless steel masher to prepare creamy potatoes tonight.
examples.zh: 她今晚用结实的不锈钢捣碎器制作了绵密的土豆泥。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语，核心含义为“捣碎、混合”。

lemmas.def_en: come into view indistinctly, often threateningly
lemmas.def_zh: （威胁等）隐隐显现；逼近；赫然耸立

examples.en: The deadline was looming, but the report was far from finished.
examples.zh: 截止日期正步步逼近，但报告还远远没有完成。

lemmas.usage_note: 常接 ahead/large/over，指隐患、危机在眼前迫近或阴魂不散，自带沉重的压迫感。

family_guide.root_logic: 词源不明，可能与织布机的隐约晃动或低伏动作有关，现多指隐隐显现或逼近。

lemmas.def_en: a garment worn around the head or neck or shoulders for warmth or decoration
lemmas.def_zh: n. 围巾，披巾；v. 狼吞虎咽

examples.en: She wrapped a warm woollen scarf around her neck before heading out into the blizzard.
examples.zh: 出门走进暴风雪前，她把一条温暖的羊毛围巾裹在脖子上。

lemmas.usage_note: 指围巾、领巾或披巾；常用搭配包括 silk scarf（丝巾）、woollen scarf（羊毛围巾）及 wear a scarf。

lemmas.def_en: masturbate while strangling oneself
lemmas.def_zh: n. 围巾，披巾；v. 狼吞虎咽

examples.en: He had only ten minutes between meetings, so he had to scarf down his burger quickly.
examples.zh: 他两场会议之间只有十分钟，因此不得不快速吞下汉堡。

lemmas.usage_note: 非正式口语表达，意为狼吞虎咽，多与 down 连用（如 scarf down lunch/food）。

family_guide.root_logic: 名词源自古法语，指围巾；动词在俚语中意为“狼吞虎咽”，词源可能模仿进食声或大口吞咽动作。

lemmas.def_en: fail to follow suit when able and required to do so

examples.en: The authorities decided to revoke his driver's license following multiple traffic violations.
examples.zh: 在多次违章驾驶后，主管当局决定吊销他的驾照。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式官方或法律用语，指废除法令、吊销执照或撤销特权；常接 license、permit、charter 等宾语。

lemmas.def_en: the state of being cancelled or annulled
lemmas.def_zh: 废止, 取消, 撤回

examples.en: Repeated traffic violations led directly to the official revocation of his driver's license.
examples.zh: 屡次违章直接导致他的驾驶执照被正式吊销。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 re-（回）+ vocare（呼唤），字面意为“召回”，引申为撤销法令或权利。

lemmas.def_en: nonelective government officials
lemmas.def_zh: 官僚机构；官僚主义；繁文缛节

examples.en: Excessive bureaucracy often slows down the approval process for new infrastructure projects.
examples.zh: 过度的繁文缛节往往会延缓新基础设施项目的审批进度。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可作集合名词指官僚体系，也常作不可数名词代指繁文缛节（贬义）；常用搭配如 reduce bureaucracy。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or resembling a bureaucrat or bureaucracy

examples.en: Startups often struggle with endless bureaucratic hurdles before securing government grants.
examples.zh: 初创企业在获得政府拨款前往往要应对没完没了的官僚障碍。

lemmas.def_en: in a bureaucratic manner

examples.en: The visa application was processed bureaucratically without any regard for personal urgency.
examples.zh: 签证申请完全按官僚流程机械办理，丝毫未考虑个人的紧急情况。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自 bureau（办公桌/办事处）+ -cracy（统治），字面为“官员统治”，指官僚体制。

lemmas.def_en: being one more than seventeen

examples.en: She moved out of her parents' house when she turned eighteen.
examples.zh: 她满十八岁时就搬出了父母家。

lemmas.usage_note: 基数词作定语修饰可数名词复数，作表语指年龄时其后不需加 years old，直接表岁数。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 eight（八）+ -teen（十）复合而成，表示十八。

lemmas.def_en: made or produced in the home or by yourself

examples.en: Nothing beats the taste of warm, homemade bread.
examples.zh: 没有什么比刚出炉的温热自制面包更好吃了。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰食物、手工艺品等，表示“自制的/家常的”；注意作定语时通常带连字符，用于名词前。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 home（家）+ made（制作）组成的复合词，字面即“在家制作的”。

lemmas.def_en: pertaining to respiration

examples.en: Air pollution has caused a significant rise in chronic respiratory diseases among urban residents.
examples.zh: 空气污染导致城市居民中慢性呼吸道疾病的发病率显著上升。

lemmas.usage_note: 医学与生物学正式用语，修饰器官或病症；常见搭配为 respiratory system（呼吸系统）、respiratory tract。

lemmas.def_en: breathe easily again, as after exertion or anxiety

examples.en: The patient began to respire normally once the doctor cleared his airway.
examples.zh: 医生清理了气道后，病人开始正常呼吸。

lemmas.def_zh: 呼吸, 一口气, 呼吸作用
lemmas.def_en: the metabolic processes whereby certain organisms obtain energy from organic molecules; processes that take place in the cells and tissues during which energy is released and carbon dioxide is produced and absorbed by the blood to be transported to the lungs

lemmas.def_zh: 口罩, 防毒面具, 人工呼吸装置
lemmas.def_en: a breathing device for administering long-term artificial respiration

examples.en: The rescue worker wore a protective respirator while entering the smoke-filled building.
examples.zh: 救援人员戴着防护防毒面具进入了浓烟弥漫的大楼。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 re-（再）+ spirare（呼吸）+ -tory（形容词后缀），表示呼吸相关的。

lemmas.def_en: hormone secreted by the isles of Langerhans in the pancreas; regulates storage of glycogen in the liver and accelerates oxidation of sugar in cells

examples.en: Diabetics may need regular injections of insulin to control their blood sugar.
examples.zh: 糖尿病患者可能需要定期注射胰岛素来控制血糖。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，常与动词搭配如 inject/produce insulin，常见概念有 insulin resistance（胰岛素抵抗）。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 insula（岛），因该激素由胰岛细胞分泌而得名。

lemmas.def_en: an oxide containing two atoms of oxygen in the molecule

examples.en: Trees absorb carbon dioxide and release oxygen into the atmosphere.
examples.zh: 树木吸收二氧化碳并将氧气释放到大气中。

lemmas.usage_note: 化学专有名词，最常用于 carbon dioxide（二氧化碳）或 sulfur dioxide，一般作为不可数名词使用。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 di-（二）+ oxide（氧化物）构成，指含两个氧原子的氧化物。

lemmas.def_en: young of any of various canines such as a dog or wolf
lemmas.def_zh: n. 幼犬，小狗；v. 产崽

examples.en: The golden retriever looked after each playful pup with immense patience.
examples.zh: 这只金毛寻回犬极有耐心地照顾着每一只顽皮的幼崽。

lemmas.usage_note: 指狗、海豹、水獭等哺乳动物的幼崽；口语中偶指自负无礼的年轻小伙（cheeky pup）。

lemmas.def_en: birth
lemmas.def_zh: n. 幼犬，小狗；v. 产崽

examples.en: Female seals usually return to the secluded sandy beach to pup in early winter.
examples.zh: 母海豹通常会在初冬时节返回僻静的沙滩产崽。

lemmas.usage_note: 专业动物学术语，指（犬、海豹等母兽）产仔、产崽，常作不及物动词使用。

family_guide.root_logic: puppy 的截短形式，指幼小的犬科动物；动词意为产崽。

lemmas.def_en: come up with (an idea, plan, explanation, theory, or principle) after a mental effort

examples.en: The research team worked overnight to devise an effective algorithm to solve the data bottleneck.
examples.zh: 研究团队彻夜工作，设计出一种有效的算法来解决数据瓶颈问题。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指经过深思熟虑设计出方案、策略、系统或精巧发明；常接 plan、strategy、scheme 等。

lemmas.def_en: a person who makes plans
lemmas.def_zh: 设计者, 计划者, 发明者

examples.en: He was the chief deviser of the revolutionary software security protocol.
examples.zh: 他是该革命性软件安全协议的主要设计者。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 deviser（分配、筹划），核心在于发挥智巧“构思设计”。
family_guide.core_distinction: devise 为动词（设计发明），device 为名词（设备、装置）。

lemmas.def_en: subject to question
lemmas.def_zh: 可疑的；有问题的；不可靠的

examples.en: His financial dealings have recently come under questionable scrutiny.
examples.zh: 他最近的财务往来引起了人们的怀疑。

lemmas.usage_note: 含怀疑或负面评价色彩，常修饰 taste/motives/practices；意为“成问题的/靠不住的”，不同于可提问的。

lemmas.def_en: incapable of being questioned
lemmas.def_zh: 无疑问的, 确实的, 无可挑剔的

examples.en: Her deep dedication to environmental conservation is unquestionable among her peers.
examples.zh: 她在环保事业上的高度奉献精神在同行中是毋庸置疑的。

family_guide.root_logic: 来自 question（疑问、质询），后缀 -able 表示“值得怀疑的、有问题的”。

lemmas.def_en: having no cogency or legal force

examples.en: Your ticket is invalid because it was booked for travel on a different date.
examples.zh: 你的车票是无效的，因为预订的出行日期与今天不符。

lemmas.usage_note: 发音为 /ɪnˈvælɪd/，指法律、逻辑或数据上无效的；常见搭配如 invalid argument、invalid passport。

lemmas.def_en: illogicality as a consequence of having a conclusion that does not follow from the premisses
lemmas.def_zh: 无效, 无价值, 病弱

examples.en: The judge declared the contract null due to the invalidity of forged signatures.
examples.zh: 法官因伪造签名的无效性而判定该合同作废。

lemmas.def_en: force to retire, remove from active duty, as of firemen

examples.en: After suffering a severe spine injury in combat, the soldier was invalided out of the army.
examples.zh: 在战斗中脊椎遭受重创后，这名士兵因伤残退役。

lemmas.usage_note: 发音为 /ˈɪnvəlɪd/，军事或正式用语，常以被动语态 invalid out of 呈现，指因病残退役。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 in-（不）+ validus（强壮的、有效的）。注意发音：/ɪnˈvælɪd/ 作形容词表示无效；/ˈɪnvəlɪd/ 作名词/动词表示病弱者、因伤病致残退役。

lemmas.def_en: state of uncertainty or perplexity especially as requiring a choice between equally unfavorable options

examples.en: She faced the dilemma of choosing between her career and her family.
examples.zh: 她面临着在事业与家庭之间抉择的进退两难。

lemmas.usage_note: 指进退两难的尴尬境地，常搭配 face a dilemma 或 be in a dilemma (about/over doing sth)。

family_guide.root_logic: 来自希腊语 di-（两）+ lemma（假设、命题），原指逻辑学中的双刀论法，引申为面临两难选择的境地。

lemmas.def_en: a signed written agreement between two or more parties (nations) to perform some action

examples.en: The two nations signed a formal covenant promising not to develop biological weapons.
examples.zh: 两国签署了一项正式盟约，承诺不发展生物武器。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指具有法律或宗教约束力的庄严契约，搭配 enter into / breach a covenant，多见于法律与宗教语境。

lemmas.def_en: enter into a covenant
lemmas.def_zh: v. 订立盟约，立约承诺

examples.en: The tenant covenanted to keep the property in good repair throughout the lease.
examples.zh: 承租人立约承诺在整个租期内保持房产处于良好修缮状态。

lemmas.usage_note: 作动词表示正式立约承诺，常接 that 从句或 to do 不定式，用于高度正式的法律文书中。

family_guide.root_logic: 来自拉丁语 com-（共同）+ venire（来），原意为“走到一起”，在法律和宗教中指具约束力的庄严契约。

lemmas.def_en: remain present although waning or gradually dying
lemmas.def_zh: 逗留，流连；磨蹭；（记忆、气息等）萦绕不绝

examples.en: The delicate scent of lavender lingered in the room long after she left.
examples.zh: 她离开许久之后，房间里依然萦绕着薰衣草的幽香。

lemmas.usage_note: 表示依依不舍地逗留或气息、病痛迟迟不散，常与 on、over、around 连用，具文学色彩与画面感。

lemmas.def_en: in a slow, leisurely or prolonged way;  -Rossetti
lemmas.def_zh: 延迟地, 逗留不去地

examples.en: She looked lingeringly at her childhood home before driving away for good.
examples.zh: 在彻底开车离开之前，她依依不舍地凝望着童年的家。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 lengen（延长、拖延），指逗留不去，或某种感觉、气味持续留存。

lemmas.def_en: more than is needed, desired, or required
lemmas.def_zh: 多余的，累赘的；被裁减的，解雇的

examples.en: Due to company restructuring, hundreds of factory workers were made redundant.
examples.zh: 由于公司重组，数百名工厂工人被裁撤。

lemmas.usage_note: 英式英语中高频搭配 make sb redundant 表示裁员；亦可指语言、信息等多余累赘的，书面口语皆常用。

lemmas.def_en: repetition of messages to reduce the probability of errors in transmission
lemmas.def_zh: 过多, 冗长, 累赘, 多余, 冗余位, 冗余度, 冗余码, 多余信息

examples.en: The editor cut several sentences to avoid unnecessary redundancy in the article.
examples.zh: 编辑删掉了几句话，以避免文章中不必要的冗余。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 re-（反复）+ unda（波浪），原义为“浪潮漫溢”，引申指多余的、冗余的或被解雇裁员的。

lemmas.def_en: any of numerous trees of the family Cupressaceae that resemble cedars

examples.en: The closet was lined with aromatic cedar to protect wool garments from moths.
examples.zh: 壁橱内衬有散发香气的雪松木，以保护毛料衣物免受虫蛀。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指雪松或雪松木，作不可数名词时指木材，如 cedar chest（雪松木箱）；作可数名词指树木。

family_guide.root_logic: 来自希腊语 kedros，指雪松属针叶树或其芳香木材。

lemmas.def_en: to break and turn over earth especially with a plow

examples.en: The rescue team had to plow through deep snow drifts to reach the stranded hikers.
examples.zh: 救援队必须穿过厚厚的积雪，才能接近被困的徒步旅行者。

lemmas.usage_note: 本义为耕地，引申为艰难穿过或开辟道路，常见短语 plow through（费力阅读/前进）或 plow into（撞上）。

lemmas.def_en: move in a way resembling that of a plow cutting into or going through the soil
lemmas.def_zh: 用犁耕田, 开路；耕, 犁, 开路

examples.en: Farmers will plough the fields in early spring to prepare for planting.
examples.zh: 农民们将在早春耕地，为播种做准备。

lemmas.def_en: a farm tool having one or more heavy blades to break the soil and cut a furrow prior to sowing

examples.en: The farmer hitched the heavy steel plow to his tractor before working the field.
examples.zh: 农夫在耕作田地前，将沉重的钢犁挂在了拖拉机上。

lemmas.usage_note: 指耕地的农具“犁”或“除雪机”（snowplow 的简写），通常用于农业或冬季交通维护相关的语境。

lemmas.def_en: (of farmland) not plowed

examples.en: The unplowed road was completely covered in thick, dangerous layers of snow.
examples.zh: 那条未经清扫的道路完全被厚厚而危险的积雪覆盖。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 plōh，核心指翻整土地的农具（犁）或相应的耕作翻土动作，引申为艰难前行。

lemmas.def_en: a race (as in swimming) in which each contestant has a free choice of the style to use
lemmas.def_zh: 自由式（游泳、滑雪等）；即兴说唱

examples.en: He won a gold medal in the 100-meter freestyle at the Olympic Games.
examples.zh: 他在奥运会男子100米自由泳比赛中斩获金牌。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于体育赛事，特指“自由泳”或滑雪中的“自由式”，高频搭配 100-meter freestyle（百米自由泳）。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 free（自由的）+ style（样式）组成的复合词，指规则宽松、动作不拘一格的自由式运动（如游泳、滑雪、说唱）。

lemmas.def_en: one who has lived in a village most of their life

examples.en: Local villagers gathered at the town hall to discuss the proposed dam.
examples.zh: 当地村民聚集在镇议事厅，讨论拟建水坝的事宜。

lemmas.usage_note: 指村民、乡民，常以复数形式 villagers 出现，描述集体行为，语体中性客气，避免与贬义的 peasant 混淆。

family_guide.root_logic: 来自 village（村庄），后缀 -er 表示“人”，即在村庄定居生活的人。

lemmas.def_en: an organism of the kingdom Fungi lacking chlorophyll and feeding on organic matter; ranging from unicellular or multicellular organisms to spore-bearing syncytia

examples.en: A damp environment provides the ideal conditions for the toxic fungus to spread.
examples.zh: 潮湿的环境为这种有毒真菌的蔓延提供了理想条件。

lemmas.usage_note: 单数名词，指真菌或霉菌类生物，常用于生物学分类或描述发霉、病害，搭配 grow / eradicate fungus。

lemmas.def_en: the taxonomic kingdom including yeast, molds, smuts, mushrooms, and toadstools; distinct from the green plants

examples.en: Many fungi play a crucial role in breaking down organic matter in forest ecosystems.
examples.zh: 许多真菌在森林生态系统中分解有机物方面起着关键作用。

lemmas.usage_note: 为 fungus 的复数形式，泛指整类真菌有机体，常作为生物学界（Kingdom Fungi）或科研统称使用。

lemmas.def_zh: 真菌, 突然发生而迅速生长的东西, 真菌类植物, 海绵肿, 真菌类病害
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to fungi

examples.en: He was prescribed an ointment to treat a persistent fungal infection on his foot.
examples.zh: 医生给他开了一种药膏，用于治疗脚部顽固的真菌感染。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，表示“真菌引起的”或“真菌的”，医学与园艺中极常用，常见搭配 fungal infection / disease。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语，指真菌、霉菌或蕈类生物。
family_guide.core_distinction: fungus 为单数形式，fungi 为其规则的拉丁语复数形式。

lemmas.def_en: (pathology) a small abnormal patch on or inside the body
lemmas.def_zh: 匾牌，铭牌；牙斑，血栓斑块

examples.en: Regular brushing helps prevent the buildup of dental plaque.
examples.zh: 定期刷牙有助于防止牙菌斑的堆积。

lemmas.usage_note: 多义词；医学上常指牙菌斑（dental plaque）或血管斑块；日常中指纪念匾牌（unveil a plaque）。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自法语，原指金属或瓷质的薄板、扁平块，引申为铭牌及牙齿或血管内壁的附着斑块。

lemmas.def_en: an edible jelly (sweet or pungent) made with gelatin and used as a dessert or salad base or a coating for foods

examples.en: She spread some sweet strawberry jelly generously over her morning toast.
examples.zh: 她把香甜的草莓果酱厚厚地抹在早晨的吐司上。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数或可数名词，指果冻、肉皮冻或胶状物，比喻用法如 legs turned to jelly（双腿发软）。

lemmas.def_en: make into jelly

examples.en: The cooling broth will jelly if you leave it in the refrigerator overnight.
examples.zh: 如果你把肉汤放在冰箱里过夜，它就会凝固成冻。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物或不及物动词，指液体凝结成胶冻状，或烹制肉冻，书面及烹饪语境中相对少见。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语，原意为“冻结的”，指凝胶状食品或半固体物质。

lemmas.def_en: a light movable barrier that competitors must leap over in certain races

examples.en: Funding was the greatest hurdle they had to overcome before launching the project.
examples.zh: 资金问题是他们在启动项目前必须克服的最大障碍。

lemmas.usage_note: 既指跨栏赛跑中的栏架，更广泛比喻工作、生活中的困难障碍，高频搭配 clear / overcome a hurdle。

lemmas.def_en: an athlete who runs the hurdles
lemmas.def_zh: 跳栏比赛选手, 制造竹篱笆者

examples.en: The young hurdler cleared every barrier with remarkable speed and precision.
examples.zh: 这位年轻的跨栏选手以惊人的速度和精准度跃过了每一个栏架。

lemmas.def_en: jump a hurdle

examples.en: The athlete hurdled the final barrier gracefully and sprinted toward the finish line.
examples.zh: 运动员优美地跨过最后一个栏架，向终点线奋力冲刺。

lemmas.usage_note: 作动词表示越过栏架或障碍物，引申为克服难题，常用作及物动词，具有较强的动态感与克服意味。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语，原指用编织树枝做成的可移动栅栏，引申为跨栏赛跑中的栏架及抽象的障碍。

lemmas.def_en: a precautionary measure warding off impending danger or damage or injury etc.

examples.en: Firefighters took every possible precaution to prevent the blaze from spreading to nearby homes.
examples.zh: 消防员采取了一切可能的防范措施，以防止大火蔓延至附近的房屋。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用复数形式 precautions，核心搭配 take precautions against（采取防范措施）或 as a precaution（以防万一）。

lemmas.def_zh: 预先警戒的, 预防的, 留心的
lemmas.def_en: taken in advance to protect against possible danger or failure

examples.en: The pilot made a precautionary landing due to unexpected bad weather conditions.
examples.zh: 由于突如其来的恶劣天气，飞行员进行了预防性着陆。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 pre-（提前）+ caution（警惕、小心），核心意为“防患于未然的措施”。

lemmas.def_en: not in action or at work

examples.en: During the off-season, several factory assembly lines remained completely idle.
examples.zh: 在淡季期间，几条工厂装配线完全处于闲置状态。

lemmas.usage_note: 修饰人指懒散无所事事，修饰机器指闲置未用，修饰言论指无根据的，如 idle gossip / threat。

lemmas.def_en: run disconnected or idle

examples.en: Drivers are advised not to leave their car engines idling while waiting in traffic.
examples.zh: 建议司机在堵车等待时不要让汽车发动机保持空转。

lemmas.usage_note: 不及物动词，指机器（如汽车引擎）空转，或人虚度光阴，常用搭配 idle away (the time)。

lemmas.def_en: having no employment
lemmas.def_zh: 懒惰, 闲散, 失业

examples.en: Months of idleness during the pandemic made him restless and bored.
examples.zh: 疫情期间数月的闲散让他坐立难安、倍感无聊。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语，原意为“空的、无用的”，引申为闲置的、不工作的。

lemmas.def_en: the range of colour characteristic of a particular artist or painting or school of art
lemmas.def_zh: 调色板；（某作品或设计中的）色彩组合，色调

examples.en: The designer chose a neutral palette of beige and gray for the living room.
examples.zh: 设计师为客厅选择了由米色和灰色组成的中性色调。

lemmas.usage_note: 本义为调色板，引申指艺术家或设计师的“色系/色彩风格”，注意勿与 pallet（托盘/简易床）混淆。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自法语，原指调色板，引申为艺术家使用的色彩范围或风格基调。

lemmas.def_en: title used for a married Frenchwoman

examples.en: "Right this way, madame," said the waiter, leading her to the table.
examples.zh: “请这边走，夫人，”侍应生说着，引她走向餐桌。

lemmas.usage_note: 源自法语，用于对非英美籍已婚女性的尊称（首字母大写）；作普通名词口语中可指老鸨，需注意语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自法语 ma（我的）+ dame（夫人），用于对已婚女性的尊称。

lemmas.def_en: of or pertaining to members of the indigenous people of Australia

examples.en: The museum displayed an exquisite collection of aboriginal rock paintings.
examples.zh: 博物馆展出了一批精美的土著岩画藏品。

lemmas.usage_note: 表示“土著的、原生的”，首字母大写时特指澳洲原住民，常见搭配 aboriginal culture / inhabitants / art。

lemmas.def_en: a dark-skinned member of a race of people living in Australia when Europeans arrived

examples.en: European settlers frequently came into conflict with the local aboriginals over land ownership.
examples.zh: 欧洲定居者因土地所有权经常与当地土著居民发生冲突。

lemmas.usage_note: 指某地的土著居民，大写 Aboriginal 常特指澳大利亚原住民；现官方及正式语境常倾向使用 Indigenous peoples。

lemmas.def_zh: 土著, 土著居民, 土人
lemmas.def_en: an indigenous person who was born in a particular place

examples.en: The anthropologist lived with the local aborigine tribe to study their ancient storytelling traditions.
examples.zh: 人类学家与当地土著部落同住，以研究他们古老的口述传统。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 ab-（从……开始）+ origin（起源）+ -al，字面意为“自最初便存在的”，常指土著的。

lemmas.def_en: any shape that is triangular in cross section

examples.en: He shoved a wooden wedge under the door to keep it firmly open.
examples.zh: 他在门下塞了一个木楔，让门稳稳地敞开着。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指楔形物、门塞或起分裂作用的事物，高频搭配 a wedge of cheese、drive a wedge between。

lemmas.def_en: put, fix, force, or implant

examples.en: She managed to wedge her suitcase into the overflowing overhead bin.
examples.zh: 她设法把手提箱塞进了已经塞得满满当当的行李架里。

lemmas.usage_note: 表示把某物卡住或挤进狭窄空间，多与 in、between、into 连用，用于描述物理挤压状态。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语，指具有斜面的楔形工具，引申为卡住、挤入动作。

lemmas.def_en: a thick fatty oil (especially one used to lubricate machinery)

examples.en: The mechanic wiped thick black grease off his hands with an old rag.
examples.zh: 机械师用一块旧抹布擦掉了手上厚厚的黑机油。

lemmas.usage_note: 作不可数名词，指动物油脂、机械润滑油或油污，常见搭配 elbow grease（卖力下功夫）。

lemmas.def_en: consisting of or covered with oil
lubricate with grease

examples.en: Remember to grease the baking tin thoroughly before pouring in the cake batter.
examples.zh: 在倒入蛋糕糊之前，记得将烤盘彻底涂抹一层油。

lemmas.usage_note: 指涂油脂润滑机械或烘焙器具，习语 grease sb's palm 常用于非正式语体表示行贿。

lemmas.def_zh: 油腻的, 含脂肪多的
lemmas.def_en: containing an unusual amount of grease or oil

examples.en: He felt sluggish after eating that greasy burger and a large portion of fries.
examples.zh: 吃完那个油腻的汉堡和一大份薯条后，他觉得浑身懒洋洋的。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容食物油腻、皮肤多油或物体表面湿滑，亦可贬义形容人虚情假意、油滑。

lemmas.def_en: not lubricated

examples.en: The ungreased baking sheet caused the cookies to stick to the bottom.
examples.zh: 未抹油的烤盘导致饼干全粘在了底部。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语，指动物脂肪或稠厚的润滑油，引申为给机械涂油。

lemmas.def_en: the basic unit of money in Vietnam

examples.en: The heavy dong of the cathedral bell signaled that the ceremony was about to begin.
examples.zh: 大教堂厚重的一声钟响预示着仪式即将开始。

lemmas.usage_note: 拟声名词，特指大钟低沉厚重的单声敲击，常与 the dong of a bell 等连用以烘托肃穆氛围。

lemmas.def_en: go `ding dong', like a bell

examples.en: The clock in the tower donged once to mark the half-hour.
examples.zh: 钟楼上的大钟低沉地鸣响了一声，报示已是半点。

lemmas.usage_note: 用作不及物动词，描绘大钟发出低沉洪亮的长鸣声，常用于文学描写中强化听觉印象。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声词，模拟大钟发出的低沉回响声；作名词时亦为越南的货币单位（盾）。

lemmas.def_en: cud-chewing mammal used as a draft or saddle animal in desert regions

examples.en: A caravan of camels slowly made its way across the vast desert.
examples.zh: 一支骆驼商队缓缓穿行在辽阔的沙漠之中。

lemmas.usage_note: 核心成语 the straw that broke the camel's back（压垮骆驼的最后一根稻草），亦常作形容词修饰 camel coat（驼色大衣）。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自闪米特语经希腊语、拉丁语借入，专指耐旱的偶蹄目哺乳动物骆驼。

lemmas.def_en: wild and domesticated birds having a heavy body and short legs

examples.en: A flock of pigeons took off as the loud noise startled them.
examples.zh: 一声巨响惊动了鸽群，它们纷纷展翅飞起。

lemmas.usage_note: 指鸽子，常与 dove 区分（后者偏指白鸽/和平象征）；口语习语 not one's pigeon 意为“与某人无关/非其分内事”。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语，指鸽形目鸟类，口语中常喻指易受骗的人或作为通信载体。

lemmas.def_en: someone who forces another to have sexual intercourse

examples.en: The convicted rapist was sentenced to a lengthy prison term.
examples.zh: 被定罪的强奸犯被判处长期监禁。

lemmas.usage_note: 法律与新闻用语，指强奸犯；通常作可数名词，注意避免与被动语态中表受害者的词汇混淆。

family_guide.root_logic: 词根 rap-（强夺、劫持）+ -ist（人），专门指代犯强奸罪的人。

lemmas.def_en: be fond of; be attached to

examples.en: He continues to cherish the hope that one day they will be reunited.
examples.zh: 他仍然心存希望，期盼着有朝一日能与他们重聚。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面色彩浓厚，后接 memory/hope/freedom 等抽象名词，表示“珍视、怀有（希望）”，不宜过度泛化为日常的 like。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 珍爱的；抱持已久的（理想、记忆等）
lemmas.def_en: characterized by feeling or showing fond affection for; held dear
lemmas.usage_note: 多修饰记忆、传统、梦想、物品等，如 cherished memories / beliefs / possessions。

examples.en: Freedom of speech is one of our most cherished rights.
examples.zh: 言论自由是我们最珍视的权利之一。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 chier（昂贵的、珍贵的），核心语义为“视若珍宝地对待”。

lemmas.def_en: (of light) lacking in intensity or brightness; dim or feeble

examples.en: She gave a wan smile before closing her eyes to rest.
examples.zh: 她勉强露出一丝微弱苍白的微笑，然后闭上眼睛休息。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面语，常修饰面容苍白或笑容勉强，如 a wan smile（虚弱勉强的微笑），多用于描述因生病、劳累导致的神色倦怠。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 wann（苍白的、微暗的），现专指因生病或疲劳而面容苍白、神色憔悴。

lemmas.def_en: a degree or grade of excellence or worth

examples.en: The firm is keen to attract software engineers of the highest caliber.
examples.zh: 该事务所极力吸引具有最高水准的优秀软件工程师。

lemmas.usage_note: 引申指人的才干、水准或事物的质量，常与 of high/exceptional caliber 连用，属正式语体。

lemmas.def_zh: 口径测定, 刻度, 校准
lemmas.def_en: the act of checking or adjusting (by comparison with a standard) the accuracy of a measuring instrument

examples.en: the thermometer needed calibration

lemmas.def_zh: 测定口径, 校准, 使标准化, 调整
lemmas.def_en: make fine adjustments or divide into marked intervals for optimal measuring

examples.en: Technicians must calibrate the laboratory scales regularly to ensure precise chemical measurements.
examples.zh: 技术人员必须定期校准实验室的天平，以确保化学测量的精准。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自阿拉伯语 qalib（模具），最初指枪炮口径，后引申为人的能力或事物的品质。

lemmas.def_en: composed of more than one member, set, or kind
lemmas.def_zh: 复数的, 两个以上的

examples.en: Modern democracies thrive by accommodating plural perspectives and diverse cultures.
examples.zh: 现代民主制度通过包容多元观点与多样文化而繁荣发展。

lemmas.usage_note: 语法中指复数的，引申指多元的或由多种成分构成的，常与 society、forms 搭配。

lemmas.def_en: the form of a word that is used to denote more than one

examples.en: The word 'criterion' has an irregular plural, which is 'criteria'.
examples.zh: 单词“criterion”拥有一个不规则的复数形式，即“criteria”。

lemmas.usage_note: 语法专有名词，指名词或动词的复数形式，常见搭配 in the plural、take a plural verb。

lemmas.def_en: the state of being plural
lemmas.def_zh: 复数, 较大的数, 多数状态, 兼职

examples.en: The candidate won a plurality of the votes, though not an absolute majority.
examples.zh: 该候选人获得了相对多数的选票，尽管未达到绝对多数。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 plus（更多），核心语义表示“数量上多于一个的”。

lemmas.def_en: a state of extreme dishonor; - F.D.Roosevelt
lemmas.def_zh: 臭名昭著；声名狼藉；恶行

examples.en: The dictator earned lasting infamy for his brutal suppression of peaceful protests.
examples.zh: 这位独裁者因残酷镇压和平抗议而遗臭万年。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式书面语，指长期留存的声名狼藉、臭名昭著，或极恶劣的行径，常接 live in infamy。

lemmas.def_en: known widely and usually unfavorably
lemmas.def_zh: 声名狼藉的；臭名昭著的

examples.en: The remote island was infamous for its harsh, escape-proof prison.
examples.zh: 这座偏远岛屿因设有一座环境恶劣、插翅难逃的监狱而臭名昭著。

lemmas.usage_note: 指因罪恶或劣迹而声名狼藉的，常作 be infamous for...，感情色彩强烈且贬义明显。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 in-（无、非）+ 词根 fam-（声誉），字面意为“败坏名声”，引申为极度的恶名。
family_guide.core_distinction: infamy 为名词指臭名昭著或恶行，infamous 为形容词指声名狼藉的。

lemmas.def_en: creative activity (writing or pictures or films etc.) of no literary or artistic value other than to stimulate sexual desire

examples.en: The government introduced strict new laws to curb the spread of online pornography.
examples.zh: 政府出台了严格的新法律以遏制网络色情制品的传播。

lemmas.usage_note: 作不可数名词，专指淫秽描写或色情出版物/音像制品，常见搭配 hard-core/soft-core pornography。

lemmas.def_en: someone who presents shows or sells writing or pictures that are sexually explicit in violation of the community mores
lemmas.def_zh: 色情小说作家, 色情作品作者

examples.en: The controversial pornographer faced numerous legal battles throughout his career.
examples.zh: 这位颇具争议的色情制品作者在其职业生涯中面临着无数诉讼。

lemmas.def_en: designed to arouse lust
lemmas.def_zh: 淫秽作品的, 色情的

examples.en: The website was blocked because it contained illicit and pornographic material.
examples.zh: 该网站因包含非法和色情内容而被封禁。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 porne（妓女）+ graphein（书写、描摹），指描绘色情内容的书画作品。

lemmas.def_en: laugh quietly or with restraint

examples.en: She chuckled softly at the memory of their childhood adventures.
examples.zh: 回想起童年的冒险经历，她不禁轻声笑了出来。

lemmas.usage_note: 指轻声低笑、暗笑；常与介词 at 连用（如 chuckle at the memory），亦可作及物动词引出直接引语。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声词，模拟压抑在喉咙里的轻笑声。

lemmas.def_en: a prearranged fight with deadly weapons by two people (accompanied by seconds) in order to settle a quarrel over a point of honor

examples.en: The two presidential candidates engaged in a fierce televised debate duel last night.
examples.zh: 两位总统候选人昨晚在电视辩论中展开了激烈的交锋。

lemmas.usage_note: 本义指带武器的正式决斗，现常借指两人或两方间激烈的较量，常与 fight a duel 搭配。

lemmas.def_en: a person who fights duels

examples.en: The skilled duelist drew his sword with blinding speed and supreme confidence.
examples.zh: 那位老练的决斗者以极快的速度和极大的自信拔出了利剑。

lemmas.def_en: a person who fights duels

examples.en: The French duellist was notorious for never losing an honor fight.
examples.zh: 这位法国决斗者因在荣誉决斗中从未败北而声名远扬。

lemmas.def_en: a person who fights duels

examples.en: Each dueler stood back to back before taking ten paces forward.
examples.zh: 每位决斗者背对背站立，随后向前迈出十步。

lemmas.def_en: fight a duel, as over one's honor or a woman

examples.en: The two chess grandmasters dueled for five grueling hours before settling for a draw.
examples.zh: 两位国际象棋特级大师经过长达五个小时的艰苦较量，最终握手言和。

lemmas.usage_note: 作不及物动词，指双方直接决斗或角逐竞争，常后接介词 with 或 for，强调一对一抗衡。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 duellum（古体 bellum，战争），受 duo（二）影响演化为两人间的正式决斗。

lemmas.def_en: a narrow channel of the sea joining two larger bodies of water

examples.en: Ships must navigate carefully through the narrow strait.
examples.zh: 船只穿过狭窄的海峡时必须小心航行。

lemmas.usage_note: 地理上常大写并单数（如 Strait of Gibraltar）；指困境时多用复数形式 in dire straits（陷入窘境）。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 strictus（拉紧的、窄的），特指狭窄的水道，引申为经济或生活的困境。

lemmas.def_en: a mental position from which things are viewed

examples.en: Try to consider the problem from a different viewpoint.
examples.zh: 试着从不同的视角来思考这个问题。

lemmas.usage_note: 意为“观点、视角”，最常见固定搭配为 from a/the viewpoint of（从……的角度看），可与 point of view 互换。

family_guide.root_logic: 复合词 view（看、视野）+ point（点），即“观察事物的立足点”。

lemmas.def_en: move outward

examples.en: The cool mist began to diffuse across the valley as the sun rose.
examples.zh: 太阳升起时，清凉的薄雾开始在山谷中弥漫开来。

lemmas.usage_note: 发音为 /dɪˈfjuːz/，指光线、气体散开或知识、文化传播扩散，亦指缓和紧张局势。

lemmas.def_en: (physics) the process in which there is movement of a substance from an area of high concentration of that substance to an area of lower concentration
lemmas.def_zh: 散播, 传播, 蔓延

examples.en: The rapid diffusion of digital technology has transformed modern communication worldwide.
examples.zh: 数字技术的迅速传播改变了全球的现代通信方式。

lemmas.def_en: baffle that distributes sound waves evenly
lemmas.def_zh: 漫射体, 喷雾器, 扬声器纸盆, 传播者, 散布者

examples.en: She placed an essential oil diffuser on the desk to promote relaxation.
examples.zh: 她在桌上放了一个精油香薰机，以促进身心放松。

lemmas.def_en: baffle that distributes sound waves evenly

examples.en: He placed a small essential oil diffusor on his office desk.
examples.zh: 他在办公桌上放了一个小精油扩香器。

lemmas.def_en: spread out; not concentrated in one place

examples.en: His essay was criticized for its diffuse structure and lack of clear arguments.
examples.zh: 他的文章因结构散漫、缺乏明确论点而受到了批评。

lemmas.usage_note: 发音为 /dɪˈfjuːs/，形容光线柔和分散，或贬义形容文章、言论冗长晦涩、不着边际。

lemmas.def_en: spreading by diffusion
lemmas.def_zh: 散播的, 冗长的, 扩散的

examples.en: The aroma of fresh coffee had a warm and diffusive presence throughout the kitchen.
examples.zh: 新鲜咖啡的香气在整个厨房中温暖地弥漫开来。

lemmas.def_en: in a diffuse manner
lemmas.def_zh: 弥漫, 扩散, 散开, 冗长, 噜苏, 漫射, 向各个方向移动, 定义含糊

examples.en: The afternoon sunlight fell diffusely across the old wooden floorboards.
examples.zh: 午后的阳光漫射在老旧的木质地板上。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 dis-（分开）+ 词根 fus-（倒、流），本义为“向四面八方流散”，引申为扩散或冗长。
family_guide.core_distinction: diffuse 作动词时重音在后，表示扩散、传播；作形容词时表示分散的或言语冗长的。

lemmas.def_en: beyond or deviating from the usual or expected
lemmas.def_zh: 奇怪的, 不舒服的, 可疑的

examples.en: She suddenly had a queer feeling that she was being watched from the dark alley.
examples.zh: 她突然产生了一种奇怪的预感，觉得有人正在漆黑的小巷里注视着她。

lemmas.usage_note: 传统文学中常表古怪或身体不适（feel queer），当代多指酷儿群体，须依语境审慎使用。

lemmas.def_en: hinder or prevent (the efforts, plans, or desires) of

examples.en: A single careless remark during the interview completely queered his chances of getting the job.
examples.zh: 面试中一句不慎的言辞彻底搞砸了他获得这份工作的机会。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常用于英式俚语搭配 queer sb's pitch，意为故意扰乱、破坏或搞砸某人的计划。

lemmas.def_en: a strange attitude or habit

examples.en: There was an undeniable queerness about the abandoned house on the hill.
examples.zh: 山上的那座废弃房屋透着一种不可否认的古怪感。

lemmas.def_en: in a strange manner

examples.en: She looked at him queerly when he claimed he could see ghosts.
examples.zh: 当他声称自己能看见鬼魂时，她古怪地看着他。

family_guide.root_logic: 来源不详，原义为“古怪的、奇特的”，20世纪后逐渐被吸纳为非异性恋或跨性别群体的统称。

lemmas.def_en: a list of employees and their salaries
lemmas.def_zh: 在册员工工资表；工薪总额

examples.en: The company currently has over 500 employees on its payroll.
examples.zh: 该公司目前在册领薪的员工超过500人。

lemmas.usage_note: 商务高频词，常用搭配 on the payroll（受雇于某公司）及 meet the payroll（按时发放员工工资）。

family_guide.root_logic: 复合词 pay（薪酬）+ roll（名册），字面义为“工资名单”，指发放薪水的总额或名册。

lemmas.def_en: strive to equal or match, especially by imitating
lemmas.def_zh: 努力赶上；效仿；（计算机）仿真

examples.en: Young athletes around the world strive to emulate her remarkable work ethic and discipline.
examples.zh: 世界各地的年轻运动员都努力效仿她那非凡的敬业精神与自律。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作及物动词，指以敬佩之心效仿榜样或在技术上仿真，常搭配 success、behavior 等。

lemmas.def_en: ambition to equal or excel

examples.en: His remarkable dedication to charity work is worthy of emulation by everyone.
examples.zh: 他在慈善工作上的卓越奉献值得所有人效仿。

lemmas.def_en: someone who copies the words or behavior of another

examples.en: He used a mobile emulator on his laptop to test the new game.
examples.zh: 他在笔记本电脑上使用移动端模拟器来测试这款新游戏。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 aemulus（竞争的），指出于崇敬而努力赶上或超越他人。

lemmas.def_en: coming next after the nineteenth in position
lemmas.def_zh: 第二十的；二十分之一的

examples.en: The museum is hosting an exhibition of twentieth-century modern art.
examples.zh: 该博物馆正在举办一场20世纪现代艺术展。

lemmas.usage_note: 序数词，注意拼写中 y 变 ie 再加 th；常修饰世纪（the twentieth century）或纪念日（twentieth anniversary）。

family_guide.root_logic: 词基 twenty（二十）+ 序数词后缀 -th。

lemmas.def_en: any of several fat-soluble organic compounds having as a basis 17 carbon atoms in four rings; many have important physiological effects
lemmas.def_zh: n. 类固醇；（用于增强体能的）类固醇兴奋剂

examples.en: The athlete was banned from international competition after testing positive for anabolic steroids.
examples.zh: 该运动员在同化类固醇检测呈阳性后，被禁止参加国际比赛。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，医学上指类固醇，体育语境中常复数使用指违禁兴奋剂，常与 use、inject 搭配。

lemmas.def_en: an organic compound that does no contain a steroid

examples.en: The doctor prescribed a nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug to relieve his persistent joint pain.
examples.zh: 医生开了非甾体抗炎药来缓解他持续的关节疼痛。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to steroid hormones or their effects

examples.en: Long-term steroidal treatment can sometimes lead to unexpected medical side effects.
examples.zh: 长期使用类固醇治疗有时会导致意想不到的医学副作用。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 stereos（立体、固体），因早期从固态胆固醇中提取而得名，现特指类固醇化合物。

lemmas.def_en: a kingdom (constitutional monarchy) in northwestern Africa with a largely Muslim population; achieved independence from France in 1956
lemmas.def_zh: n. 摩洛哥坚革（常用于精装书的山羊皮）

examples.en: The antique volume was bound in crimson morocco.
examples.zh: 这本古籍是用深红色的摩洛哥皮革装订的。

lemmas.usage_note: 小写时专指装订书籍用的“摩洛哥山羊皮”，不可数；注意与大写的国名 Morocco（摩洛哥）区分。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自北非国家“摩洛哥（Morocco）”，因该地出产的优质山羊皮革而引申为专用皮革名。

lemmas.def_en: troops trained to fight on horseback

examples.en: The regiment was historically known as light cavalry.
examples.zh: 该团历史上被称为轻骑兵团。

lemmas.usage_note: 作集合名词指骑兵或装甲部队，常连用复数动词；口语常借指“救兵”，注意勿与受难地Calvary混淆。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 caballus（马），演化为骑兵部队及现代装甲部队。

lemmas.def_en: clearly defined or formulated; - R.B.Taney
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 决定性的；最权威的；确凿的

examples.en: This biography is considered the definitive study of the artist's life.
examples.zh: 这部传记被认为是研究该艺术家生平的最具权威性的著作。

lemmas.usage_note: 常搭配definitive edition/answer/guide，强调“权威且最终的”，避免与仅表限制的definite混用。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自 define（界定，限制），加形容词后缀 -itive，表“最终确立的、具权威性的”。

lemmas.def_en: the sensation caused by heat energy

examples.en: She greeted her old friends with genuine warmth.
examples.zh: 她以由衷的热情迎接着老友们。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，既指温度也常搭配feel/radiate the warmth of，用于情感时表示“热情、亲切”。

family_guide.root_logic: 由形容词 warm（温暖的）加名词后缀 -th 构成，表温度或情感上的暖意。

lemmas.def_en: a surrounding or nearby region
lemmas.def_zh: n. 邻近，周边地区；大约（数量）

examples.en: Several high-end restaurants and art galleries have opened in the immediate vicinity of the museum.
examples.zh: 几家高端餐厅和艺术画廊在该博物馆紧邻的周边地区开业。

lemmas.usage_note: 通常以 in the vicinity (of...) 的固定短语出现，表示在某地附近或数量大约接近。

lemmas.def_zh: 附近的, 接近的, 地方的, 本地的
lemmas.def_en: belonging to or limited to a vicinity

examples.en: The construction project only used materials sourced from the vicinal forest areas.
examples.zh: 该建设项目仅使用了附近森林地区采购的材料。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 vicinus（邻近的），指邻里、周边区域或数值上的接近。

lemmas.def_en: popular dance music (especially in the late 1970s); melodic with a regular bass beat; intended mainly for dancing at discotheques
lemmas.def_zh: n. 迪斯科舞厅；迪斯科舞曲 |

examples.en: During the late 1970s, the local disco was packed with dancers every weekend.
examples.zh: 在20世纪70年代末，那家当地的迪斯科舞厅每到周末都挤满了跳舞的人。

lemmas.usage_note: 作名词表示迪斯科舞厅或舞曲，常与 go to、dance to 搭配，具强烈的复古流行色彩。

lemmas.def_en: dance to disco music

examples.en: The enthusiastic crowd discoed all night long to celebrate the retro festival.
examples.zh: 热情的群众跳了整晚的迪斯科，以庆祝这个复古狂欢节。

lemmas.usage_note: 作不及物动词，指跳迪斯科舞，属于口语及非正式语体，常与 away、the night away 连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 缩略自法语 discothèque（唱片库），后流行指代迪斯科舞厅及相关舞曲，亦可作动词。

lemmas.def_en: proclaim on, or as if on, a trumpet
lemmas.def_zh: v. 大声宣告，鼓吹；吹小号；（大象等）吼叫

examples.en: The tech company trumpeted its latest quarterly profits as proof of a successful turnaround.
examples.zh: 这家科技公司大肆宣扬其最新季度利润，以证明其转型成功。

lemmas.usage_note: 可作及物或不及物动词，引申为大肆鼓吹某事，常搭配 success、achievement，含赞扬或贬义宣传色调。

lemmas.def_en: a musician who plays the trumpet or cornet
lemmas.def_zh: 小号吹奏者, 号兵, 吹鼓手

examples.en: A talented jazz trumpeter played a mournful solo on the dimly lit street.
examples.zh: 一位才华横溢的爵士小号手在昏暗的街道上演奏了一段悲伤的独奏。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 trompe（喇叭），作动词时借指如吹小号般“大肆宣扬”。

lemmas.def_en: state of violent mental agitation
lemmas.def_zh: n. 歇斯底里，极度情绪失控；群众狂热

examples.en: Sensational headlines in the media whipped up public hysteria about the economic downturn.
examples.zh: 媒体上耸人听闻的头条新闻煽动起了公众对经济衰退的群体性恐慌。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，指极度情绪失控或群体狂热，常与 mass、widespread、whip up 搭配。

lemmas.def_en: a person suffering from hysteria

examples.en: The shocking news sent the crowd into a state of hysteric panic.
examples.zh: 令人震惊的消息让整个人群陷入了歇斯底里的恐慌状态。

lemmas.def_en: characterized by or arising from psychoneurotic hysteria; - Morris Fishbein
lemmas.def_zh: 歇斯底里的, 异常兴奋的

examples.en: The exhausted parents burst into hysterical laughter after the chaotic birthday party.
examples.zh: 在混乱的生日派对结束后，筋疲力尽的父母歇斯底里地大笑起来。

lemmas.def_zh: 癔病的, 歇斯底里的
lemmas.def_en: characterized by or arising from psychoneurotic hysteria; - Morris Fishbein

examples.en: The shocking news sent the crowd into a state of hysteric panic.
examples.zh: 令人震惊的消息让整个人群陷入了歇斯底里的恐慌状态。

lemmas.def_en: in a hysterical manner

examples.en: The audience laughed hysterically throughout the comedian's brilliant hour-long stand-up special.
examples.zh: 在喜剧演员长达一小时的精彩单口相声专场中，观众们笑得前仰后合。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 hystera（子宫），古人误以为由子宫问题引发，现泛指极度情绪失控、狂热或歇斯底里。

lemmas.def_en: ammunition consisting of a cylindrical casing containing an explosive charge and a bullet; fired from a rifle or handgun
lemmas.def_zh: n. 子弹筒，弹药筒；墨盒；磁带盒

examples.en: The printer has run out of black ink, so we need to replace the cartridge.
examples.zh: 打印机的黑色墨水用完了，我们需要更换墨盒。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，高频搭配ink/toner cartridge（打印机墨盒/硒鼓），或指武器领域的“子弹壳、弹药筒”。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自法语 cartouche（纸卷包裹物），后特指枪弹药筒、墨盒等封装单元。

lemmas.def_en: write out from speech, notes, etc.
lemmas.def_zh: v. 记录，转录；改编（乐曲）

examples.en: The research assistant spent three days transcribing the recorded interviews from the field study.
examples.zh: 助理研究员花了三天时间将实地调研中录制的采访内容转写成文字。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指将录音转写为文字或将乐曲改写配器，常搭配 interview、recording 等。

lemmas.def_en: something written, especially copied from one medium to another, as a typewritten version of dictation
lemmas.def_zh: n. 抄本，转录本；转写，记录

examples.en: She carefully reviewed the phonetic transcription of the dialect recorded by the linguists.
examples.zh: 她仔细审阅了语言学家记录下的当地方言的国际音标转写文本。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，既可指转写的过程（不可数），也可指转写后的文本（可数），常与 accurate 连用。

lemmas.def_en: a person who translates written messages from one language to another
lemmas.def_zh: 抄写者, 誊写员, 抄录器, 信息转换器, 读数器

examples.en: The legal transcriber listened carefully to the recording and typed every word accurately.
examples.zh: 法律文字转录员仔细聆听录音，准确地键入每一个词。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 trans-（跨越，转换）+ scribe（书写），指将声音或文字形式“转换书写下来”。
family_guide.core_distinction: transcribe 为动词（转录/誊写）；transcription 为名词（转录本/转写过程）。

lemmas.def_en: a composer of words or music for popular songs
lemmas.def_zh: n. 歌曲创作者，词曲作者

examples.en: He is a talented songwriter who composed hits for many pop stars.
examples.zh: 他是一位才华横溢的词曲作者，为许多流行歌星创作过大热单曲。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指流行或现代歌曲创作者，常构成固定称谓singer-songwriter（唱作人、原创歌手）。

family_guide.root_logic: 复合词：song（歌曲）+ writer（作者），指专门创作歌曲（通常包含词曲）的人。

lemmas.def_en: a song of praise (to God or to a saint or to a nation)

examples.en: The congregation stood up to sing a traditional hymn at the beginning of the service.
examples.zh: 礼拜开始时，全体会众起立唱了一首传统的赞美诗。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指宗教赞美诗或比喻性的颂歌，常与 sing、compose 及介词 to 搭配。

lemmas.def_en: sing a hymn

examples.en: The ancient poet hymned the glorious deeds of legendary heroes in his epic verses.
examples.zh: 这位古代诗人在他的史诗诗篇中歌颂了传奇英雄的辉煌事迹。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，属书面与文学语体，意为歌颂、高度赞美，常接 achievements、praises 等宾语。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 hymnos（赞歌），特指宗教赞美诗，引申为唱赞歌赞颂。

lemmas.def_en: equipment designed to serve a specific function
lemmas.def_zh: n. 仪器，器械；（政府、党派等）机构，组织

examples.en: Firefighters used breathing apparatus to enter the smoke-filled building.
examples.zh: 消防员使用呼吸器进入了浓烟弥漫的大楼。

lemmas.usage_note: 多作不可数或单复同形，指成套仪器（如lab apparatus）；引申指政治/官僚机构（state apparatus）。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 apparare（准备），由 ad-（去）+ parare（准备）构成，指为特定目的准备的整套设备、工具或组织系统。

lemmas.def_en: the relation that exists when things occur at the same time

examples.en: The dancers moved in perfect synchrony with the pulsing rhythm of the drums.
examples.zh: 舞者们随着鼓点律动完全同步地舞动着。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，多见于学术与技术语境，常构成固定短语 in synchrony (with) 表示同步协调。

lemmas.def_en: the relation that exists when things occur at the same time

examples.en: Cloud synchronization allows you to access your files seamlessly from any device.
examples.zh: 云同步使你能够从任何设备无缝访问自己的文件。

lemmas.def_en: the relation that exists when things occur at the same time

examples.en: Meeting her old classmate in a foreign city seemed like pure synchronicity.
examples.zh: 在异国他乡偶遇老同学，似乎纯属巧合与机缘。

lemmas.def_en: an instrument that indicates whether two periodic motions are synchronous (especially an instrument that enables a pilot to synchronize the propellers of a plane that has two or more engines)
lemmas.def_zh: 同步装置, 同步闪光装置

examples.en: A broken synchronizer in the manual transmission made shifting gears very difficult.
examples.zh: 手动变速箱中损坏的同步器让换挡变得非常困难。

lemmas.def_en: make synchronous and adjust in time or manner
lemmas.def_zh: 使同步, 使合拍；同时发生

examples.en: Let us synchronize our watches so we can launch the surprise simultaneously.
examples.zh: 我们对一下表，以便能同时发起这次惊喜。

lemmas.def_en: occurring or existing at the same time or having the same period or phase; - Jour.A.M.A.

examples.en: The online course offers both synchronous live lectures and self-paced study modules.
examples.zh: 这门在线课程既提供实时的同步直播讲座，也提供自定进度的学习模块。

lemmas.def_en: occurring or existing at the same time or having the same period or phase; - Jour.A.M.A.
lemmas.def_zh: 仅描写某一特写时期的, 共时的

examples.en: The linguist conducted a synchronic study of slang used by contemporary teenagers.
examples.zh: 这位语言学家对当代青少年使用的俚语进行了共时性研究。

lemmas.def_en: not occurring together

examples.en: The dancers struggled to keep rhythm during their chaotic, unsynchronized final rehearsal.
examples.zh: 舞者们在混乱且不同步的最后一次排练中难以保持节奏。

lemmas.def_en: in synchrony; in a synchronous manner

examples.en: All fireflies in the clearing flashed synchronously, lighting up the dark summer forest.
examples.zh: 林中空地上的所有萤火虫同时闪烁，照亮了夏夜的森林。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 syn-（共同）+ chronos（时间），核心意为“在时间上的同时性、同步性”。

lemmas.def_en: a periodic publication containing pictures and stories and articles of interest to those who purchase it or subscribe to it

examples.en: She was flipping through a fashion mag while waiting for her flight.
examples.zh: 她一边等飞机，一边翻阅着一本时尚杂志。

lemmas.usage_note: magazine的口语极度缩写，常用于出版圈或年轻人闲聊中，如glossy mags（铜版纸杂志）。

family_guide.root_logic: magazine 的非正式口语截短形式。

lemmas.def_en: a boy or man

examples.en: He seemed like a decent fella when I spoke to him.
examples.zh: 我和他交谈时，觉得他像个挺不错的小伙子。

lemmas.usage_note: fellow的口语非正式拼写，常指“小伙子、哥们”，用于熟人间招呼或指代男性，语气亲切随性。

family_guide.root_logic: fellow 的口语化发音变体，意为“家伙，伙计”。

lemmas.def_en: make short successive sounds
lemmas.def_zh: 使嘎嘎响, 喋喋不休地说；格格响, 喋喋不休

examples.en: The unexpected and aggressive questions during the cross-examination began to rattle the witness.
examples.zh: 交叉盘问中那些突如其来且咄咄逼人的提问开始让证人感到慌乱。

lemmas.usage_note: 可作不及物或及物动词，指发出格格声响，引申为使人紧张不安，常搭配 rattle off（飞快说出）。

lemmas.def_en: a rapid series of short loud sounds (as might be heard with a stethoscope in some types of respiratory disorders)
lemmas.def_zh: 格格声, 拨浪鼓, 喋喋不休的话

examples.en: A sudden metallic rattle under the hood alerted the driver to an engine problem.
examples.zh: 引擎盖下突然传来的金属嘎嘎声提醒驾驶员发动机出现了故障。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，指短促连续的格格声，也可指婴儿玩具拨浪鼓，常与 loud、metallic 连用。

lemmas.def_en: pit viper with horny segments at the end of the tail that rattle when shaken
lemmas.def_zh: (美)响尾蛇, 饶舌的人, (美)(非正式)有轨电车, 磨砖机

examples.en: While hiking along the rocky path, we suddenly spotted a dangerous rattler sunning itself.
examples.zh: 沿着岩石小路徒步时，我们突然发现一条危险的响尾蛇正在晒太阳。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声词，模拟连续短促的碰撞脆响，引申指“使慌乱”。

lemmas.def_en: Vice President of the United States under Bill Clinton (born in 1948)
lemmas.def_zh: 流出的血, 淤血, 三角形布

examples.en: The horror movie contained far too much blood and gore for younger viewers.
examples.zh: 这部恐怖片充斥着太多血腥场面，不适合年轻观众观看。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，常指暴力场景中流出的浓稠血液，常与 blood 连用构成 blood and gore。

lemmas.def_en: wound by piercing with a sharp or penetrating object or instrument
lemmas.def_zh: 把...剪成楔形三角布, 缝以补裆, 刺伤, 抵

examples.en: The matador was severely gored by the enraged bull during the festival.
examples.zh: 在节日期间，斗牛士被愤怒的公牛严重顶伤。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常指动物用角或长牙刺伤、挑伤人畜，多用于被动语态或突发攻击场景。

family_guide.root_logic: 古英语词源，作名词指凝固的血块（常伴随暴力），作动词源自长矛、角等尖锐物刺伤。

lemmas.def_en: two words that can be interchanged in a context are said to be synonymous relative to that context

examples.en: The dictionary listed 'wealthy' as a common synonym for 'rich'.
examples.zh: 词典把“wealthy”列为“rich”的一个常见同义词。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，后常接介词 for，表示某个词的同义词，学术写作与词汇教学中极常见。

lemmas.def_en: (of words) meaning the same or nearly the same

examples.en: His family name has become synonymous with luxury and exquisite taste.
examples.zh: 他的家族姓氏已经成了奢华与高雅品味的代名词。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与介词 with 搭配构成 be synonymous with，比喻某事物与某种特质紧密等同。

lemmas.def_en: in a synonymous manner

examples.en: The two terms are often used synonymously, although their technical meanings differ slightly.
examples.zh: 这两个术语经常被同义使用，尽管它们在技术含义上略有不同。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 syn-（共同）+ onyma（名字），指“具有相同含义的词”。
family_guide.core_distinction: synonym 为名词表示同义词；synonymous 为形容词，常引申为“等同于、密不可分的”。

lemmas.def_en: a British imperial capacity measure (liquid or dry) equal to 4 gills or 568.26 cubic centimeters
lemmas.def_zh: 品脱(干量或液量的单位)

examples.en: After a hard day at work, he enjoyed a cold pint of beer.
examples.zh: 辛苦工作了一天后，他享用了一品脱冰镇啤酒。

lemmas.usage_note: 英美容量单位（品脱），英式口语中常专指“一杯啤酒”，高频搭配go for a pint（去喝一杯）。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 pinte，容量计量单位，常在口语中特指一品脱啤酒。

lemmas.def_en: the moment of most intense pleasure in sexual intercourse
lemmas.def_zh: 极度兴奋, 兴奋的高潮, (感情等的)爆发

examples.en: The scientific study examined physiological changes that happen during a female orgasm.
examples.zh: 这项科学研究考察了女性达到性高潮时发生的生理变化。

lemmas.usage_note: 生理学及日常用语，动词常搭配have/reach/experience an orgasm或fake an orgasm。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 organ（充满液体、膨胀、激动），指性兴奋的最高峰。

lemmas.def_en: a group of musicians playing or singing together
lemmas.def_zh: 全体, 合唱曲, (女人的)全套服装

examples.en: The local chamber ensemble will perform several classical pieces at the theater tonight.
examples.zh: 当地的室内乐团今晚将在剧院演奏几首古典乐曲。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面色彩浓厚，既指“乐团/剧团全体”，也常用于时尚界指“协调搭配的全套服装”。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自法语，en-（在内）+ semble（共同），指各个部分组合在一起的“整体、合奏组或成套服装”。

lemmas.def_en: magnifier of the image of small objects

examples.en: The lab technician placed the slide under the microscope to inspect the cells.
examples.zh: 实验室技术员将载玻片置于显微镜下以检查细胞。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，常与介词 under 搭配构成 under the microscope，字面或比喻仔细审视。

lemmas.def_zh: 显微镜使用, 用显微镜检查, 显微镜学
lemmas.def_en: research with the use of microscopes

examples.en: Recent advances in fluorescence microscopy have allowed scientists to observe living molecules.
examples.zh: 荧光显微技术的最新进展使科学家能够观察到活体分子。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，指显微镜的使用技术、检测方法或显微术学科，属于科学专业术语。

lemmas.def_en: a scientist who specializes in research with the use of microscopes
of or relating to or used in microscopy
lemmas.def_zh: 显微镜的, 用显微镜可见的, 微观的, (非正式)极微小的, 细微的

examples.en: Many microscopic organisms live in the soil and help break down organic matter.
examples.zh: 许多微小的微生物生活在土壤中，帮助分解有机物。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or used in microscopy
lemmas.def_zh: 显微镜的, 用显微镜可见的, 微观的, (非正式)极微小的, 细微的

examples.en: A thorough microscopical examination revealed several tiny cracks along the metal surface.
examples.zh: 彻底的显微镜检查显示金属表面有几处微小的裂纹。

lemmas.def_en: by using a microscope; so as to be visible only with a microscope; as seen with a microscope
lemmas.def_zh: 用显微镜, 通过显微镜

examples.en: The tissue sample was examined microscopically to check for any signs of infection.
examples.zh: 组织样本在显微镜下进行了检查，以排查任何感染迹象。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 micro-（微小）+ -scope（观察工具），即观察微小事物的仪器。

lemmas.def_en: a step in walking or running
lemmas.def_zh: 大步, 步幅, 步态, 进步

examples.en: The research team has made great strides toward finding a cure for the disease.
examples.zh: 研究团队在寻找该疾病治愈方法方面取得了巨大进展。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作复数 strides，多与 make 搭配构成 make great strides，表示取得显著进步。

lemmas.def_en: a person who walks rapidly with long steps

examples.en: He played the classic video game Strider for hours on his vintage console.
examples.zh: 他在老式游戏机上玩了几个小时的经典游戏《出击飞龙》。

lemmas.def_en: walk with long steps
lemmas.def_zh: 迈大步走, 跨过, 跨

examples.en: She strode purposefully into the conference room and commanded everyone's attention.
examples.zh: 她大步流星、自信果断地走进会议室，吸引了所有人的注意。

lemmas.usage_note: 不及物动词，指大步快走，常与 into、across、down 等介词连用描述自信神态。

lemmas.def_en: walk with long steps

examples.en: The manager strode purposefully across the busy office floor toward the conference room.
examples.zh: 经理目的明确地大步穿过忙碌的办公室，走向会议室。

family_guide.root_logic: 日耳曼语族词源，核心动作是“迈大步走”，引申指进展与跨越。

lemmas.def_en: a liquor made from fermented mash of grain

examples.en: He poured himself a glass of aged Irish whiskey beside the warm fireplace.
examples.zh: 他在温暖的壁炉旁给自己倒了一杯陈年爱尔兰威士忌。

lemmas.usage_note: 通常指爱尔兰或美国威士忌（苏格兰/加拿大常用whisky），搭配如whiskey on the rocks（加冰威士忌）。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自盖尔语 uisce beatha，字面意思是“生命之水”，特指烈性威士忌蒸馏酒。

lemmas.def_en: induce to have sex
lemmas.def_zh: 唆使, 怂恿, 引诱, 诱奸

examples.en: The corrupt official was seduced into accepting bribes by promises of immense wealth.
examples.zh: 那个腐败官员受巨额财富承诺的诱惑而收受了贿赂。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，既指肉体诱惑，也常引申为以利益怂恿诱导某人犯错，常接 into doing。

lemmas.def_en: enticing someone astray from right behavior
lemmas.def_zh: 教唆, 怂恿, 诱惑, 诱惑物, 诱饵

examples.en: The sweet seduction of fame has ruined many talented young artists in Hollywood.
examples.zh: 成名的甜蜜诱惑在好莱坞毁掉了许多才华横溢的年轻艺术家。

lemmas.def_en: a bad person who entices others into error or wrongdoing
lemmas.def_zh: 诱惑者, 骗子, 玩弄女性的人

examples.en: The smooth-talking seducer deceived several lonely women out of their life savings.
examples.zh: 这个能说会道的花言巧语之徒骗取了几位孤独女性的毕生积蓄。

family_guide.root_logic: 拉丁语 se-（离开、偏离）+ ducere（引导），字面即“引离正道”，引申为诱惑、勾引。

lemmas.def_en: land that is covered with trees and shrubs

examples.en: They spent the peaceful afternoon walking their dog through the dense green woodland.
examples.zh: 他们在这个宁静的下午带着狗在茂密的绿色林地里散步。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作不可数名词泛指林地，也可作定语如 woodland area，比 forest 更偏自然生态或乡村风光。

family_guide.root_logic: 复合词 wood（树木，森林）+ land（土地），指覆盖着树木的林地。

lemmas.def_en: turn aside; turn away from

examples.en: The pilot was instructed not to deviate from the planned flight path.
examples.zh: 飞行员接到指令，不得偏离预定的飞行航线。

lemmas.usage_note: 不及物动词，常与介词 from 搭配构成 deviate from，表示偏离预定路线、规范或主题。

lemmas.def_en: a variation that deviates from the standard or norm

examples.en: Any significant deviation from the approved safety plan could result in severe penalties.
examples.zh: 任何偏离获批安全计划的重大背离都可能导致严厉的处罚。

lemmas.def_en: a person whose behavior deviates from what is acceptable especially in sexual behavior

examples.en: Sociologists study why certain individuals become social deviants while others conform.
examples.zh: 社会学家研究为什么某些人会沦为社会越轨者，而其他人则循规蹈矩。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指行为、思想背离社会普遍公认道德或法律标准的人，带有贬义色彩。

lemmas.def_en: a state or condition markedly different from the norm

examples.en: Sociologists study various forms of social deviance to understand shifting cultural norms.
examples.zh: 社会学家研究各种形式的社会越轨行为，以理解不断变化的文化规范。

lemmas.def_en: markedly different from an accepted norm

examples.en: The psychologist analyzed the underlying factors behind his deviant behavior.
examples.zh: 心理学家分析了他异常行为背后的深层原因。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，作定语修饰 behavior 等词，指行为或思想异常、反常且不符合社会规范。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 de-（离开）+ via（道路），引申为偏离既定轨道、常规或标准。

lemmas.def_en: a soft whitish calcite

examples.en: The teacher picked up a piece of white chalk and wrote the formula on the board.
examples.zh: 老师拿起一支白色粉笔，在黑板上写下了公式。

lemmas.usage_note: 可指石灰岩（不可数）或黑板粉笔（单根常作 a piece of chalk），教育与地质常用词。

lemmas.def_en: write, draw, or trace with chalk

examples.en: We can chalk the initial failure up to a lack of preparation.
examples.zh: 我们可以把最初的失败归结为准备不足。

lemmas.usage_note: 动词，常与 up 搭配构成短语 chalk sth up to，表示将某事归咎于或归功于某原因。

lemmas.def_en: composed of or containing or resembling calcium carbonate or calcite or chalk

examples.en: His skin had a chalky pallor that worried the doctor during the examination.
examples.zh: 在检查过程中，他苍白的脸色让医生感到担忧。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 cealc（石灰石），指白垩或粉笔，后引申为用粉笔做标记、记录。

lemmas.def_en: a written assurance that some product or service will be provided or will meet certain specifications

examples.en: The new laptop comes with a standard two-year manufacturer warranty.
examples.zh: 这款新笔记本电脑附带两年的原厂标准保修。

lemmas.usage_note: 商品质保专用词，高频搭配 under warranty（在保修期内）或 1-year warranty，注意不可拼写为 guaranty。

family_guide.root_logic: 来自古法语 warantie（担保、保证），与 guarantee 同源，指法律或商业上的质量保障。

lemmas.def_en: a procession of land vehicles traveling together

examples.en: A convoy of supply trucks made its way cautiously through the dangerous mountain pass.
examples.zh: 一支补给卡车车队小心翼翼地穿过了危险的山口。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指结队护卫前行的车队或船队，常与 in convoy 搭配表示编队行进。

lemmas.def_en: escort in transit

examples.en: Naval destroyers were deployed to convoy the merchant ships across the hostile waters.
examples.zh: 海军驱逐舰被部署以护送商船穿过敌对水域。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指武装力量护航船只或车辆，常用于军事、救援或外交场景中。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 com-（共同）+ via（道路），本义为结伴同行，演变为护送、车队/船队。

lemmas.def_en: be shiny, as if wet
lemmas.def_zh: 灿烂, 闪烁, 辉耀

examples.en: Her diamond necklace glittered brightly under the chandeliers of the ballroom.
examples.zh: 在宴会厅吊灯的照射下，她的钻石项链闪烁着耀眼的光芒。

lemmas.usage_note: 不及物动词，指反射闪耀刺目光芒，常形容珠宝、水面或眼神中的兴奋情绪。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of shining with a bright reflected light
lemmas.def_zh: 灿烂, 闪烁, 辉耀

examples.en: She was quickly captivated by the glamour and glitter of the entertainment industry.
examples.zh: 她很快就被娱乐行业的魅力与浮华所深深吸引。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，既指装饰用亮片，也常比喻光彩夺目的浮华表象，如名利场的诱惑。

lemmas.def_en: having brief brilliant points or flashes of light

examples.en: She wore a glittery silver dress that captured everyone's attention at the party.
examples.zh: 她穿了一条闪亮的银色连衣裙，吸引了派对上所有人的目光。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声兼具形态色彩的词根，模拟光线碎片般闪烁颤动的视觉效果。

lemmas.def_en: believing in or supporting tenets of the political left

examples.en: The newly elected president introduced a series of leftist economic policies.
examples.zh: 新当选的总统推出了一系列左翼经济政策。

lemmas.usage_note: 政治语体形容词，修饰 policy、party 或 ideology，指左翼的、激进主义或社会主义倾向的。

lemmas.def_en: a person who belongs to the political left

examples.en: Prominent leftists gathered at the rally to advocate for expanded labor rights.
examples.zh: 知名左翼人士聚集在集会上，主张扩大劳工权益。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指拥护左翼政治主张的人，常出现在政治分析、新闻报道和选举评论中。

lemmas.def_zh: 左派观点, 在倾行为
lemmas.def_en: the ideology of the political left; belief in or support of the tenets of the political left

examples.en: His radical brand of leftism alienated many moderate voters during the local election.
examples.zh: 在地方选举中，他激进的左派观点使许多温和派选民与他疏远。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自政治术语 left（左派，因法国大革命国民议会坐席而得名）+ -ist（主义者/倾向）。

lemmas.def_en: the style in which hair has been cut
lemmas.def_zh: 理发；发型；（金融）资产减值扣减

examples.en: You look much sharper after getting that new haircut.
examples.zh: 剪了新发型后，你看起来精神多了。

lemmas.usage_note: 表示理发常搭配 get/have a haircut；金融领域特指资产减值或债务折价（take a haircut），不可望文生义。

family_guide.root_logic: 复合词 hair（头发）+ cut（剪），字面指理发，引申可喻指资产减值或削减。

lemmas.def_en: the arrangement of the body and its limbs
lemmas.def_zh: 姿势, 态度, 情形, 形势

examples.en: Poor sitting posture can cause chronic lower back pain.
examples.zh: 不良的坐姿可能会导致慢性腰痛。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指身体的姿势，亦常引申为官方或公众展现的立场与态度，常见搭配如 adopt a defensive posture。

lemmas.def_en: behave affectedly or unnaturally in order to impress others

examples.en: The politician was merely posturing to win over undecided voters.
examples.zh: 这位政客摆出这副姿态，不过是为了拉拢摇摆不定的选民。

lemmas.usage_note: 主要用作不及物动词，指为了给人留下深刻印象或虚张声势而做作地摆姿态，常含贬义色彩。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or involving posture

examples.en: Physical therapy helped him correct the postural problems he developed over several years.
examples.zh: 物理治疗帮助他矫正了多年来养成的姿势问题。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 ponere（放置、摆放），原指身体放置的姿势，引申为态度、姿态。

lemmas.def_en: a period of time containing 365 (or 366) days

examples.en: The contract is valid for a period of 1 yr starting next month.
examples.zh: 该合同自下月起生效，有效期为一年。

lemmas.usage_note: year 的常见非正式缩写，多用于表格、简历（如 3 yrs experience）或即时通讯，正规学术写作忌用。

family_guide.root_logic: 英语单词 year（年）的常用缩写形式。

lemmas.def_en: not based on fact; unreal; - F.D.Roosevelt
lemmas.def_zh: 想象中的，虚构的，假想的

examples.en: As a lonely child, she invented an imaginary companion to talk to.
examples.zh: 小时候很孤独，她便虚构了一个假想同伴来陪伴自己说话。

lemmas.usage_note: 强调凭空虚构、现实中不存在的（如 imaginary friend/line），切勿与 imaginative（富于想象力的）混淆。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自 imagine（想象）+ -ary（形容词后缀），核心指仅存在于头脑想象中、非真实的。
family_guide.core_distinction: imaginary 指虚构的、不存在的；imaginative 指富有想象力的；imaginable 指可以想象得到的。

lemmas.def_en: situated in or oriented toward the northwest

examples.en: The storm is moving steadily toward the northwestern coast of the island.
examples.zh: 风暴正稳步向该岛的西北海岸移动。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于大写指代特定地理区域（如Northwestern University）；描述方位时多作前置定语，不与to连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 方位复合词 northwest（西北）+ -ern（方向后缀），表示西北方向的或特质的。

lemmas.def_en: a male spokesperson

examples.en: A company spokesman declined to comment on the ongoing merger rumors.
examples.zh: 公司发言人拒绝就目前正在流传的并购传闻置评。

lemmas.usage_note: 常搭配spokesman for/of sb/sth；现代正式公文更倾向用中性词spokesperson以避免性别偏见。

family_guide.root_logic: 复合词 spoke（speak 的过去式语义核心：发言）+ -s- + man（人），意为替他人公开发言的人。

lemmas.def_en: a slippery smoothness
lemmas.def_zh: 光滑平面, 平滑器, 修光工具

examples.en: The tanker accident left a massive oil slick spreading across the bay.
examples.zh: 油轮事故导致一大片浮油在海湾中蔓延开来。

lemmas.usage_note: 通常指浮在水面或路面上的薄油层，最为常见且固定的搭配是 oil slick（水面浮油）。

lemmas.def_en: a macintosh made from cotton fabric treated with oil and pigment to make it waterproof
lemmas.def_zh: 防水衣, 雨衣, 骗子

examples.en: He pulled on a bright yellow slicker before heading out into the torrential storm.
examples.zh: 他套上一件亮黄色雨衣，然后走进了倾盆大雨中。

lemmas.def_en: verbal misrepresentation intended to take advantage of you in some way
lemmas.def_zh: 光滑, 巧妙, 花言巧语

examples.en: The salesman's slickness made the cautious buyers doubt the authenticity of his promises.
examples.zh: 销售员的花言巧语让谨慎的买家怀疑其承诺的真实性。

lemmas.def_en: made slick by e.g. ice or grease
lemmas.def_zh: 光滑的, 熟练的, 聪明的, 华而不实的, 老套的, 陈腐的

examples.en: The roads were slick with ice after the sudden freezing rain.
examples.zh: 一场突如其来的冻雨过后，路面结冰变得非常湿滑。

lemmas.usage_note: 可表示表面光滑，亦可形容技术熟练或商业包装精美但缺乏真诚，常用搭配如 slick advertising。

lemmas.def_en: make slick or smooth
lemmas.def_zh: 使光滑, 使漂亮；打扮整洁

examples.en: He slicked his hair back with gel before heading out to the party.
examples.zh: 出门去参加聚会前，他用发胶把头发整齐地梳到了脑后。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，意为使平整光滑，尤指涂抹发胶或油脂将头发向后梳理，常与 down 或 back 连用。

lemmas.def_en: with superficial plausibility

examples.en: The team slickly executed the play, scoring a decisive goal in the final seconds.
examples.zh: 该队精妙地执行了战术，在最后几秒打入了决胜的一球。

family_guide.root_logic: 原意为平滑、油滑，引申为表面光鲜但可能隐藏欺诈，或指水面的浮油。

lemmas.def_en: a person loved by another person
lemmas.def_zh: n. 恋人，心爱的人；好心人

examples.en: She has been his sweetheart since high school.
examples.zh: 她从高中起就是他的恋人了。

lemmas.usage_note: 口语中用作爱人称呼；商业政治中常构成sweetheart deal（私相授受的内部优惠交易），含批判色彩。

family_guide.root_logic: 复合词（sweet + heart），字面为“甜蜜的心”，代指心爱之人。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to a phenomenon
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 非凡的，杰出的；现象的

examples.en: The company has experienced phenomenal growth over the past two years.
examples.zh: 过去两年里，该公司取得了惊人的飞速增长。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用于正式或口语褒义语境，形容成就、增长等极其非凡、卓越，常修饰 growth 或 success。

lemmas.def_en: to a phenomenal degree
lemmas.def_zh: 现象, 从感官认识到, 非凡, 出众

examples.en: The new smartphone proved phenomenally successful, breaking all previous company sales records.
examples.zh: 这款新智能手机取得了惊人的成功，打破了公司以往的所有销售纪录。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自 phenomenon（现象，引申为奇迹），-al 构成的形容词，强调如奇观般非凡的。

lemmas.def_en: worry unnecessarily or excessively
lemmas.def_zh: v. （为小事）烦恼，大惊小怪；瞎忙活

examples.en: Please stop fussing over every little detail; everything will be fine.
examples.zh: 请别再为每一个细节瞎操心了，一切都会好起来的。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用作不及物动词，常与 about 或 over 搭配，表示为微不足道的小事过度担忧、焦虑或瞎忙活。

lemmas.def_en: annoyed and irritable
lemmas.def_zh: 易怒的, 爱挑剔的, 难取悦的, 易烦恼的

examples.en: The fussy toddler refused to eat any vegetables that were green or crunchy.
examples.zh: 这个挑食的幼儿拒绝吃任何绿色或爽脆的蔬菜。

lemmas.def_en: an irritable petulant feeling

examples.en: Her constant fussiness about minor details annoyed her colleagues during the busy project.
examples.zh: 在繁忙的项目中，她对微小细节的不断挑剔惹恼了同事。

lemmas.def_en: in a fussy manner
lemmas.def_zh: 无事空扰地, 小题大做地, 大惊小怪地

examples.en: The clerk fussily rearranged the paperwork on his desk before answering the phone.
examples.zh: 办事员在接电话前，小题大做地重新整理了桌上的文件。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声拟态词，形容为细微琐事而表现出的忙乱与不安。

lemmas.def_en: a professional boxer who weighs between 131 and 135 pounds
lemmas.def_zh: n. 轻量级选手；无足轻重的人

examples.en: Critics dismissed him as a political lightweight.
examples.zh: 批评家们认为他在政治上微不足道。

lemmas.usage_note: 除拳击量级外，多比喻“无足轻重的人或缺乏深度的事物”，含轻微贬义；常作可数名词，用于非正式评论。

family_guide.root_logic: 复合词（light + weight），指轻重量，引申指无足轻重的人或物。

lemmas.def_en: hairpiece covering the head and made of real or synthetic hair

examples.en: The actor wore a curly wig for the period drama.
examples.zh: 为了这部时代剧，演员戴了一顶卷曲的假发。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与动词wear/put on搭配；注意区分日常假发与法官假发；口语俚语wig out表示“极度激动、发疯”。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自 periwig 的截短词，借自法语，指假发。

lemmas.def_en: refer to another person for decision or judgment

examples.en: After a terrible season, the football club was relegated to the second division.
examples.zh: 经历了一个糟糕的赛季后，该足球俱乐部被降级至乙级联赛。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常用于被动语态，后接介词 to，指把某人贬至低位或将球队降级到次级联赛。

lemmas.def_en: authorizing subordinates to make certain decisions
lemmas.def_zh: 驱逐, 调职, 归属

examples.en: The football club faced immediate relegation after losing the crucial final match yesterday.
examples.zh: 在输掉昨天的关键决赛后，这家足球俱乐部面临直接降级。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 re-（回/退）+ legate（派送），原指遣送放逐，引申为降职或降级。

lemmas.def_en: make (images or sounds) soft or softer

examples.en: The government eventually softened its stance on the controversial tax reform.
examples.zh: 政府最终在该项备受争议的税制改革上放软了态度。

lemmas.usage_note: 兼作及物和不及物动词，可指物理变软，亦常用于抽象引申，如软化立场或减弱冲击力（soften the blow）。

lemmas.def_en: a substance added to another to make it less hard
lemmas.def_zh: 软化剂, 硬水软化器

examples.en: Remember to add fabric softener to the rinse cycle to keep towels fluffy.
examples.zh: 记得在漂洗阶段加入织物柔顺剂，以保持毛巾蓬松。

family_guide.root_logic: soft（柔软的）+ -en（使变得），字面即“使柔软/缓和”。

lemmas.def_en: participate in an all-night techno dance party
lemmas.def_zh: v. 热烈赞扬；胡话，狂言

examples.en: Critics could not stop raving about the young director's debut film.
examples.zh: 影评人们对这位年轻导演的处女作赞不绝口。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与 about 连用表示极力赞扬；也可表示因发热或精神失常而语无伦次，常搭配 rave on。

lemmas.def_en: declaiming wildly

examples.en: Nobody paid attention to the wild ravings of the drunkard on the street.
examples.zh: 没有人理会街上那个醉汉发出的疯癫胡话。

lemmas.usage_note: 多以复数形式 ravings 出现，指精神错乱者或极度愤怒时发出的胡言乱语与诳语。

lemmas.def_en: a participant in a rave dancing party
lemmas.def_zh: 说胡话的人, 社交场常客

examples.en: The tired raver finally left the packed dance floor just as dawn broke.
examples.zh: 破晓时分，这位疲惫的派对狂欢者终于离开了拥挤的舞池。

family_guide.root_logic: 可能源自古法语，最初指胡言乱语，引申为极度狂热或极力赞美。
family_guide.core_distinction: rave（胡言狂热/盛赞）与 raving（狂妄言论，多作名词或分词修饰语）。

lemmas.def_en: construct or form anew or provide with a new structure

examples.en: The company had to restructure its debt to avoid bankruptcy.
examples.zh: 该公司不得不重组其债务以避免破产。

lemmas.usage_note: 商业与财经高频词，常用搭配restructure debts（债务重组）或restructure an organization（机构重组）。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 re-（重新）+ structure（构建），指对现有组织或结构进行重大调整。

lemmas.def_en: secure in or as if in a berth or dock
lemmas.def_zh: v. （用缆绳等）系泊，固定（船只）

examples.en: We carefully moored the sailboat to the dock before the storm hit.
examples.zh: 在暴风雨来临前，我们小心地将帆船系泊在码头上。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可用作及物动词（后接船只），亦可用作不及物动词，常与 to 或 at 搭配，指用缆绳靠泊系牢。

lemmas.def_en: a place where a craft can be made fast
lemmas.def_zh: 系泊, 系留, 停泊处, 系船处

examples.en: The captain secured the yacht safely to its mooring before the storm arrived.
examples.zh: 暴风雨来临之前，船长将游艇安全地固定在系泊处。

lemmas.def_en: a fee for mooring
lemmas.def_zh: 停泊, 定泊处, 定泊费

examples.en: The harbor master collected a small fee for overnight moorage at the dock.
examples.zh: 港口管理员在码头收取了一笔小额隔夜停泊费。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语或低地德语，核心动作为用缆绳或锚固定船只。

lemmas.def_en: a hard kind of stone; a form of silica more opaque than chalcedony

examples.en: The survivalist used a piece of flint and steel to start the campfire.
examples.zh: 这位野外生存专家用一块燧石和火钢生起了营火。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数或不可数名词，主要指燧石或打火机火石，常用于 strike a flint 等点火相关搭配。

lemmas.def_en: containing flint
lemmas.def_zh: 燧石的, 含燧石的, 坚硬的, 冷酷的

examples.en: He refused the desperate plea for help with a cold and flinty glare.
examples.zh: 他带着冰冷而坚决的目光，拒绝了那绝望的求助请求。

family_guide.root_logic: 日耳曼语族古词，指质地极其坚硬、撞击可取火的燧石。

lemmas.def_en: a person who takes part in an armed rebellion against the constituted authority (especially in the hope of improving conditions)

examples.en: Government forces successfully repelled the insurgents from the town.
examples.zh: 政府军成功将叛乱分子击退出了该镇。

lemmas.usage_note: 政治与军事正式用语，常指“叛乱分子”；搭配如 armed insurgents，语气较 rebel 更显法制或政权对立色彩。

lemmas.def_en: an organized rebellion aimed at overthrowing a constituted government through the use of subversion and armed conflict
lemmas.def_zh: 叛乱状态, 发生暴动

examples.en: Government troops launched a new offensive to crush the growing armed insurgency.
examples.zh: 政府军发起新一轮攻势，以粉碎日益扩大的武装叛乱。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 in-（进入，向上）+ surgere（升起/涌起），形容暴动、奋起反抗的人。

lemmas.def_en: a passage selected from a larger work

examples.en: She read a brief excerpt from her new novel to the audience.
examples.zh: 她向观众朗读了自己新小说中的一小段摘录。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指从书籍、演讲、音乐等中节选的内容，常搭配 excerpt from。

lemmas.def_en: take out of a literary work in order to cite or copy

examples.en: The short story was excerpted from an upcoming collection of essays.
examples.zh: 这篇短篇故事节选自即将出版的散文集。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常用于被动语态，表示从更长的作品中进行节录、引用，后常接介词 from。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 ex-（出）+ carpere（采摘），字面意为“摘录出来”。
family_guide.core_distinction: excerpt(n.) 指摘抄的内容片段；excerpt(v.) 指摘录这一动作。

lemmas.def_en: exhibiting or caused by radioactivity

examples.en: The facility is designed for the safe disposal of highly radioactive waste.
examples.zh: 该设施旨在安全处置高放射性废料。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰 waste, fallout, isotope 等，用于科技、环保及军事语境，表示具有放射性危险。

lemmas.def_en: not radioactive

examples.en: The laboratory uses nonradioactive tracers to safely study blood flow in the body.
examples.zh: 该实验室使用非放射性示踪剂来安全地研究体内的血液流动。

lemmas.def_en: the spontaneous emission of a stream of particles or electromagnetic rays in nuclear decay

examples.en: Scientists carefully monitored the sudden rise in radioactivity levels near the damaged plant.
examples.zh: 科学家们密切监测着受损电厂附近放射性水平的突然上升。

lemmas.def_en: in a radioactive manner

examples.en: Workers safely isolated the medical waste that had been radioactively contaminated during testing.
examples.zh: 工人们安全隔离了在测试过程中受到放射性污染的医疗废物。

family_guide.root_logic: 复合词（radio-“射线/辐射” + active“活跃的”），即具放射活性的。

lemmas.def_en: a flat cake of thin batter fried on both sides on a griddle

examples.en: She served warm pancakes topped with maple syrup for breakfast.
examples.zh: 她端出淋有枫糖浆的热薄煎饼作为早餐。

lemmas.usage_note: 日常口语常用短语 as flat as a pancake（极其平坦）；作动词时常形容飞机“迫降、平跌”，避免误作一般面饼统称。

family_guide.root_logic: 复合词（pan“平底锅” + cake“饼/糕”），指在锅里摊出的薄饼。

lemmas.def_en: an address of a religious nature (usually delivered during a church service)

examples.en: The vicar delivered a powerful sermon on the importance of forgiveness.
examples.zh: 牧师作了一次关于宽恕的重要性的有力布道。

lemmas.usage_note: 宗教上搭配 preach/deliver a sermon；日常引申为口语中烦人的“说教”，搭配多用 give sb a sermon。

family_guide.root_logic: 来自拉丁语 sermo（谈话、演讲），在宗教语境中专指教会讲道，引申为道德说教。

lemmas.def_en: claim back
lemmas.def_zh: v. 开垦；回收；要求归还

examples.en: The city plans to reclaim industrial wasteland and turn it into a public park.
examples.zh: 该市计划开垦这片工业废弃地，并将其改造成公园。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常接 land, property, right，常与 from 连用，指收回所有权或开垦荒地。

lemmas.def_en: the conversion of wasteland into land suitable for use of habitation or cultivation

examples.en: Land reclamation projects have significantly expanded the city's coastline.
examples.zh: 填海造地工程大幅扩大了该市的海岸线。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词为主，常与 land, resource 搭配，用于指土地开垦、资源回收利用或感化教育。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 回收利用的；开垦的
lemmas.def_en: recovered from waste or a wild state so as to be made suitable for use
lemmas.usage_note: 现代英语中极常修饰材料或土地，如 reclaimed wood（回收木材）、reclaimed land（填海/开垦土地）。提示中'delivered from danger'为罕见古义。

examples.en: The dining table is made entirely of reclaimed barn wood.
examples.zh: 这张餐桌完全是由谷仓回收的旧木料制成的。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 re-（回）+ claim（呼喊、要求），核心逻辑是“要求收回原本属于自己的事物”。

lemmas.def_en: supply with water, as with channels or ditches or streams

examples.en: Water from the river is diverted to irrigate miles of parched farmland.
examples.zh: 河水被引流去灌溉数英里干涸的农田。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，接 farmland/crops 表示农田灌溉；在医学语境中接 wound 指冲洗消毒伤口。

lemmas.def_en: supplying dry land with water by means of ditches etc

examples.en: Modern irrigation systems help farmers conserve water during severe droughts.
examples.zh: 现代灌溉系统有助于农民在严重干旱期间节约用水。

lemmas.usage_note: 主要作不可数名词，常与 system, ditch, channel 搭配，广泛用于农业水利与医学清洗中。

family_guide.root_logic: 来自拉丁语 in-（进入）+ rigare（浇水、湿润），指引水灌溉土地或冲洗伤口。
family_guide.core_distinction: irrigate 为动词“灌溉”，irrigation 为名词“灌溉”。

lemmas.def_en: the ordering of genes in a haploid set of chromosomes of a particular organism; the full DNA sequence of an organism

examples.en: Scientists have successfully mapped the entire human genome.
examples.zh: 科学家们已经成功绘制出了完整的人类基因组图谱。

lemmas.usage_note: 专业学术与科普高频词，核心搭配 the human genome（人类基因组）、genome sequencing（全基因组测序）。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 gene（基因）与 chromosome（染色体）嵌合而成，指生物体的全套遗传物质。

lemmas.def_en: kick the ball
lemmas.def_zh: v. 撑篙；凌空踢球；碰运气

examples.en: They decided to take a punt on the young, untested director for their new film.
examples.zh: 他们决定在新电影上冒险碰碰运气，起用这位未经考验的年轻导演。

lemmas.usage_note: 作动词既指乘平底船撑篙，也可指球类凌空踢球，口语中常与 on 搭配表示在某事上碰运气。

lemmas.def_en: someone who propels a boat with a pole
lemmas.def_zh: 用篙撑船的人, 船夫, 赌博者

examples.en: A lucky punter walked away with thousands after betting on the rank outsider.
examples.zh: 一名幸运的赌徒在押中了冷门马后赢走了数千元。

family_guide.root_logic: 本义指用长篙撑平底船，后在球类运动中引申为“凌空踢球”，俗语中亦指“碰运气/下赌注”。

lemmas.def_en: plants with sword-shaped leaves and erect stalks bearing bright-colored flowers composed of three petals and three drooping sepals

examples.en: Her irises contracted as she stepped out into the bright sunlight.
examples.zh: 当她迈步走进明亮的阳光下时，瞳孔周围的虹膜收缩了。

lemmas.usage_note: 可指眼球的“虹膜”（常搭配 iris recognition/scan 虹膜识别），亦可指花卉“鸢尾花”；语境差异极大需注意辨析。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊神话中的彩虹女神 Iris，因色彩斑斓而指代眼球的“虹膜”及花卉“鸢尾花”。

lemmas.def_en: having great beauty and splendor
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 极好的；壮丽的，辉煌的

examples.en: We watched the sunset from the cliff, enjoying a truly splendid panoramic view.
examples.zh: 我们在悬崖边看日落，欣赏着真正壮丽的全景。

lemmas.usage_note: 可作定语或表语，英式英语口语中常用于赞美事物极好，书面语中多描绘景色或成就的辉煌。

lemmas.def_en: extremely well
lemmas.def_zh: 壮丽地; 豪华地; 极好地; 了不起地

examples.en: The entire orchestra performed splendidly throughout the challenging final movement of the symphony.
examples.zh: 在整首交响乐充满挑战的末乐章中，整个管弦乐团表现得极其出色。
