family_guide.root_logic: 来自拉丁语 splendere（发光、照耀），核心语义为“光彩夺目的”，引申为极好的、壮丽的。

lemmas.def_en: marked by or showing unaffected simplicity and lack of guile or worldly experience
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 天真的，幼稚的；缺乏经验的

examples.en: It was naive of him to believe that everyone in the market would play fair.
examples.zh: 他天真地以为市场上的每个人都会公平竞争，真是太幼稚了。

lemmas.usage_note: 作表语或定语，常接 to do 或 that 从句，多含贬义或轻微批评，指缺乏社会经验易受欺骗。

lemmas.def_en: in a naive manner

examples.en: She naively believed that everyone in the competitive business world was entirely honest.
examples.zh: 她天真地以为竞争激烈的商业世界里每个人都是完全诚实的。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自法语（与 native 同源，意为天生的、质朴的），现多指缺乏世故经验而显得幼稚或轻信。

lemmas.def_en: Venetian traveler who explored Asia in the 13th century and served Kublai Khan (1254-1324)

examples.en: He spent the weekend playing polo with his college friends.
examples.zh: 他周末和大学朋友们一起打了马球。

lemmas.usage_note: 指马球运动，不可数；常构成复合词如 polo shirt（Polo衫）或 water polo（水球运动）。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自藏语 polo（球），专指骑马击球的“马球”运动，也代指源自此运动的开领短袖衫。

lemmas.def_en: understanding and entering into another's feelings

examples.en: Good managers show empathy for their employees during challenging personal times.
examples.zh: 优秀的管理者在员工遭遇个人困境时会表现出同理心。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，常与 have, feel, show 连用，后接介词 with 或 for，指设身处地理解他人的能力。

lemmas.def_en: be understanding of

examples.en: A good counselor must genuinely empathize with the struggles of their patients.
examples.zh: 一位优秀的心理咨询师必须能够真正同情并理解患者的痛苦。

lemmas.def_zh: 移情作用的；同感的（等于empathic）
lemmas.def_en: showing empathy or ready comprehension of others' states

examples.en: A good counselor must be empathetic and listen to patients without judging.
examples.zh: 优秀的咨询师必须富有同理心，并在不作评判的情况下倾听患者的心声。

lemmas.def_zh: 感情移入地, 移情地
lemmas.def_en: in a sympathetic manner

examples.en: she listened to him sympathetically

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 em-（进入）+ pathy（感受、感情），字面即“感同身受”，强调体验并理解他人痛苦的能力。

lemmas.def_en: reproducer in which two microphones feed two or more loudspeakers to give a three-dimensional effect to the sound
lemmas.def_zh: n. 立体声音响；立体声系统

examples.en: He turned up the stereo and began to dance around the living room.
examples.zh: 他调大立体声音响的音量，在客厅里跳起舞来。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于介词短语 in stereo（以立体声形式），作名词指立体声音响设备，如 a stereo system。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 stereos（立体的、坚固的），现代多指通过双声道还原空间感的立体声音响设备。

lemmas.def_en: marked by sudden changes in subject and sharp transitions
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 突然的，意外的；生硬唐突的

examples.en: The meeting came to an abrupt end when the fire alarm began to ring.
examples.zh: 火警警报响起时，会议戛然而止。

lemmas.usage_note: 修饰 end, change, departure 指突然且出人意料的转变；修饰 manner, reply 指态度生硬唐突。

lemmas.def_en: quickly and without warning

examples.en: The vehicle stopped abruptly, causing all the passengers to lurch forward.
examples.zh: 车辆猛地停住，导致所有乘客都往前猛冲。

lemmas.usage_note: 副词，常修饰 stop, leave, halt, turn 等动词，强调行为或事态发生得极其仓促、毫无预兆。

lemmas.def_en: an abrupt discourteous manner

examples.en: The abruptness of his sudden resignation shocked all of his colleagues at work.
examples.zh: 他突然辞职的唐突举动震惊了所有的职场同事。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 ab-（离开）+ rupt（破裂、断开），形容事情像猛然折断一样突如其来或言行生硬唐突。
family_guide.core_distinction: abrupt 为形容词，abruptly 为副词。

lemmas.def_en: no longer active; extinguished

examples.en: Deforestation has driven several rare bird species to the verge of extinction.
examples.zh: 滥砍滥伐已使几种稀有鸟类濒临灭绝的边缘。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与 face, avoid, drive to 搭配，高频短语为 on the brink/verge of extinction（濒临灭绝）。

lemmas.def_zh: 熄灭者, 灭火器, 消灭者
lemmas.def_en: a manually operated device for extinguishing small fires

lemmas.def_zh: 熄灭, 使消亡, 压制, 使减色
lemmas.def_en: put an end to; kill

examples.en: Firefighters worked for several hours to extinguish the blaze in the warehouse.
examples.zh: 消防员奋战了数小时才将仓库的大火扑灭。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，具体指扑灭火焰（flame/fire）；抽象引申为压制希望、欲望或彻底消灭某事物。

family_guide.root_logic: 来自拉丁语 ex-（出）+ stinguere（熄灭、刺），核心语义为生命火种的彻底“熄灭”。

lemmas.def_en: a thick sweet sticky liquid

examples.en: She poured sweet maple syrup over her freshly baked pancakes.
examples.zh: 她将甜甜的枫糖浆浇在刚出炉的煎饼上。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，常见搭配有 maple syrup（枫糖浆）和 cough syrup（止咳糖浆），泛指浓稠甜液。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自阿拉伯语 sharab（饮料），指通过浓缩熬制而成的浓稠含糖液体。

lemmas.def_en: small rounded bread either plain or sweet

examples.en: She tied her long brown hair back into a neat bun.
examples.zh: 她把棕色长发在脑后挽成了一个整洁的圆发髻。

lemmas.usage_note: 可指小圆面包（如 hamburger bun），也指盘在脑后的“发髻”，常见搭配为 wear one's hair in a bun。

family_guide.root_logic: 词源不详，可能与古法语或古诺斯语中的“肿块”有关，现指特定的小型圆面包或发髻。

lemmas.def_en: a person who does not talk
lemmas.def_zh: 傀儡, 假人, 仿制品

examples.en: Engineers placed a crash-test dummy in the driver's seat to measure impact forces.
examples.zh: 工程师在驾驶座上放置了一个碰撞测试假人，以测量撞击力。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指橱窗人体模型（mannequin）、测试假人、仿制品或受人操纵的傀儡；英式亦指奶嘴。

lemmas.def_en: make a dummy of

examples.en: The striker dummied to shoot with his right foot but quickly passed to his left.
examples.zh: 前锋假装用右脚射门，却迅速将球传向了左侧。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于体育术语，指做假动作晃过对手；商业设计中指制作样品雏形（常与 up 搭配）。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自哑巴、沉默，引申指不会说话的人体模型、替身或假物件。

lemmas.def_en: a sizeable hole (usually in the ground)

examples.en: The dentist discovered a small cavity in his molar during the routine checkup.
examples.zh: 牙医在例行检查中发现他的臼齿上有一个小龋洞。

lemmas.usage_note: 医学上指身体空腔（如 abdominal cavity），日常口语中多特指“蛀牙/龋齿”，如 have a cavity filled。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 cavus（空的），表示内部凹陷、空洞的结构。

lemmas.def_en: any loose flowing garment
lemmas.def_zh: 宽松长袍, 礼服, 披肩, 覆盖物

examples.en: The judge adjusted his black robe before stepping into the courtroom to deliver the final verdict.
examples.zh: 法官在步入法庭宣读最终判决前，整理了一下自己的黑色长袍。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指仪式性长袍、法官袍或宽松浴袍；常与 wear、don、ceremonial 连用，用于正式或居家语境。

lemmas.def_en: take something away by force or without the consent of the owner
lemmas.def_zh: 抢夺, 抢掠, 剥夺

examples.en: The sudden injury robbed the young athlete of his chance to compete in the Olympics.
examples.zh: 突如其来的伤病剥夺了这位年轻运动员参加奥运会的机会。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，核心句型为 rob sb./sth. of sth.，可指暴力抢劫财物，也可引申为剥夺权利或机会。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自日耳曼语经古法语借入，原指战利品、衣服（rob 与 robe 同源，原指剥夺衣服/财物）。
family_guide.core_distinction: robe 指长袍或穿长袍；rob 为动词，指抢劫，两者拼写相近但词义已分化。

lemmas.def_en: a mechanical damper; absorbs energy of sudden impulses

examples.en: Having ample emergency savings provides a vital financial cushion against unexpected unemployment.
examples.zh: 拥有充裕的应急储蓄能为应对突如其来的失业提供至关重要的财务缓冲。

lemmas.usage_note: 指靠垫、座垫，或比喻起缓解、缓冲作用的事物；常与 provide a cushion against 连用。

lemmas.def_en: protect from impact
lemmas.def_zh: 加垫褥, 缓冲, 掩盖

examples.en: The government introduced temporary subsidies to cushion low-income households against rising energy costs.
examples.zh: 政府出台了临时补贴措施，以缓解能源价格上涨对低收入家庭的冲击。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常与 from/against 搭配，表示减缓撞击力，或在抽象语境中减轻不良影响、损失。

lemmas.def_en: softened by the addition of cushions or padding

examples.en: The hotel lobby featured deep, cushiony chairs that were extraordinarily comfortable to sit in.
examples.zh: 酒店大堂摆放着坐感极为舒适的厚实柔软的椅子。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语，指软垫，引申出减震、缓冲的核心动作与功能。

lemmas.def_en: an indication of radiant light drawn around the head of a saint
lemmas.def_zh: 晕轮, 光圈, 晕状物, 荣光

examples.en: Streetlights on the foggy bridge were surrounded by a strange, glowing yellow halo.
examples.zh: 大雾笼罩的桥上，路灯周围环绕着一圈奇异发光的黄色光晕。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于心理学 halo effect（光环效应），描写宗教绘画或月晕时也高频，搭配 wear/have a halo。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 halos（圆盘、光环），特指日月周围的光晕或神像头顶的光环。

lemmas.def_en: get the meaning of something
lemmas.def_zh: 理解, 忧虑, 逮捕；担心, 理解

examples.en: Local authorities managed to apprehend the suspect within hours of the security breach.
examples.zh: 当地警方在发生安全事件后的数小时内便成功逮捕了嫌疑人。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式用语，主要用于警方逮捕案犯（及物），较少指深刻理解或对未来感到担忧。

lemmas.def_en: interpret in the wrong way

examples.en: It is easy to misapprehend his dry humor as genuine rudeness.
examples.zh: 人们很容易把他冷幽默的风格误解为真正的无礼。

lemmas.def_en: fearful expectation or anticipation
lemmas.def_zh: 理解, 忧惧, 逮捕

examples.en: She faced her first job interview with a deep sense of apprehension.
examples.zh: 面对人生的第一次求职面试，她心中充满了忧虑。

lemmas.def_en: an understanding of something that is not correct

examples.en: I was under the misapprehension that the deadline had already passed yesterday.
examples.zh: 我之前误以为截止日期昨天就已经过了。

lemmas.def_en: fearful expectation or anticipation

examples.en: His constant apprehensiveness about the future prevented him from enjoying the present.
examples.zh: 他对未来的持续担忧让他无法享受当下。

lemmas.def_en: quick to understand; - Nathaniel Hawthorne
lemmas.def_zh: 惴惴不安的, 敏悟的, 知晓的

examples.en: Many investors felt apprehensive about the sudden volatility in the stock market.
examples.zh: 许多投资者对股市的突然波动感到惴惴不安。

lemmas.def_en: with anxiety or apprehension

examples.en: The child looked apprehensively at the dentist as the drill started humming.
examples.zh: 牙钻嗡嗡作响时，孩子忧心忡忡地看着牙医。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 ad-（去）+ prehendere（抓住），引申为肉体上“逮捕”或认知上“领会/担忧”。

lemmas.def_en: a document attesting to the truth of certain stated facts
lemmas.def_zh: 国书, 凭据, 证明书

examples.en: Her extensive medical research serves as her strongest credential for the post.
examples.zh: 广泛的医学研究经历是她竞聘该职位的最有力资历证明。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用复数 credentials 表示“资历、凭证”，常搭 examine/present/establish credentials for/in。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 credere（相信），表示让人产生信任的凭证、资格证明。

lemmas.def_en: move smoothly and effortlessly
lemmas.def_zh: 滑动, 滑翔, 溜走, 流逝；使滑动

examples.en: The swans glided effortlessly across the calm surface of the lake at dawn.
examples.zh: 拂晓时分，天鹅在平静的湖面上轻盈地滑行。

lemmas.usage_note: 作不及物动词居多，描述平稳、安静且省力地滑动、滑翔，常与 across、over、through 连用。

lemmas.def_en: aircraft supported only by the dynamic action of air against its surfaces

examples.en: The silent glider soared above the mountains riding invisible thermal air currents.
examples.zh: 这架无声的滑翔机乘着无形的热气流在山峰上空翱翔。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 glidan，本义为平滑、无声且省力地移动。

lemmas.def_en: a vote that blocks a decision

examples.en: The president decided to exercise his veto against the proposed environmental legislation.
examples.zh: 总统决定行使否决权，驳回这项拟议的环保法案。

lemmas.usage_note: 指法定否决权或一票否决的行为；常与 exercise/use one's veto 或 have a veto over 搭配。

lemmas.def_en: vote against; refuse to endorse; refuse to assent

examples.en: The board of directors firmly vetoed the merger proposal due to excessive financial risks.
examples.zh: 鉴于巨大的财务风险，董事会坚决否决了这项并购提议。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指行使否决权拒绝法案，或日常中断然拒绝、禁止某项计划、提议。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 veto（我禁止），现多用作法定否决权及行使否决。

lemmas.def_en: a roll of tobacco for smoking

examples.en: The old gentleman lit an expensive cigar after finishing his evening dinner.
examples.zh: 老绅士吃完晚餐后点燃了一支昂贵的雪茄。

lemmas.usage_note: 指雪茄，区别于 cigarette（香烟）；常用搭配 light/smoke a cigar；习语 close, but no cigar（差一点就成功）。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自玛雅语 sik'ar（抽烟），经西班牙语 cigarro 传入，指纯烟叶卷制的大雪茄。

lemmas.def_en: shout, as if with joy or enthusiasm
lemmas.def_zh: 叫喊, 鸣叫；高声说, 唤起

examples.en: The supporters whooped with joy as the referee blew the final whistle, signaling their team's victory.
examples.zh: 当裁判吹响终场哨示意主队获胜时，支持者们兴奋地欢呼起来。

lemmas.usage_note: 多作不及物动词，指因兴奋、胜利而高声欢呼；常用搭配为 whoop with joy/delight。

lemmas.def_en: rare North American crane having black-and-white plumage and a trumpeting call
lemmas.def_zh: 高喊者, 呐喊者, 咳嗽者

examples.en: A majestic whooper swan rested peacefully near the icy edge of the lake.
examples.zh: 一只雄伟的大天鹅在湖边结冰的角落平静地歇息。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声词，模仿兴奋、胜利时发出的大叫声。

lemmas.def_en: move or draw apart

examples.en: Although they started with the same goal, their opinions began to diverge sharply during negotiations.
examples.zh: 尽管最初目标一致，但他们的观点在谈判过程中开始出现严重分歧。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作不及物动词，后接介词 from，描述道路分岔，或观点、利益、发展路径出现分歧和差异。

lemmas.def_en: diverging from another or from a standard

examples.en: The two economists held divergent views on the long-term impact of inflation.
examples.zh: 两位经济学家对通胀的长期影响持有截然不同的观点。

lemmas.def_en: the act of moving away in different direction from a common point

examples.en: There is a notable divergence between his public statements and private actions.
examples.zh: 他的公开声明与私下行动之间存在显著的分歧与出入。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 dis-（分开）+ vergere（倾向、倾斜），表示从同一处向不同方向分岔延伸。

lemmas.def_en: a decorative paper for the walls of rooms

examples.en: They selected a subtle floral wallpaper to bring warmth and texture to the living room.
examples.zh: 他们选了一款淡雅的花卉壁纸，为客厅增添了温馨感与质感。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，指糊墙纸或电脑手机桌面壁纸；常与 strip、hang、choose 等动词搭配。

lemmas.def_en: cover with wallpaper

examples.en: We spent the entire weekend wallpapering the spare bedroom before the guests arrived.
examples.zh: 我们赶在客人到来之前，花了一整个周末给客房贴壁纸。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指给墙面贴壁纸；常引申为 wallpaper over 表示粉饰、掩盖内部深层矛盾或缺陷。

family_guide.root_logic: 复合词 wall（墙）+ paper（纸），本义指墙纸，后引申为贴墙纸的动作及电脑桌面背景。

lemmas.def_en: administer or bestow, as in small portions
lemmas.def_zh: 分发, 分配；特许, 豁免

examples.en: Under the new policy, the hospital pharmacy must safely dispense prescription medications to outpatients.
examples.zh: 根据新规，医院药房必须安全地向门诊患者发放处方药物。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物时指配药、分发或施予；若与 with 连用（dispense with），意为摒弃、省去或不再需要。

lemmas.def_zh: (尤指医院的)药房, 诊疗所
lemmas.def_en: clinic where medicine and medical supplies are dispensed

examples.en: The injured worker was immediately escorted to the factory dispensary for preliminary treatment.
examples.zh: 受伤的工人被立即护送到工厂诊疗所接受初步处理。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指诊所、学校或营地内的配药室、诊疗所；属于较正式的医疗场所用词。

lemmas.def_en: a container so designed that the contents can be used in prescribed amounts
lemmas.def_zh: 分配者, 药剂师, 配药员, 分配器

examples.en: Please place an automatic soap dispenser next to every public restroom sink.
examples.zh: 请在每个公共洗手间的水槽旁放一个自动给皂机。

lemmas.def_en: an exemption from some rule or obligation
lemmas.def_zh: 分配, 施与, (义务的)免除

examples.en: The athlete received a special dispensation to compete despite the late registration.
examples.zh: 尽管报名逾期，这名运动员仍获得了参赛的特许豁免。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 dis-（分开）+ pendere（称重、支付），本义为按份称量分发，引申为配发、免除。

lemmas.def_en: an appreciable consequence (especially a lessening)

examples.en: A stray baseball left a noticeable dent on the driver's side door of my car.
examples.zh: 一颗飞来的棒球在我汽车的驾驶座车门上留下了一个明显的凹痕。

lemmas.usage_note: 指受撞击凹下的压痕；常用搭配 make a dent in 表示削减、减少某物的数量或取得初步进展。

lemmas.def_en: make a depression into

examples.en: Failing the qualification exam severely dented his confidence in pursuing a legal career.
examples.zh: 资格考试失利严重打击了他从事法律职业的信心。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，既指物理上使某物凹陷，也广泛比喻削弱、损害自信心、声誉或自尊心。

family_guide.root_logic: 与 dink（击中）同源，原指用力敲击留下的印记，现特指表面被撞出的凹痕。

lemmas.def_en: not suitable or right or appropriate
lemmas.def_zh: 不合规的；不恰当的；不正当的

examples.en: The committee launched an investigation into the improper use of public funds.
examples.zh: 委员会对公款的不当使用展开了调查。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰 conduct、use 或 behavior，多用于正式语境指违反法律、行规或公序良俗的行为。

lemmas.def_en: in an improper way

examples.en: The machine malfunctioned because the software had been improperly installed by the technician.
examples.zh: 由于技术人员安装不当，机器发生了故障。

family_guide.root_logic: 否定前缀 im- 加上 proper（恰当的），表示不合规矩、不恰当。

lemmas.def_en: an incidental benefit awarded for certain types of employment (especially if it is regarded as a right)

examples.en: A company car and private healthcare are standard perks of this executive position.
examples.zh: 配备公司用车和私人医疗保险是这一高管职位的常规福利。

lemmas.usage_note: 作可数名词，常以复数 perks 出现，主要指工作待遇中除工资外的额外津贴、福利或特权。

lemmas.def_en: gain or regain energy
lemmas.def_zh: 昂首, 振作, 举止高傲, 神气活现, 滤煮；竖起, 打扮, 使振作, 滤煮

examples.en: A cup of strong black coffee helped him perk up after a sleepless night.
examples.zh: 彻夜未眠后，一杯浓黑咖啡帮他振作了精神。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与 up 连用构成 perk up，意为“振作精神”或“活跃起来”，多用于日常口语及非正式语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 核心动作指“昂首、挺起”，引申出精神振作或职位附带的额外好处。

lemmas.def_en: turn red, as if in embarrassment or shame
lemmas.def_zh: 脸红, 羞愧；弄成红色

examples.en: She couldn't help but blush when the teacher praised her in front of the whole class.
examples.zh: 当老师在全班面前表扬她时，她忍不住脸红了。

lemmas.usage_note: 是不及物动词，常与介词 with（因某种情绪）或 at（因某事）搭配，表因害羞、尴尬而面红。

lemmas.def_en: yellowish edible agaric that usually turns red when touched
lemmas.def_zh: 脸红的人,使脸色红润的化妆品

examples.en: She applied a light sweep of pink blusher to brighten her tired face.
examples.zh: 她轻轻扫了一层粉色腮红，以提亮疲惫的面容。

lemmas.def_en: feeling no shame
lemmas.def_zh: 不脸红的, 脸皮厚的, 不知耻的

examples.en: The politician delivered an unblushing lie despite knowing that the cameras were rolling.
examples.zh: 这位政客在明知镜头正在录制的情况下，依然厚颜无耻地撒谎。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声及日耳曼语源，指脸部因害羞或激动而泛起红晕。

lemmas.def_en: flesh of any of several primarily freshwater game and food fishes

examples.en: The mountain stream is teeming with wild trout.
examples.zh: 那条山间小溪里到处都是野生鳟鱼。

lemmas.usage_note: 指‘鳟鱼’，单复数同形（a trout / two trout），常见搭配有 rainbow trout（虹鳟）及 catch trout。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古希腊语“啃咬者”，特指冷水淡水或海水中生活的鲑科鱼类。

lemmas.def_en: the ending of a series or sequence; --Revelation
lemmas.def_zh: 希腊字母的最后一个字母；终结

examples.en: He declared himself the alpha and the omega of the project.
examples.zh: 他宣称自己是该项目的始与终。

lemmas.usage_note: 希腊字母末字，常与 alpha 连用构成 alpha and omega（始终/核心）；日常多用于营养学术语 omega-3 fatty acids。

family_guide.root_logic: 希腊字母表最后一个字母（大写 Ω，小写 ω），象征终结、极限。

lemmas.def_en: the marked and rapid transformation of a larva into an adult that occurs in some animals

examples.en: Regular aerobic exercise can help speed up your resting metabolism.
examples.zh: 规律的有氧运动有助于加快你的静息新陈代谢。

lemmas.usage_note: 作不可数或可数名词，常与 fast、slow、boost 等搭配，多用于医学、健身和日常健康语境。

lemmas.def_zh: 变化的, 变形的, 新陈代谢的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to metabolism

examples.en: Thyroid hormones play a crucial role in regulating the body's metabolic rate.
examples.zh: 甲状腺激素在调节机体代谢率方面起着至关重要的作用。

lemmas.usage_note: 前置定语，修饰 rate、process、disorder 等，属于生物化学和临床医学的高频正式用语。

lemmas.def_en: involving metabolism

examples.en: metabolically important substances

lemmas.def_zh: 使物质交替, 使新陈代谢, 使变形
lemmas.def_en: produce by metabolism

examples.en: The human body needs adequate water to metabolize food and burn calories effectively.
examples.zh: 人体需要充足的水分来有效地代谢食物和燃烧热量。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 meta-（改变）加上希腊词根 bol-（抛掷、变化），指生物体内物质转化与能量代谢。

lemmas.def_en: ranking above all others
lemmas.def_zh: 最重要的；最著名的；首先

examples.en: She is widely regarded as the foremost authority on medieval history.
examples.zh: 她被广泛认为是中世纪历史领域最顶尖的权威。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式书面语，常前置作定语指‘最杰出的’；最高频搭配为固定成语 first and foremost（首要的是/首先）。

family_guide.root_logic: fore（前）加上最高级后缀 -most，意为“在最前面的”，指地位或时间上的首要。

lemmas.def_en: of or from or pertaining to or characteristic of the cosmos or universe

examples.en: Scientists are studying cosmic rays to understand the origins of the early universe.
examples.zh: 科学家们正在研究宇宙射线以了解早期宇宙的起源。

lemmas.usage_note: 多作定语，可修饰 ray、dust（天文语境），亦可修饰 scale、significance（比喻“极其重大的”）。

lemmas.def_zh: 宇宙, 秩序, 和谐, 大波斯菊
lemmas.def_en: everything that exists anywhere

examples.en: Ancient philosophers believed that the human soul was a reflection of the orderly cosmos.
examples.zh: 古代哲学家认为人类心灵是井然有序之宇宙的缩影。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与定冠词 the 连用，特指井然有序的宇宙整体；属于带有哲学、文学或天文学色彩的庄重词汇。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 cosmos（宇宙、秩序），描述与宇宙宏观规律或尺度相关的事物。

examples.en: They signed an agreement wherein both parties committed to peace.
examples.zh: 他们签署了一项协议，双方在其中承诺维护和平。

lemmas.usage_note: 极为正式的书面语或法律用语，相当于 in which，常引导从句表示‘在其中/在那一点上’，日常口语中应避免使用。

family_guide.root_logic: 复合副词，由 where 与 in 构成，意为“在其中，在哪个方面”。

lemmas.def_en: the friction between a body and the surface on which it moves (as between an automobile tire and the road)
lemmas.def_zh: 拉力；抓地力；（产品、概念等的）支持度/势头

examples.en: The new policy is finally beginning to gain traction among voters.
examples.zh: 这项新政策终于开始在选民中获得支持与势头。

lemmas.usage_note: 物理上指附着力（lose traction）；商业及媒体中极高频引申为‘吸引力/进展’，常搭配 gain/get traction。

family_guide.root_logic: 词根 tract-（拉、拖）加上名词后缀 -ion，指拖拉之力或轮胎与地面的附着抓地力。

lemmas.def_en: a county in southwestern England on the Bristol Channel

examples.en: The acrobat performed a breathtaking somerset high above the crowd.
examples.zh: 杂技演员在观众上方高处做了一个令人惊叹的空翻。

lemmas.usage_note: 即 somersault 的古旧或变体拼写，指‘翻筋斗/空翻’，现罕见，现代英语写作建议直接使用 somersault。

family_guide.root_logic: 古英语词源，即“空翻”（通常拼作 somersault），源自苏黎世法语层级的“跳跃翻转”。

lemmas.def_en: be relevant to

examples.en: Please provide all documents that pertain to the financial transactions under review.
examples.zh: 请提供与正在审查的财务交易相关的所有文件。

lemmas.usage_note: 固定与介词 to 搭配为 pertain to，用于法律、学术等正式文体，表示“与……相关”或“从属于”。

lemmas.def_zh: 相关的, 中肯的, 切题的
lemmas.def_en: having precise or logical relevance to the matter at hand

examples.en: The witness provided pertinent information that helped the police crack the case.
examples.zh: 目击者提供了有助于警方破案的切题信息。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作定语或表语，搭配 pertinent to，意为“切题的、相关的”，多见于正式讨论、法律及学术语境。

lemmas.def_en: in a pertinent way

examples.en: what is singular about his use of them is that no other artist, of his time or any other, has painted them so directly, intimately and pertinently

lemmas.def_en: relevance by virtue of being applicable to the matter at hand

examples.en: The judge questioned the pertinence of the evidence to the ongoing trial.
examples.zh: 法官质疑该证据与正在审理的案件之间的关联性。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 per-（完全）加上 -tain（保持、持有），指事物在逻辑或从属关系上紧密“相关”。

lemmas.def_en: a murderer (especially one who kills a prominent political figure) who kills by a surprise attack and often is hired to do the deed

examples.en: The soprano was greeted with loud bravos and a standing ovation at the end of the opera.
examples.zh: 歌剧结束时，这位女高音受到了响亮的喝彩声和全场起立鼓掌。

lemmas.usage_note: 可指剧场中的喝彩声，也可指受雇的亡命刺客；作喝彩声时多用复数 bravos，语体较古典典雅。

lemmas.def_en: applaud with shouts of `bravo' or `brava'

examples.en: The audience clapped and bravoed enthusiastically as the curtain fell.
examples.zh: 当大幕落下时，观众热烈地鼓掌并大声喝彩。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物或不及物动词，意为“向……喝彩、高呼好极了”，多见于文学描写演出反响的语境中。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自意大利语 bravo（勇敢的、出色的），既作喝彩赞词，也作喝彩动作。

lemmas.def_en: a deliberate act of destruction or disruption in which equipment is damaged
lemmas.def_zh: 怠工, 破坏活动, 破坏

examples.en: The explosion at the power plant was suspected to be an act of deliberate sabotage.
examples.zh: 发电厂的爆炸被怀疑是一起蓄意破坏行为。

lemmas.usage_note: 作不可数名词，常与 act of、commit 搭配，多用于军事战争、政治斗争及商业蓄意破坏语境。

lemmas.def_en: destroy property or hinder normal operations
lemmas.def_zh: 从事破坏活动；妨害, 破坏

examples.en: Fear of failure can subconsciously lead people to sabotage their own success.
examples.zh: 对失败的恐惧可能在潜意识中促使人们破坏自己的成功。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，宾语常为 efforts、chances、plan 等抽象名词，用于表达暗中蓄意破坏阻挠。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自法语 sabot（木鞋），原指用木鞋破坏机器，引申为暗中破坏

lemmas.def_en: prevent the occurrence of; prevent from happening

examples.en: The politician tried to deflect criticism by shifting the blame onto his opponent.
examples.zh: 这位政客试图通过将责任推给对手来转移人们的批评。

lemmas.usage_note: 可及物或不及物；常接 bullet、ball（物理偏转），或接 criticism、attention（转移话题/批评）。

lemmas.def_en: a twist or aberration; especially a perverse or abnormal way of judging or acting

examples.en: The soccer ball found the net after a lucky deflection off a defender.
examples.zh: 足球击中一名防守球员发生偏转后，幸运地钻入了球网。

lemmas.def_en: a device intended to turn aside the flow of something (water or air or smoke etc)

examples.en: The technician adjusted the wind deflector on the roof to reduce drag.
examples.zh: 技术员调整了车顶上的导流板以减少阻力。

lemmas.def_en: capable of changing the direction (of a light or sound wave)
lemmas.def_zh: 偏倚的, 偏斜的, 歪斜的

examples.en: The spacecraft was equipped with a deflective shield to repel tiny space particles.
examples.zh: 该航天器配备了偏转防护罩，以抵御微小的太空微粒。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 de-（偏离）+ flect（弯曲），字面指“使弯曲偏转”

lemmas.def_en: hold spellbound

examples.en: The foreign tourists were completely enchanted by the ancient town's picturesque scenery.
examples.zh: 外国游客们完全被这座古镇如画的风光迷住了。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常用于被动语态 be enchanted by/with，表示被某人或景物的魅力深深吸引或迷住。

lemmas.def_en: a feeling of great liking for something wonderful and unusual
lemmas.def_zh: 魔法, 妖术, 魅力

examples.en: The quiet ancient forest seemed wrapped in a layer of timeless enchantment.
examples.zh: 这片寂静的原始森林仿佛笼罩在一种永恒的魔力之中。

lemmas.def_en: a sorcerer or magician

examples.en: In the legend, the enchanter cast a powerful spell to protect the kingdom.
examples.zh: 在传说中，这位魔法师施展了强大的法术来保护王国。

lemmas.def_en: in a bewitching manner
lemmas.def_zh: 夺人心魂地；可爱地, 迷人地

examples.en: The garden was enchantingly illuminated by hundreds of tiny fairy lights at dusk.
examples.zh: 黄昏时分，数百盏小彩灯将花园装点得迷人绚丽。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 迷人的，令人陶醉的
lemmas.def_en: delightfully charming or attractive, capturing interest as if by magic
lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰景致、声音、故事或人物，如 an enchanting view / smile / story。

examples.en: The coastal town is famous for its enchanting scenery and historic streets.
examples.zh: 这座海滨小镇以其迷人的风光和历史悠久的街道而闻名。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 en-（使进入）+ chant（唱/念咒），字面指“施魔法诱惑”

lemmas.def_en: relatively long-bodied reptile with usually two pairs of legs and a tapering tail

examples.en: A green lizard sat perfectly still on the warm rock, absorbing the sunshine.
examples.zh: 一只绿蜥蜴一动不动地趴在温暖的岩石上晒着太阳。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指蜥蜴；俚语中 lounge lizard 指吃软饭的男子或交际花，注意语境差异。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 lesarde，指爬行动物蜥蜴

lemmas.def_en: a source of danger; a possibility of incurring loss or misfortune

examples.en: Thousands of jobs will be in jeopardy if the company fails to secure the bank loan.
examples.zh: 如果公司无法获得银行贷款，数千个工作岗位将陷入危机。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面语高频词，多见于正式报道与法律文本，常与介词搭配构成 in jeopardy（处于危险中）。

lemmas.def_en: pose a threat to; present a danger to
lemmas.def_zh: 危害, 使受危困, 使陷危地

examples.en: Making reckless financial decisions will jeopardize the long-term stability of the family.
examples.zh: 做出鲁莽的财务决定会危及整个家庭的长期稳定。

lemmas.def_en: pose a threat to; present a danger to
lemmas.def_zh: 使受危险, 危及, 危害

examples.en: Leaking confidential details to the press could jeopardise the ongoing peace negotiations.
examples.zh: 向媒体泄露机密细节可能会危及正在进行的和平谈判。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 jeu parti（均势博弈），原指胜负未定的危险局面，引申为危难

lemmas.def_en: teach and impress by frequent repetitions or admonitions
lemmas.def_zh: 注入, 使充满, 泡制, 鼓舞；泡

examples.en: The coach tried to infuse confidence into the young players before the final match.
examples.zh: 教练在决赛前试图给年轻队员们注入信心。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于书面语，核心搭配 infuse A into B 或 infuse B with A，引申表示注入活力、思想或泡茶浸泡。

lemmas.def_en: a solution obtained by steeping or soaking a substance (usually in water)
lemmas.def_zh: 注入, 泡制, 注入物

examples.en: The struggling startup desperately needed a fresh infusion of capital to survive.
examples.zh: 这家陷入困境的初创公司极度需要注入新资金以求生存。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 in-（入内）+ fuse（倾倒/注入），核心为“注入、灌输”

lemmas.def_en: consider again; give new consideration to; usually with a view to changing

examples.en: We urge the committee to reconsider its decision regarding the budget cuts.
examples.zh: 我们敦促委员会重新考虑削减预算的决定。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用及物动词，接名词、代词或 whether 从句作宾语，用于正式且礼貌地请求或说明重新考虑某决定。

lemmas.def_en: a consideration of a topic (as in a meeting) with a view to changing an earlier decision
lemmas.def_zh: 再考虑, 再审查, 再议

examples.en: After careful reconsideration, the board decided to approve the proposed budget cuts.
examples.zh: 经过仔细重新考虑，董事会决定批准拟议的预算削减。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 re-（重新）+ consider（考虑），即“重新思考”

lemmas.def_en: the substance that is acted upon by an enzyme or ferment
lemmas.def_zh: 底层, 地层, 衬底, 基底, 基质, 酶作用物, 酶解物

examples.en: The enzyme binds specifically to its substrate to speed up the chemical reaction.
examples.zh: 该酶与其底物特异性结合以加速化学反应。

lemmas.usage_note: 专业学术词汇，在生化中指“底物”，材料学中指“基质/基底”，不用于日常泛指的表面或基础。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 sub-（在...下）+ strate（铺展），原指底层基底，生物化学中指受质

lemmas.def_en: a person who is the aim of an attack (especially a victim of ridicule or exploitation) by some hostile person or influence
lemmas.def_zh: 采石场, 方形石, 猎物, 被追求物, 来源

examples.en: The detective pursued his quarry through the crowded subway station.
examples.zh: 侦探穿过拥挤的地铁站追捕他的目标猎物。

lemmas.usage_note: 可表示露天“采石场”，亦指狩猎或追逐的“猎物”，常用于自然描写、纪实文学或司法追缉语境。

lemmas.def_en: a man who works in a quarry

examples.en: The experienced quarrier carefully split the massive granite blocks using traditional tools.
examples.zh: 经验丰富的采石工人用传统工具小心地劈开巨大的花岗岩石块。

lemmas.def_en: extract (something such as stones) from or as if from a quarry
lemmas.def_zh: 挖出, 努力挖掘；费力地找

examples.en: Limestone has been quarried in this mountainous region for centuries.
examples.zh: 几个世纪以来，这个山区一直在开采石灰岩。

lemmas.usage_note: 作动词表示开采石料，引申指从文献或资料库中费力搜集材料，常与 out、for 连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 quadrare（方石），引申指石矿；另一同音源义指猎物（原指分给猎犬的内脏）

lemmas.def_en: strike with a swiping motion
lemmas.def_zh: 强打, 用力挥击, 偷

examples.en: Someone managed to swipe his expensive watch while he was distracted in the crowd.
examples.zh: 他在人群中分心时，有人趁机偷走了他昂贵的手表。

lemmas.usage_note: 现代科技高频词，如 swipe a card（刷卡）或 swipe left/right（屏幕左右滑动）；口语可指偷窃。

family_guide.root_logic: 可能源自 sweep（扫过）的变体，表示大范围划过或猛击

lemmas.def_en: lacking in light; not bright or harsh

examples.en: We struggled to read the map in the dim light of the single candle.
examples.zh: 在一支蜡烛昏暗的微光下，我们费力地看着地图。

lemmas.usage_note: 作形容词可修饰光线（暗淡）、视力记忆（模糊）或前景（渺茫），常与 take a dim view of 连用。

lemmas.def_en: not made dim or less bright
lemmas.def_zh: 不暗淡的,不模糊的,清楚的,明亮的

examples.en: Even in her nineties, her passion for painting remained completely undimmed by age.
examples.zh: 即使到了九十多岁，她对绘画的热情也丝毫未因岁月而褪色。

lemmas.def_en: switch (a car's headlights) from a higher to a lower beam

examples.en: The theatre lights dimmed as the opening music began to play.
examples.zh: 随着开场音乐响起，剧场里的灯光逐渐暗了下来。

lemmas.usage_note: 可作及物或不及物动词，指灯光减弱或希望、热情减退，影院或表演开场前常提示调暗灯光。

lemmas.def_en: the state of being poorly illuminated

examples.en: Her eyes gradually adjusted to the dimness of the old, shuttered room.
examples.zh: 她的眼睛逐渐适应了这间关着百叶窗的昏暗老房间。

family_guide.root_logic: 日耳曼语源，核心意义为“昏暗的、模糊的”

lemmas.def_en: characteristic of a mother; - Dorothy Sayers
lemmas.def_zh: 母亲的, 母系的, 母方的

examples.en: Her strong maternal instincts kicked in the moment she held the crying baby.
examples.zh: 在她抱起啼哭婴儿的那一刻，她强烈的母性本能油然而生。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式形容词，常与 instinct（本能）、leave（产假）、grandfather（外祖父）等搭配，强调母亲或母系特征。

lemmas.def_en: in a maternal manner; as a mother

examples.en: The nurse smiled maternally as she tucked the blanket around the sick patient.
examples.zh: 护士像母亲般微笑着为生病的患者掖好被子。

lemmas.def_zh: 母性, 怀孕, 妇产科医院
lemmas.def_en: the state of being pregnant; the period from conception to birth when a woman carries a developing fetus in her uterus

examples.en: She decided to return to her consulting job after six months of maternity leave.
examples.zh: 休完六个月产假后，她决定重返咨询工作岗位。

lemmas.usage_note: 作名词表示母亲身份、怀孕期，多用作定语构成 maternity leave（产假）、maternity ward（产房）。

family_guide.root_logic: 词根 mater-（母亲）+ -al（形容词后缀），表示“母亲的”

lemmas.def_en: a large thick pad filled with resilient material and often incorporating coiled springs, used as a bed or part of a bed
lemmas.def_zh: 床垫, 空气垫, 沉床

examples.en: Buying a firm mattress significantly relieved his chronic lower back pain overnight.
examples.zh: 买一张硬床垫让他的慢性腰痛在一夜之间明显减轻。

lemmas.usage_note: 指床垫，常与 on/upon 连用；常见搭配有 spring/foam mattress，注意其为可数名词。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自阿拉伯语 matrah（扔垫子的地方），指用于睡眠的充填床垫

lemmas.def_en: a cavalry unit consisting of two or more troops and headquarters and supporting arms
lemmas.def_zh: 骑兵营, 分遣队, 小舰队

examples.en: A squadron of fighter jets patrolled the coastal border during the joint exercise.
examples.zh: 联合演习期间，一个战斗机中队在沿海边境巡逻。

lemmas.usage_note: 军事术语，指空军中队或海军舰队分队；常用搭配如 fighter squadron（战斗机中队）。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自意大利语 squadrone（方阵），引申指陆海空军队的编制分队

lemmas.def_en: a biography of yourself

examples.en: In his candid autobiography, the former president reflected on his major political failures.
examples.zh: 在前总统坦诚的自传中，他反思了自己主要的政治失误。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指亲笔撰写的“自传”，注意与他人作传的 biography 区分，常作书名或文学分类标签。

lemmas.def_en: someone who writes their own biography

examples.en: The candid autobiographer reflected openly on both his greatest triumphs and deepest regrets.
examples.zh: 这位坦率的自传作者公开反思了他最大的成就和最深的遗憾。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or characteristic of an autobiographer

examples.en: Many critics noted that her first novel was largely autobiographical in nature.
examples.zh: 许多评论家指出，她的第一部小说在很大程度上具有自传性质。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 auto-（自己）+ bio（生命）+ graphy（书写），即“为自己写的生平记录”
family_guide.core_distinction: 区别于 biography（由他人撰写的传记）

lemmas.def_en: a mixture containing two or more metallic elements or metallic and nonmetallic elements usually fused together or dissolving into each other when molten

examples.en: Brass is an alloy consisting primarily of copper and zinc.
examples.zh: 黄铜是一种主要由铜和锌组成的合金。

lemmas.usage_note: 工业与化学高频词，指两种或多种金属融合而成的合金，常用于材料科学及工程制造文本中。

lemmas.def_en: lower in value by increasing the base-metal content
lemmas.def_zh: 将...铸成合金, 减低成色；合铸

examples.en: Gold is often alloyed with other metals to increase its overall durability.
examples.zh: 黄金通常与其他金属熔合以增加其整体耐用度。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指将金属熔合成合金，文学语境中常引申指“减低成色、使……打折扣”，常带消极色彩。

lemmas.def_en: free from admixture
lemmas.def_zh: 未搀杂的, 纯粹的, 非合金的

examples.en: Winning the final championship championship brought pure, unalloyed joy to the young team.
examples.zh: 赢得最终的总冠军给这支年轻的队伍带来了纯粹的喜悦。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 alligare（绑定），核心义为将金属熔合在一起，引申为使掺杂或品质打折扣。

lemmas.def_en: any of various primates with short tails or no tail at all

examples.en: Chimpanzees belong to the family of great apes and share much of our DNA.
examples.zh: 黑猩猩属于类人猿科，与人类共享大量脱氧核糖核酸。

lemmas.usage_note: 生物学及日常词汇，专指无尾类人猿（如猩猩），注意与 monkey（猴子）在物种分类上的区别。

lemmas.def_en: someone who copies the words or behavior of another

examples.en: He was dismissed as a mere aper of his predecessor's grand style.
examples.zh: 他被贬为不过是在拙劣模仿前任的大气风格。

lemmas.def_en: imitate uncritically and in every aspect

examples.en: He loved to ape his older brother's cool mannerisms in front of his friends.
examples.zh: 他喜欢在朋友面前模仿他哥哥装酷的言行举止。

lemmas.usage_note: 动词表示（尤指笨拙、可笑地）模仿或效仿他人，带轻蔑贬义，也可用于技术语境作专有缩写动词。

family_guide.root_logic: 本义为类人猿，因其善于模仿人类行为，引申出盲目模仿的动词义。

lemmas.def_en: walk as if unable to control one's movements
lemmas.def_zh: 蹒跚, 犹豫；使摇摆, 使踌躇, 交错, 错开

examples.en: The company decided to stagger the working hours to avoid peak rush-hour traffic.
examples.zh: 公司决定错开上下班时间，以避开早晚交通高峰期。

lemmas.usage_note: 兼具物理位移（蹒跚）、心理冲击（使震惊）及管理调度（错开时间/休假）三种核心动词用法。

lemmas.def_en: extremely
lemmas.def_zh: 难以置信地; 令人震惊地; 摇晃地; 蹒跚地

examples.en: The project ended up being staggeringly expensive compared to the initial budget.
examples.zh: 与最初的预算相比，该项目的最终开销高得令人震惊。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 令人难以置信的；震惊的；巨大的
lemmas.def_en: deeply shocking, astonishing, or overwhelming in amount or degree
lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰数量、数额、差异或成就，如 a staggering amount / sum / defeat。

examples.en: The project was completed at a staggering cost of over ten billion dollars.
examples.zh: 该项目以超过一百亿美元的惊人巨资竣工。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古诺斯语，核心动作是“摇摆、不稳地移动”，引申出交错排列或令人难以承受的震惊。

lemmas.def_en: someone who manages property or other affairs for someone else
lemmas.def_zh: 管理人, 招待员, 管家, 乘务员

examples.en: The flight steward kindly offered extra pillows and blankets to tired passengers.
examples.zh: 客舱乘务员亲切地为疲惫的乘客提供额外的枕头和毯子。

lemmas.usage_note: 可指客机/客轮服务员（现更常用 flight attendant），亦指大型活动的乘务员或管理员。

lemmas.def_en: the position of steward

examples.en: The company flourished under her responsible stewardship over the past ten years.
examples.zh: 在过去的十年里，公司在她负责任的管理下蓬勃发展。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 stig（房屋、圈栏）+ weard（守卫），原指管家，后泛指负责管理事务或服务的人员。

lemmas.def_en: a covered passageway with shops and stalls on either side
lemmas.def_zh: 拱廊, 拱形建筑物, 有拱廊的街道

examples.en: We spent the rainy afternoon playing vintage video games at the local arcade.
examples.zh: 下雨的下午，我们在当地的街机游戏厅玩老式电子游戏度过。

lemmas.usage_note: 指拱廊商街（shopping arcade）或电子游戏厅（amusement/video arcade），多作可数名词。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 arcus（拱门），指一系列由柱子支撑的拱门长廊，现代多引申为拱廊商业街或游乐场。

lemmas.def_en: the top line of a hill, mountain, or wave
lemmas.def_zh: 冠, 饰毛, 头盔的顶部

examples.en: They finally reached the crest of the ridge just as the sun began to set.
examples.zh: 太阳刚开始落山时，他们终于到达了山脊的顶峰。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指山顶、浪尖、羽冠或家族徽章，常与 of 连用（如 crest of the wave/hill），书面语色彩浓厚。

lemmas.def_en: lie at the top of

examples.en: The exhausted hikers crested the hill and saw the ocean stretching out before them.
examples.zh: 疲惫的徒步者们翻过山顶，看到大海在眼前绵延展开。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用作不及物或及物动词，表示登上顶峰或达到最高点，常与 hill、wave 等词搭配，具动态画面感。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 crista（羽冠、冠毛），核心指物体顶部的隆起部分，引申至攀上顶峰。

lemmas.def_en: edge tool used in shaving

examples.en: He replaced the blunt blade in his razor before shaving.
examples.zh: 他在刮胡子前更换了剃刀里变钝的刀片。

lemmas.usage_note: 指剃须刀或刮胡刀，常见搭配有 safety razor（安全剃刀）、razor blade（刀片）等，多用于日常生活语境。

lemmas.def_en: shave with a razor

examples.en: The stylist razored the ends of her hair to create a textured, layered look.
examples.zh: 发型师用剃刀削薄了她的发尾，以打造出富有层次感的效果。

lemmas.usage_note: 表示用剃刀刮除毛发或划开某物，多用于及物动词，属于相对少见的动作化表达，强调刮剃的动作。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 raser（刮削），指刮去毛发、使之平滑的锐利刀具。

lemmas.def_en: narrate or give a detailed account of
lemmas.def_zh: 详述, 叙述, 重新计算

examples.en: The grandfather loved to recount exciting stories from his travels around the world.
examples.zh: 祖父喜欢详述他环游世界时的那些刺激经历。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面正式用词，指按顺序叙述/重述事件经历，直接接宾语，如 recount a tale/incident to sb。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 re-（再）+ count（数、计算），原义为重新清点，引申为逐一叙述、重述经历。

lemmas.def_en: perceive by inhaling through the nose
lemmas.def_zh: 嗅, 蔑视, 嗤之以鼻；闻, 用力吸, 发觉

examples.en: She sniffed the milk cautiously to check whether it had gone sour.
examples.zh: 她小心翼翼地闻了闻牛奶，看它是否变质了。

lemmas.usage_note: 可表示抽鼻子、吸气闻气味或嗤之以鼻，常与 at 连用表示轻蔑（sniff at），兼具生理动作与态度隐喻。

lemmas.def_zh: 吸着鼻子说话, 抽鼻涕
lemmas.def_en: cry or whine with snuffling

examples.en: Suffering from a sudden winter cold, the boy began to sniffle loudly.
examples.zh: 由于突然患上冬日感冒，那个男孩开始大声抽鼻涕。

lemmas.def_en: a person who sniffs

examples.en: Network administrators used a packet sniffer to detect the security breach immediately.
examples.zh: 网络管理员使用数据包嗅探器立即检测到了安全漏洞。

lemmas.def_en: liable to sniffle

examples.en: The child felt very sniffly after walking home through the freezing autumn rain.
examples.zh: 孩子在冰冷的秋雨中走回家后开始不停地抽鼻子。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声词，模拟用鼻子急促吸气的声音，引申为嗅闻或轻蔑地嗤之以鼻。

lemmas.def_en: a professional person trained in library science and engaged in library services
lemmas.def_zh: 图书馆员, 图书管理员

examples.en: The friendly librarian helped me track down a rare historical manuscript easily.
examples.zh: 那位友善的图书管理员帮我轻松找到了一份罕见的历史手稿。

lemmas.usage_note: 指图书馆专业管理人员而非普通借阅助理；常与 chief/head 搭配，在学术或公共语境中广泛使用。

lemmas.def_en: the position of librarian
lemmas.def_zh: 图书馆长[图书管理学专家]的职位[资格]

examples.en: She decided to study librarianship to pursue a career organizing digital knowledge archives.
examples.zh: 她决定攻读图书馆学，以从事整理数字知识档案的职业。

family_guide.root_logic: 词根 libr-（书）衍生出 library（图书馆），加后缀 -an 表示从事某专业的人。

lemmas.def_en: lie in wait, lie in ambush, behave in a sneaky and secretive manner
lemmas.def_zh: 暗藏, 潜伏, 埋伏

examples.en: A sense of unease lurked in the back of his mind throughout the interview.
examples.zh: 在整个面试过程中，一丝不安始终潜伏在他的心头。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指危险、怀疑或人在暗处潜伏，常搭配 in the shadows/background，网络语境中亦指只看帖不发言。

lemmas.def_en: someone waiting in concealment

examples.en: He remained a silent lurker on the forum without ever posting a comment.
examples.zh: 他一直是该论坛上的潜水者，从未发表过任何评论。

family_guide.root_logic: 可能源自中世纪英语，核心指鬼祟地隐藏、潜伏，常含危险即将发生之意。

lemmas.def_en: a proposition deducible from basic postulates

examples.en: The math professor proved the complex theorem using an elegant and direct method.
examples.zh: 数学教授用一种优雅而直接的方法证明了那个复杂的定理。

lemmas.usage_note: 学术与数学书面语，常与 prove/formulate 连用；注意与公理（axiom）区分，定理特指已被严格证明的命题。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 theorema（观察物、推测、定理），指经过逻辑推理被证明的命题。

lemmas.def_en: (often followed by `of' or `to') yielding readily to or capable of
lemmas.def_zh: 易受影响的, 易感动的, 容许...的

examples.en: Elderly people are particularly susceptible to severe respiratory infections during the winter.
examples.zh: 老年人在冬季尤其容易受到严重呼吸道感染的影响。

lemmas.usage_note: 固定搭配为 be susceptible to，后接疾病、影响或诱惑等，表示易受感染或脆弱，偏正式文体。

lemmas.def_en: the state of being susceptible; easily affected

examples.en: Lack of proper sleep can significantly increase your susceptibility to seasonal flu.
examples.zh: 缺乏充足的睡眠会显著增加你对季节性流感的易感性。

family_guide.root_logic: 词根 sus-（在…下）+ cept（抓取）+ -ible（可…的），字面为“从下方被轻易拿下的”，引申为易受影响或感染的。

lemmas.def_en: beyond or deviating from the usual or expected
lemmas.def_zh: 奇特的, 罕见的, 特殊的, 特别的

examples.en: This strange nesting behavior is peculiar to this specific species of bird.
examples.zh: 这种奇怪的筑巢行为是这一特定鸟类所特有的。

lemmas.usage_note: 可表‘古怪的’，亦常与 to 搭配构成 peculiar to，表示‘为……所特有的’，适用于正式学术或观察描述。

lemmas.def_en: an odd or unusual characteristic
lemmas.def_zh: 特质, 特性, 怪癖

examples.en: One peculiar habit of his was reading every book completely backward first.
examples.zh: 他的一个怪癖是看每本书前都要完全倒着读一遍。

lemmas.def_en: uniquely or characteristically; ; ; - John Knowles
lemmas.def_zh: 特别, 尤其, 奇怪地

examples.en: The empty house felt peculiarly quiet after all the excited guests had departed.
examples.zh: 所有兴奋的客人都离开后，空荡荡的房子显得异常安静。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 peculium（私有财产），原指专属于个人的，引申为特有的，后引申出因不同寻常而显得怪异。

lemmas.def_en: to grip, cut off, or tear with or as if with the teeth or jaws

examples.en: The icy mountain wind bit into their exposed skin as they climbed higher.
examples.zh: 随着他们越爬越高，刺骨的山风刮痛了他们裸露的皮肤。

lemmas.usage_note: 表示用牙咬、昆虫叮咬，或引申为刺痛、起作用；常见搭配 bite one's lip（咬唇忍耐），口语与书面皆常用。

lemmas.def_en: extremely and sharply

examples.en: The critic wrote a bitingly sarcastic review of the director's latest film.
examples.zh: 影评人对该导演的最新电影撰写了一篇尖刻讽刺的评论。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 bitan（用牙齿咬），核心指牙齿咬入，引申为寒冷刺骨或言语辛辣尖刻。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of being shockingly cruel and inhumane

examples.en: The international court was established to prosecute those who committed atrocities during the conflict.
examples.zh: 成立国际法庭是为了起诉那些在冲突期间犯下残暴罪行的人。

lemmas.usage_note: 指战争或暴力中的极度残暴行径，常以复数 atrocities 出现，多与 commit 搭配（commit atrocities）。

lemmas.def_en: shockingly brutal or cruel

examples.en: The prisoners were forced to endure truly atrocious conditions during the harsh winter.
examples.zh: 囚犯们在严冬被迫忍受极其残暴恶劣的条件。

lemmas.def_en: in a terrible manner

examples.en: The spoiled young prince behaved atrociously throughout the entire royal dinner banquet.
examples.zh: 那位被宠坏的年轻王子在整个皇家晚宴上的表现都极其糟糕。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 atrox（凶猛的、残暴的），引申指极度凶残暴虐的行为或恶行。

lemmas.def_en: functioning in a supporting capacity

examples.en: When the main power grid failed, the hospital's auxiliary generators kicked in automatically.
examples.zh: 当主电网发生故障时，医院的备用发电机自动启动了。

lemmas.usage_note: 修饰设备、人员或措施，表示‘辅助的、备用的’，常见搭配 auxiliary power/engine/nurse，语体偏正式。

lemmas.def_en: someone who acts as assistant
lemmas.def_zh: 辅助者, 辅助物, 附属机构, 助动词

examples.en: In the sentence 'She has finished,' the word 'has' functions as an auxiliary.
examples.zh: 在句子 'She has finished' 中，单词 'has' 充当助动词。

lemmas.usage_note: 语法中指助动词（如 do, have），也可指辅助人员或外国援军，作可数名词使用，多见于语法学或军事语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 auxilium（帮助、援助），核心意为“辅助的、后备的”。

lemmas.def_en: a person having kinship with another or others

examples.en: He went to live with his kin after his parents passed away.
examples.zh: 父母去世后，他去和亲戚们一起生活。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数集合名词，正式或古风语体，常用搭配 next of kin（直系亲属/最近亲属）及 kith and kin（亲朋好友）。

lemmas.def_en: a close connection marked by community of interests or similarity in nature or character

examples.en: The shared tragedy created a strong sense of kinship among the survivors.
examples.zh: 共同的悲剧在幸存者之间建立起强烈的亲切感。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 cynn（家族、血缘），指具有亲属关系的人或亲族。

lemmas.def_en: the domain controlled by an emir

examples.en: Dubai is the most populous emirate in the United Arab Emirates.
examples.zh: 迪拜是阿拉伯联合酋长国人口最多的酋长国。

lemmas.usage_note: 专有名词性强，特指“酋长国”；常用于中东政治地理语境（如 the United Arab Emirates），首字母视情况大写。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自阿拉伯语 amir（埃米尔/酋长）加统治区域后缀 -ate，指酋长管辖的国家或领地。

lemmas.def_en: a cruel act; a deliberate infliction of pain and suffering

examples.en: There are strict laws against cruelty to animals.
examples.zh: 有严格的法律禁止虐待动物。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用搭配 cruelty to（对……残忍，如 cruelty to animals）；作不可数名词指残酷性质，可数时指具体残暴行为。

family_guide.root_logic: 来自 cruel（残忍的）的名词形式，核心含义是对他人或动物造成痛苦的残忍行为或冷酷态度。

lemmas.def_en: continue talking or writing in a desultory manner

examples.en: Showing him the old photograph helped to jog his memory about that summer.
examples.zh: 给他看那张老照片有助于唤起他对那个夏天的记忆。

lemmas.usage_note: 既指慢跑锻炼，也常构成习语 jog sb's memory（唤起某人的记忆），及物与不及物均十分地道常用。

lemmas.def_en: someone who runs a steady slow pace (usually for exercise)

examples.en: A morning jogger found the lost wallet lying beside the park bench.
examples.zh: 一名晨跑者在公园长椅旁发现了遗失的钱包。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声兼动作描写，原意为颠簸晃动，现代常指有节奏、慢步调地慢跑。

lemmas.def_en: a carnival performer who does disgusting acts

examples.en: He is a computer geek who loves building custom PCs.
examples.zh: 他是一个热衷于组装定制电脑的极客。

lemmas.usage_note: 常搭配 computer geek，现多为中性或褒义，指在特定领域极具热情且技术精湛的极客或专家。

family_guide.root_logic: 原指狂欢节杂耍中表演怪诞举动的演员，后引申为对电脑或某领域极度沉迷的技术狂人。

lemmas.def_en: an armed adversary (especially a member of an opposing military force)

examples.en: The two political rivals were bitter foes for decades.
examples.zh: 这两位政界对手针锋相对了数十年。

lemmas.usage_note: 属文学或书面语，常构成固定搭配 friend or foe（敌或友），日常口语中更习惯用 enemy。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 fah（怀有敌意的），指公开的仇敌、对手。

lemmas.def_en: a person afflicted with psychosis
lemmas.def_zh: 精神病患者；神经质的人

examples.en: He acted like a complete psycho when he lost his temper.
examples.zh: 他发脾气时表现得像个彻头彻尾的疯子。

lemmas.usage_note: 非正式且具强烈贬义的口语词，指变态狂或精神失常者；医学及正式语境应使用 psychopath。

family_guide.root_logic: psychopath 的缩略语，源自希腊语 psyche（心灵、灵魂），日常用于贬称心理病态或精神失常的人。

lemmas.def_en: give help or assistance; be of service
lemmas.def_zh: 援助, 帮助, 有助于；帮助

examples.en: The newly developed software will greatly aid researchers in analyzing complex data.
examples.zh: 这款新开发的软件将极大地帮助研究人员分析复杂数据。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面语常用动词，常与介词in连用（aid sb. in doing sth.），表示提供物资或协助。

lemmas.def_en: carried out without aid or assistance
lemmas.def_zh: 无助的, 未受协助的

examples.en: The elderly patient can now walk a few steps unaided after surgery.
examples.zh: 手术后，这位老年患者现在可以独立行走几步了。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 ad-（朝向）+ iuvare（帮助），核心语义为给予支援或协助。

lemmas.def_en: a hidden storage space (for money or provisions or weapons)
lemmas.def_zh: 隐藏所, 隐藏的粮食或物资, 贮藏物, 高速缓冲存储器

examples.en: Police discovered a secret cache of firearms hidden in the abandoned warehouse.
examples.zh: 警方在废弃仓库里发现了秘密隐藏的一批枪支。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指隐秘物资储备或计算机高速缓存，搭配clear the cache或a cache of weapons。

lemmas.def_en: save up as for future use

examples.en: Browsers automatically cache web pages to improve loading speeds on return visits.
examples.zh: 浏览器会自动缓存网页，以提高再次访问时的加载速度。

lemmas.usage_note: 作动词表示将物资秘密储藏或计算机暂存数据，常见于技术和探险语境中。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自法语 cacher（隐藏），指秘密储藏的物资，在计算机领域引申为快速临时读取的缓存。

lemmas.def_en: an atoll in the Marshall Islands; formerly used by the United States as a site for testing nuclear weapons

examples.en: She wore a red bikini and relaxed by the swimming pool.
examples.zh: 她穿着一身红色比基尼在泳池边放松。

lemmas.usage_note: 指比基尼泳装，常作可数名词，高频搭配有 wear a bikini 或 bikini line（比基尼线）。

family_guide.root_logic: 得名于太平洋的比基尼环礁（Bikini Atoll），因该泳装面世时的冲击力被比作原子弹试爆。

lemmas.def_en: an inconvenient discomfort

examples.en: We apologize for any inconvenience caused by the temporary system outage.
examples.zh: 对因系统临时故障给您带来的任何不便，我们深表歉意。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作不可数名词，商业道歉中高频搭配cause inconvenience或apologize for the inconvenience。

lemmas.def_en: to cause inconvenience or discomfort to
lemmas.def_zh: 使感不便, 使感困难

examples.en: I hope my late arrival did not inconvenience your dinner plans.
examples.zh: 希望我的迟到没有打扰到你们的晚餐计划。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，语气较正式客气，常用于表达不想给他人添麻烦的社交礼貌用语中。

lemmas.def_en: not suited to your comfort, purpose or needs

examples.en: She called at a very inconvenient time when we were in the middle of a meeting.
examples.zh: 她打来电话的时间很不巧，我们当时正在开会。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容时间、地点或安排带来不便，常作表语或定语，搭配an inconvenient time。

lemmas.def_en: in an inconvenient manner

examples.en: he arrived at an inconveniently late hour

family_guide.root_logic: in-（不）+ convenience（便利），指引起麻烦或不方便的人或事。

lemmas.def_en: (astronomy) a relatively small extraterrestrial body consisting of a frozen mass that travels around the sun in a highly elliptical orbit

examples.en: The bright comet was visible to the naked eye for several weeks.
examples.zh: 这颗明亮的彗星肉眼可见长达数周。

lemmas.usage_note: 天文学常见名词，指带尾巴的彗星，常用搭配a comet's tail或Halley's Comet。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or resembling a comet

examples.en: Scientists analyzed the cometary dust collected during the deep space exploration mission.
examples.zh: 科学家们分析了深空探测任务中收集到的彗星尘埃。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 komētes（长发的），古人将彗星拖着的尾巴形象地比作“长发之星”。

lemmas.def_en: shaking and vibration at the surface of the earth resulting from underground movement along a fault plane of from volcanic activity

examples.en: The powerful quake destroyed dozens of old buildings near the epicenter.
examples.zh: 这场强震摧毁了震中附近的数十栋老建筑。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，earthquake的非正式或文学化简称，常用于新闻标题或口语描绘灾害。

lemmas.def_en: a member of the Religious Society of Friends founded by George Fox (the Friends have never called themselves Quakers)

examples.en: The Quaker community advocated passionately for peaceful resolutions to international disputes.
examples.zh: 贵格会社团热切倡导和平解决国际争端。

lemmas.def_en: shake with fast, tremulous movements

examples.en: The ground began to quake violently as the volcano erupted.
examples.zh: 随着火山爆发，地面开始剧烈震颤。

lemmas.usage_note: 不及物动词，指因恐惧、寒冷而发抖，或土地剧烈晃动，常搭配quake with fear。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 cwacian（震动、颤栗），主要用于描述大地剧烈震动或人因恐惧而颤抖。

lemmas.def_en: a hazard on a golf course
lemmas.def_zh: 煤仓, 沙坑, 暗堡

examples.en: The soldiers retreated into the fortified underground bunker during the airstrike.
examples.zh: 空袭期间，士兵们撤退到了加固的地下掩体中。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指军事防空掩体或高尔夫沙坑，军事语境中常作underground bunker。

lemmas.def_en: hit a golf ball into a bunker
lemmas.def_zh: 击入沙坑, 使陷入困境

examples.en: A sudden gust of wind bunkered his golf ball on the eighth hole.
examples.zh: 一阵突如其来的大风将他在第八洞的击球吹进了沙坑。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，多用于高尔夫运动中把球击入沙坑，或比喻使陷入难以脱身的困境。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自苏格兰语，原指长凳或大箱子，后引申为封闭的储藏舱、掩体或球场沙坑。

lemmas.def_en: all the plant life in a particular region or period

examples.en: Dense tropical vegetation made it extremely difficult for the hikers to advance.
examples.zh: 茂密的热带植被使得徒步旅行者极难前行。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数集合名词，总称某地区的植被或植物群落，常见搭配dense/lush vegetation。

lemmas.def_zh: 植物的, 蔬菜的, 生长的, 无性繁殖的, 植物似的, 生活呆板单调的, 生长性的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to an activity that is passive and monotonous

examples.en: a dull vegetative lifestyle

lemmas.def_en: composed of vegetation or plants

examples.en: Scientists surveyed the island to record changes in its unique vegetational patterns.
examples.zh: 科学家对该岛进行了考察，以记录其独特植被格局的变化。

lemmas.def_zh: 植物似地生长, 过呆板单调的生活, 无所事事地生活, (赘疣)生长, 长大
lemmas.def_en: lead a passive existence without using one's body or mind

examples.en: He decided to vegetate on the sofa all weekend instead of working.
examples.zh: 他决定整个周末都窝在沙发上无所事事，而不是去工作。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 vegetare（赋予生命、使活跃），指生长茂盛的植物整体。

lemmas.def_en: to a remarkable degree or extent
lemmas.def_zh: 显著地, 引人注目地, 非常地

examples.en: The new hybrid vehicle is remarkably quiet even at high driving speeds.
examples.zh: 即使在高速行驶时，这辆新型混合动力车也非常安静。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰形容词或副词，搭配 remarkably well/similar，书面语中作评注性状语置于句首表达令人惊异。

lemmas.def_en: under normal conditions

examples.en: His career progressed quite unremarkably until he suddenly won the national award.
examples.zh: 在意外获得国家级奖项之前，他的职业生涯发展得相当平淡无奇。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 re-（强调）+ mark（标记、注意）+ -able + -ly，核心义为“值得注意地、显著地”。

lemmas.def_en: assign a new name to
lemmas.def_zh: 重新命名, 再命名, 给...改名

examples.en: The company decided to rename the brand to attract younger global consumers.
examples.zh: 该公司决定重命名该品牌，以吸引更年轻的全球消费者。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于被动语态，典型句型为 rename sth/sb after 或 rename A as B，注意接双宾语时无需介词。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 re-（重新）+ name（命名），指再次或更改名称。

lemmas.def_en: respiratory disorder characterized by wheezing; usually of allergic origin

examples.en: Cold dry winter air can easily trigger a severe attack of asthma.
examples.zh: 寒冷干燥的冬季空气容易诱发严重的哮喘发作。

lemmas.usage_note: 为不可数名词，常见搭配有 suffer from asthma、an asthma attack（哮喘发作）及 asthma inhaler。

lemmas.def_en: a person suffering from asthma

examples.en: As an asthmatic, she always carries an emergency inhaler in her bag.
examples.zh: 作为一名哮喘患者，她包里总是随身带着急救吸入器。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 asthma（急促呼吸、喘息），医学专指哮喘病。

lemmas.def_en: a painful and involuntary muscular contraction
lemmas.def_zh: 痉挛, 腹部绞痛, 铁夹钳

examples.en: The swimmer had to leave the pool because of a severe muscle cramp in his leg.
examples.zh: 那名游泳者因腿部严重肌肉痉挛不得不离开泳池。

lemmas.usage_note: 指肌肉痉挛或抽筋，常作单数或复数，高频搭配muscle cramp或get a cramp。

lemmas.def_en: secure with a cramp
lemmas.def_zh: 使抽筋, 以铁箍扣紧, 束缚

examples.en: Strict budgetary constraints will severely cramp our research plans this year.
examples.zh: 严格的预算限制将严重束缚我们今年的研究计划。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，比喻限制或束缚发展、风格等，最典型习语为cramp one's style。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自日耳曼语族词根，本义为“弯曲、夹紧”，引申为肌肉抽筋或限制束缚。

lemmas.def_en: a clawed foot of an animal especially a quadruped

examples.en: The dog raised its injured paw to show the vet where it hurt.
examples.zh: 那只狗抬起受伤的爪子，向兽医展示疼痛的位置。

lemmas.usage_note: 指猫、狗等具有爪垫的兽爪，也可幽默借指笨拙的人手，搭配front/hind paws。

lemmas.def_en: scrape with the paws
lemmas.def_zh: 以蹄扒地, 用爪子抓, 拼命抓, 向...乱抓, 笨拙地使用, 费力地前进

examples.en: The restless horse began to paw at the ground with its front hoof.
examples.zh: 那匹焦躁不安的马开始用前蹄扒地。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指动物用爪子扒拉，或人粗鲁、笨拙地乱抓摸，常与介词at连用（paw at）。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声或古法语借词，指有爪动物的脚掌，动词指用爪子抓或乱摸。

lemmas.def_en: the immediate descendants of a person
lemmas.def_zh: 子孙, 后代, 产物

examples.en: Female birds often work tirelessly to protect their vulnerable offspring from predators.
examples.zh: 雌鸟常常不知疲倦地保护脆弱的后代免受捕食者的伤害。

lemmas.usage_note: 单复数同形，不可加 -s；语体偏正式、科学或幽默调侃，指人时多指子女，指动物时指幼崽。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 off（离开）+ spring（跳出、生发）构成，指“从祖先处发散出来的后代”。

lemmas.def_en: French general who became emperor of the French (1769-1821)

examples.en: Historians still debate whether Napoleon was a heroic reformer or a ruthless tyrant.
examples.zh: 历史学家仍在争论拿破仑究竟是英勇的改革者还是残暴的暴君。

lemmas.usage_note: 小写时常指法国旧金币或法式千层酥；首字母大写时多用于心理学词汇 Napoleon complex（拿破仑情结）。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拿破仑·波拿巴（Napoleon Bonaparte），引申为旧金币、拿破仑酥点或拿破仑式纸牌游戏。

lemmas.def_en: a cgs unit of magnetic flux equal to the flux perpendicular to an area of 1 square centimeter in a magnetic field of 1 gauss

examples.en: James Clerk Maxwell formulated the classical theory of electromagnetic radiation in physics.
examples.zh: 詹姆斯·克拉克·麦克斯韦创立了物理学中的经典电磁辐射理论。

lemmas.usage_note: 物理学专业术语，为磁通量单位麦克斯韦（符号 Mx），仅见于学术或科技语境，复数形式直接加 s。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自英国物理学家詹姆斯·克拉克·麦克斯韦（James Clerk Maxwell），用作磁通量单位。

lemmas.def_en: a county in southeastern England on the Thames
lemmas.def_zh: 四轮双座轻便游览马车

examples.en: The tourists enjoyed riding in a horse-drawn surrey through the historic park.
examples.zh: 游客们喜欢乘坐马拉四轮双座马车穿行在这座历史悠久的公园中。

lemmas.usage_note: 历史名词，指19世纪美国流行的四轮敞篷轻便马车；作地名时首字母大写，指英国萨里郡。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自英国萨里郡（Surrey），指最初在该地制造的四轮轻便双座马车。

lemmas.def_en: the forest trees growing in a country or region

examples.en: The botanist spent years documenting the rich silva of the northern region.
examples.zh: 这位植物学家花数年时间记录了北部地区丰富的森林志。

lemmas.usage_note: 植物学学术用语，指某一地区的森林树木志；作为通称时可拼作 sylva，属极高阶的书面专业词汇。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 silva（森林、树木），引申指林木区或某个地区的森林树木志。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or associated with the moon
lemmas.def_zh: 阴历的, 月的, 微亮的(指光)

examples.en: Many Asian cultures celebrate the lunar new year with grand family feasts.
examples.zh: 许多亚洲文化都会以丰盛的家庭宴席来庆祝农历新年。

lemmas.usage_note: 仅作前置定语，常见搭配 lunar calendar（阴历）、lunar eclipse（月食）及 lunar module（登月舱）。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 luna（月亮）+ -ar（形容词后缀），指与月球或太阴相关的。

lemmas.def_en: conducted with or marked by hidden aims or methods
lemmas.def_zh: 秘密从事的, 秘密的, 从事间谍活动的

examples.en: Two undercover detectives joined the street gang to gather crucial criminal evidence.
examples.zh: 两名卧底便衣侦探潜入街头团伙以收集关键的犯罪证据。

lemmas.usage_note: 通常作定语修饰人或行动，如 undercover agent/operation；作状语表达秘密卧底时常搭配 go undercover。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 under（在……下）+ cover（掩护、遮盖）构成，形容隐藏身份进行秘密活动。

lemmas.def_en: a unit of magnetic flux density equal to one weber per square meter
lemmas.def_zh: 特斯拉（磁感应强度单位）

examples.en: The magnetic field of the MRI scanner is measured in teslas.
examples.zh: 这台核磁共振扫描仪的磁场强度是以特斯拉为单位测量的。

lemmas.usage_note: 作为磁感应强度单位时首字母小写（符号为T），常用于科技语境；作汽车品牌时首字母大写，不可混淆。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自塞尔维亚裔美籍物理学家尼古拉·特斯拉（Nikola Tesla）的姓氏，用作磁通量密度的国际单位制单位。

lemmas.def_en: a content word that can be used to refer to a person, place, thing, quality, or action

examples.en: In the sentence 'Dogs bark', 'dogs' is a noun.
examples.zh: 在句子 'Dogs bark' 中，'dogs' 是名词。

lemmas.usage_note: 语法学专有名词，常见搭配如 proper/common noun（专有/普通名词），常作可数名词使用。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 nomen（名字、名称），在语法中指用来指代人、事、物或概念的词。

lemmas.def_en: surface layer of ground containing a mat of grass and grass roots
lemmas.def_zh: n. 草皮；地盘；赛马界；v. 铺草皮；驱逐，赶走

examples.en: The rival gang members refused to sell their goods on our turf.
examples.zh: 对头帮派的成员不敢在我们的地盘上卖货。

lemmas.usage_note: 指草皮，引申为势力范围或地盘，习语搭配home turf或protect one's turf。

lemmas.def_en: cover (the ground) with a surface layer of grass or grass roots
lemmas.def_zh: n. 草皮；地盘；赛马界；v. 铺草皮；驱逐，赶走

examples.en: Security guards quickly turf trouble-making fans out of the stadium.
examples.zh: 保安人员迅速将闹事的球迷逐出了体育场。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指铺草皮，在英式口语中常搭配turf sb. out of表示驱逐某人。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自日耳曼语，本义为带有植物根系的草皮，引申为个人或团体的势力范围及赛马场。

lemmas.def_en: move in a wavy pattern or with a rising and falling motion
lemmas.def_zh: v. 拍打；扇动；摆动；焦虑；n. 扁平垂下物；扇动；恐慌

examples.en: The flags flapped violently in the strong coastal wind.
examples.zh: 旗帜在强劲的海风中剧烈飘动。

lemmas.usage_note: 常表示鸟类振翅、旗帜随风摆动，英式口语中常用于flap about/around表示慌张焦虑。

lemmas.def_en: any broad thin and limber covering attached at one edge; hangs loose or projects freely
lemmas.def_zh: v. 拍打；扇动；摆动；焦虑；n. 扁平垂下物；扇动；恐慌

examples.en: There is no need to get into a flap about the slight delay.
examples.zh: 没必要为了这点轻微的延误而惊慌失措。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指信封开口或衣服口袋的折口垂下物；口语中常用in a flap指陷入惊慌混乱状态。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声词，模拟扁平物体在空中快速拍打振动的声音和动作，引申为慌乱或激动。

lemmas.def_en: one of the 150 lyrical poems and prayers that comprise the Book of Psalms in the Old Testament; said to have been written by David
lemmas.def_zh: n. 圣诗，赞美诗；v. 唱圣诗赞美

examples.en: The choir sang a traditional psalm during the morning service.
examples.zh: 唱诗班在晨祷仪式上唱了一首传统的赞美诗。

lemmas.usage_note: 宗教与文学语体词汇，尤指《圣经》中的诗篇或赞美诗，常与sing、chant等动词搭配。

lemmas.def_en: a composer of sacred songs
lemmas.def_zh: 赞美诗作者, 领唱者

examples.en: The ancient psalmist expressed profound joy and deep sorrow through his sacred verses.
examples.zh: 这位古代赞美诗作者通过神圣的诗句表达了极大的喜悦与深沉的悲伤。

lemmas.def_en: sing or celebrate in psalms
lemmas.def_zh: n. 圣诗，赞美诗；v. 唱圣诗赞美

examples.en: The monks gathered to psalm the glory of the divine at dawn.
examples.zh: 僧侣们在黎明时分聚集，唱圣诗赞美神的荣耀。

lemmas.usage_note: 罕见的文雅或文学用词，指以圣诗颂扬或唱赞美诗，多作及物动词使用。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 psalmos（伴随弦乐的歌声），特指宗教崇拜中所唱的赞美诗或圣诗。

lemmas.def_en: a print made by an impression of the ridges in the skin of a finger; often used for biometric identification in criminal investigations
lemmas.def_zh: n. 指纹；特征标记；v. 提取……的指纹

examples.en: The forensic team managed to lift a clear fingerprint from the glass.
examples.zh: 法医团队设法从玻璃杯上提取到了一枚清晰的指纹。

lemmas.usage_note: 指生理指纹或引申指独特的电子、化学特征标记，常与lift、match、leave搭配。

lemmas.def_en: take an impression of a person's fingerprints
lemmas.def_zh: n. 指纹；特征标记；v. 提取……的指纹

examples.en: The suspect was booked and fingerprinted shortly after his arrest.
examples.zh: 嫌疑人被捕后不久便被登记并采集了指纹。

lemmas.usage_note: 司法与警务语体词，指对嫌疑人提取或采集指纹，直接接宾语人称或身体部位。

family_guide.root_logic: 复合词，由 finger（手指）和 print（印记）构成，核心语义指手指末端独特的纹理印记，引申为特征识别标记。

lemmas.def_en: any of numerous deciduous trees and shrubs of the genus Salix

examples.en: Weeping willows were gently swaying by the riverbank.
examples.zh: 垂柳在河岸边轻轻摇曳。

lemmas.usage_note: 常见固定植物搭配 weeping willow（垂柳），文学中常用 willow-pattern 描摹青花瓷风格。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 welig，指生长在水边、枝条柔韧的柳树，其木材常用以制作板球拍。

lemmas.def_en: a low evergreen shrub of the family Ericaceae; has small bell-shaped pink or purple flowers

examples.en: They spent the afternoon walking across the windy heath.
examples.zh: 他们整个下午都在风声呼啸的石楠荒原上漫步。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面语与地理词汇，指荒野、石楠灌木丛，常与 moor 互换但更强调灌木覆盖的开阔未开垦地。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 hǣth，指未开垦的荒野、石楠丛生地，亦指生长其上的低矮石楠属植物。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or created by statutes
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 法定的；依照法令的

examples.en: Employers have a statutory obligation to ensure workplace safety.
examples.zh: 雇主负有确保工作场所安全的法定责任。

lemmas.usage_note: 法律及行政语体正式词，修饰义务、权利或要求，常搭配duty、requirement、right。

lemmas.def_en: according to statute

examples.en: Employers are statutorily required to provide a safe working environment for all staff.
examples.zh: 法律明文规定雇主必须为所有员工提供安全的工作环境。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 status（法令、规定），由 statute（法规）派生而来，指法律或法规所明确规定的。

lemmas.def_en: the visual percept of a region
lemmas.def_zh: n. 远景；壮丽景色；展望，前景

examples.en: From the mountain peak, a breathtaking vista opened up before us.
examples.zh: 从山顶望去，一幅令人惊叹的壮丽全景展现在我们眼前。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面语，指开阔景观或展望；常搭配 a vista of（...的前景/景致），比 view 更具宏大和纵深感。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自意大利语 vista（视野），来自拉丁语 videre（看），指透过狭长通道（如林荫道）所见的远景，引申为发展前景。

lemmas.def_en: very large in scale or scope or capability
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 宏观的，大规模的；n. 宏，宏指令

examples.en: The government needs to consider the macro economic implications of this tax reform.
examples.zh: 政府需要考虑这项税制改革对宏观经济的影响。

lemmas.usage_note: 学术与经济语体词，指宏观的或全局性的，常与environment、level、trend搭配。

lemmas.def_en: a single computer instruction that results in a series of instructions in machine language
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 宏观的，大规模的；n. 宏，宏指令

examples.en: She wrote a simple macro to automate the repetitive daily report generation.
examples.zh: 她编写了一个简单的宏，以自动生成重复性的每日报告。

lemmas.usage_note: 计算机与办公软件术语，指宏命令或自动化脚本，常与run、record、write搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 makros（巨大、宏大），用于指宏观层面的事物，计算机中引申为“宏指令”。

lemmas.def_en: bounded or limited in magnitude or spatial or temporal extent

examples.en: Earth has a finite supply of non-renewable fossil fuels.
examples.zh: 地球上不可再生的化石燃料储量是有限的。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面语及学术语体词，指数量、时间或空间有限，常搭配resources、number、amount。

lemmas.def_en: with a finite limit

examples.en: The computer program searches among finitely many options before returning the best result.
examples.zh: 该计算机程序在有限的若干个选项中进行检索，然后返回最佳结果。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of being finite

examples.en: The fundamental finiteness of natural resources requires humanity to adopt sustainable habits.
examples.zh: 自然资源根本上的有限性要求人类养成可持续的生活习惯。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 finire（结束、限制），核心语义为“有边界的、有限度的”。

lemmas.def_en: (botany) a minute rudimentary plant contained within a seed or an archegonium

examples.en: The groundbreaking technology was still in embryo when funding ran out.
examples.zh: 资金耗尽时，这项开创性技术仍处于萌芽阶段。

lemmas.usage_note: 生物学指胚胎；比喻义多用介词短语in embryo，表示事物处于萌芽或初步阶段。

lemmas.def_en: the branch of biology that studies the formation and early development of living organisms

examples.en: Modern embryology offers vital insights into the earliest stages of human development.
examples.zh: 现代胚胎学为人类发育的最早阶段提供了重要的见解。

lemmas.def_en: of an organism prior to birth or hatching
lemmas.def_zh: 萌芽的, 初期的, 未成熟

examples.en: The space startup is still in an embryonic stage and seeking initial funding.
examples.zh: 这家太空初创公司仍处于萌芽阶段，正在寻求首轮融资。

lemmas.def_en: of an organism prior to birth or hatching

examples.en: Pathologists identified an embryonal tumor that required immediate aggressive medical treatment.
examples.zh: 病理学家确诊了一种需要立即进行强力医疗干预的胚胎性肿瘤。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 embryon（在体内生长的），由 en-（在……内）+ bryein（膨胀、发芽）构成，指未成形的早期发育阶段。

lemmas.def_en: a common nonmetallic element that is normally a colorless odorless tasteless inert diatomic gas; constitutes 78 percent of the atmosphere by volume; a constituent of all living tissues

examples.en: Liquid nitrogen is widely used to preserve biological samples at low temperatures.
examples.zh: 液氮被广泛用于低温保存生物样本。

lemmas.usage_note: 化学与农业科学核心词，指氮元素或氮气，常见搭配liquid nitrogen、nitrogen fertilizer。

lemmas.def_en: any compound containing the nitrate group (such as a salt or ester of nitric acid)

examples.en: High concentrations of nitrate in drinking water pose severe health risks.
examples.zh: 饮用水中高浓度的硝酸盐会带来严重的健康隐患。

lemmas.usage_note: 化学与环境学术语，指硝酸盐，常以复数nitrates指水体或土壤中的硝酸盐污染物。

lemmas.def_zh: 氮化合, 氮饱和, 硝化作用
lemmas.def_en: the chemical process in which a nitro group is added to an organic compound (or substituted for another group in an organic compound)

examples.en: Healthy soil bacteria are essential for the natural nitrification process.
examples.zh: 健康的土壤细菌对自然的硝化作用过程至关重要。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or containing nitrogen

examples.en: Farmers apply nitrogenous fertilizers to the soil to boost overall crop yields.
examples.zh: 农民在土壤中施用含氮肥料以提高农作物的总体产量。

lemmas.def_en: treat with nitric acid, so as to change an organic compound into a nitrate

examples.en: Specialized chemists nitrate toluene under tightly controlled laboratory conditions.
examples.zh: 专业化学家在严格受控的实验室条件下硝化甲苯。

lemmas.usage_note: 化学专业及工业术语，表示硝化反应或用硝酸盐处理有机物，及物动词直接接物质名。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 nitron（纯碱、硝石）+ -gen（产生者），因其为硝石的核心构成元素而得名。

lemmas.def_en: a car suitable for traveling over rough terrain

examples.en: They drove a rugged jeep across the muddy terrain.
examples.zh: 他们驾驶一辆坚固的吉普车穿过了泥泞的地形。

lemmas.usage_note: 日常口语中常泛指越野车（四驱车），但作为专有名词 Jeep 指特定品牌，出行搭配如 by jeep 或 in a jeep。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自二战美军对多用途车（GP，General Purpose）的简称或连环画中无所不能的吉祥物名字。

lemmas.def_en: clap one's hands or shout after performances to indicate approval

examples.en: The audience stood up to applaud her breathtaking performance.
examples.zh: 观众起立为她那令人惊叹的演出鼓掌。

lemmas.usage_note: 可表示鼓掌（applaud the performance），更常作书面语表示赞同（applaud the decision），避免加介词 to。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 plaudere（拍手、击打），前缀 ad- 表方向，核心为鼓掌赞赏。

lemmas.def_en: in a vertical position; not sloping
lemmas.def_zh: 正直的, 诚实的, 公正的, 垂直的, 竖式的

examples.en: He was respected throughout the town as an honest and upright judge.
examples.zh: 他因诚实正直作为一名法官而受到全镇人的尊敬。

lemmas.usage_note: 既指物理姿势垂直竖立（sit upright），也指道德品行正直诚实（upright citizen）。

lemmas.def_en: a vertical structural member as a post or stake

examples.en: The football struck the right upright and bounced back into the field.
examples.zh: 足球击中了右立柱，反弹回了球场内。

lemmas.usage_note: 工程、建筑及体育用语，指门柱、立柱或垂直支柱支撑物，常以复数形式出现。

lemmas.def_en: the property of being upright in posture

examples.en: Throughout his political career, he was widely respected for his moral uprightness.
examples.zh: 在整个政治生涯中，他因道德上的正直而受到广泛尊敬。

lemmas.def_en: in an honorable manner

examples.en: The judge served his community uprightly and never accepted any political bribes.
examples.zh: 这位法官正直地服务于社区，从不接受任何政治贿赂。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 up（向上）+ right（笔直）复合而成，引申为空间上的挺拔与道德上的正直。

lemmas.def_en: reason by deduction; establish by deduction

examples.en: We can reasonably infer from the survey results that public opinion is shifting.
examples.zh: 从调查结果中我们可以合理推断出，公众舆论正在发生转变。

lemmas.usage_note: 论证与学术用语，指由证据得出结论，常接that从句或搭配infer from，切忌与imply混淆。

lemmas.def_en: the reasoning involved in drawing a conclusion or making a logical judgment on the basis of circumstantial evidence and prior conclusions rather than on the basis of direct observation

examples.en: Scientists draw a reasonable inference based on the latest laboratory test data.
examples.zh: 科学家根据最新的实验室检测数据得出了一个合理的推论。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or having the nature of illation or inference
lemmas.def_zh: 推理的, 可以推论的, 推理上的

examples.en: Students learned inferential statistics to draw conclusions about the larger population accurately.
examples.zh: 学生们学习推断统计学，以便准确地对更大范围的总体得出结论。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 in-（进入）+ fer（带来，推移），指从已有前提推导结论。

lemmas.def_en: insulting terms of address for people who are stupid or irritating or ridiculous

examples.en: He cursed at the thief, calling him a cowardly motherfucker.
examples.zh: 他咒骂那个小偷，骂他是个懦弱的混蛋。

lemmas.usage_note: 极具攻击性与冒犯性的极度粗俗俚语，用于强烈辱骂他人或表达极度愤怒、震惊，极需慎用。

family_guide.root_logic: 英语极具侮辱性的粗俗复合词，由 mother + fucker 构成，在特定俚语语境中亦可表极度厉害的事物或人。

lemmas.def_en: large black-and-white herbivorous mammal of bamboo forests of China and Tibet; in some classifications considered a member of the bear family or of a separate family Ailuropodidae

examples.en: The giant panda spends most of its day munching on bamboo.
examples.zh: 大熊猫一天中大部分时间都在嚼竹子。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用搭配 giant panda（大熊猫）、red panda（小熊猫）；英式口语中 panda car 特指传统警车。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自尼泊尔语 nigalya-ponya（食竹之物），特指大熊猫或小熊猫。

lemmas.def_en: the molecular weight of a substance expressed in grams; the basic unit of amount of substance adopted under the Systeme International d'Unites
lemmas.def_zh: 鼹鼠；内奸，卧底；痣；防波堤

examples.en: Intelligence agencies suspected that a mole inside the department had been leaking classified files for months.
examples.zh: 情报部门怀疑该部门内部有一名卧底已经泄露机密文件数月之久。

lemmas.usage_note: 多义名词，指动物、生理上的痣、间谍或防波堤；引申指卧底时常搭配 plant a mole 或 unmask a mole。

lemmas.def_en: grinding tooth with a broad crown; located behind the premolars

examples.en: Students calculated the molar concentration of the chemical solution in the chemistry lab.
examples.zh: 学生们在化学实验室里计算了该化学溶液的摩尔浓度。

lemmas.def_en: concentration measured by the number of moles of solute per liter of solution

lemmas.def_zh: 磨碎的, 臼齿的, 摩尔的, 克分子的
lemmas.def_en: of or pertaining to the grinding teeth in the back of a mammal's mouth

examples.en: Students calculated the molar concentration of the chemical solution in the chemistry lab.
examples.zh: 学生们在化学实验室里计算了该化学溶液的摩尔浓度。

family_guide.root_logic: 多源词，可指哺乳动物“鼹鼠”（破土者）、人体“黑痣”（斑点）或工程“防波堤”。

lemmas.def_en: any of several small ungulate mammals of Africa and Asia with rodent-like incisors and feet with hooflike toes
lemmas.def_zh: 地方检察官们（复数）；（德语定冠词中性）

examples.en: The DAs from three counties met to coordinate the investigation.
examples.zh: 来自三个县的地方检察官会面以协调调查行动。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作专有名词缩写（如地区检察官 District Attorneys 的复数），具体语义须严格依赖特定上下文。

lemmas.def_en: an official prosecutor for a judicial district
lemmas.def_zh: 地方检察官（District Attorney的缩写）

examples.en: The DA decided to press charges against the suspect.
examples.zh: 地方检察官决定对嫌疑人提起诉讼。

lemmas.usage_note: 通常大写为 DA，为 District Attorney（地方检察官）的常用缩写，多出现在美剧或法律新闻中。

family_guide.root_logic: da/das 常见于缩写（如 District Attorney）或外来词、冠词，此处指检察官或特定缩写名衔。
family_guide.core_distinction: da通常为单数缩写（如地方检察官District Attorney），das多为其复数形式或特定拼写。

lemmas.def_en: put to use
lemmas.def_zh: 运用，施加（影响、压力等）；竭力

examples.en: Environmental groups are lobbying to exert pressure on the government to reduce carbon emissions.
examples.zh: 环保组织正在进行游说，以对政府施加压力削减碳排放。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常用于正式语境；常见搭配为 exert pressure/influence on（施加压力/影响）以及反身结构 exert oneself（竭尽全力）。

lemmas.def_en: use of physical or mental energy; hard work
lemmas.def_zh: 努力, 发挥, 运用

examples.en: After hours of intense physical exertion, he collapsed happily onto the grass.
examples.zh: 经过数小时剧烈的体力消耗后，他开心地倒在草地上。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 exserere，ex-（出）+ serere（联结），意为使出全部力量或施加影响。

lemmas.def_en: a slowly moving mass of ice

examples.en: Scientists warn that the massive glacier could lose over half its volume by the end of the century.
examples.zh: 科学家警告说，到本世纪末，这座巨大的冰川可能会减少一半以上的体积。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指地质学上的冰川；常与 melting、retreating 或 advancing 等现在分词连用，多见于地理与气候报道。

lemmas.def_zh: 冻结成冰, 冰川作用
lemmas.def_en: the condition of being covered with glaciers or masses of ice; the result of glacial action

examples.en: Agassiz recognized marks of glaciation all over northern Europe

lemmas.def_zh: 冰的, 冰川的, 冰川时代的, 冰冷的
lemmas.def_en: relating to or derived from a glacier

examples.en: Negotiations between the two rival factions proceeded at a glacial pace, yielding little progress.
examples.zh: 两个敌对派系之间的谈判进展极其缓慢，几乎未取得任何进展。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，既可表“冰川的/极冷的”，也可比喻人态度冰冷或速度极其缓慢（如 at a glacial pace）。

lemmas.def_en: by a glacier

examples.en: glacially deposited material

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 glacies（冰），演变为专指高山或极地缓缓移动的巨大冰川。

lemmas.def_en: a standard by which something can be measured or judged

examples.en: This smartphone sets a new benchmark for camera quality.
examples.zh: 这款智能手机为摄像头品质树立了新的基准。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作可数名词，搭配set/establish a benchmark for（为……树立基准），多用于商务与技术语境。

family_guide.root_logic: bench（长凳/工作台）+ mark（标记），原指测量中的基准高程点，引申为评估的标准。

lemmas.def_en: filamentous hairlike growth on a plant
lemmas.def_zh: 细毛, 绒毛, 警察

examples.en: She gently rubbed the soft fuzz on the surface of the freshly picked peach.
examples.zh: 她轻轻揉搓着刚采摘下来的桃子表面的柔软绒毛。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词指植物或衣物上的“绒毛/细毛”；在非正式俚语中加定冠词 the fuzz 可代指“警察”。

lemmas.def_zh: (fuzzy 的复数) a. 有微毛的, 模糊的

examples.en: Watching the rescued puppy play gave everyone warm fuzzies all afternoon.
examples.zh: 看着获救的小狗玩耍，让大家整个下午心里都暖洋洋的。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of being indistinct and without sharp outlines

examples.en: The slight fuzziness of the print made the small letters hard to read.
examples.zh: 打印字迹略显模糊，导致那些小字很难看清。

lemmas.def_en: covering with fine light hairs

examples.en: Without my glasses, the text on the distant signboard appeared completely fuzzy.
examples.zh: 没戴眼镜，远处指示牌上的文字在我看来完全是模糊的。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，常修饰织物表面多绒毛，或引申表示图像不清晰、思维/记忆模糊（fuzzy memory/thinking）。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声兼象形来源，指毛茸茸的细毛，引申为模糊不清的状态或俚语指警察。
family_guide.core_distinction: fuzz 为名词（绒毛、模糊）；fuzzy 为形容词（起毛的、模糊不清的）。

lemmas.def_en: feel grief

examples.en: The entire nation paused to grieve for the brave soldiers who lost their lives in the conflict.
examples.zh: 举国肃立，为在冲突中失去生命的英勇士兵们哀悼。

lemmas.usage_note: 可作不及物动词常接 for/over 表示为某人哀悼；作及物动词表示“使伤心”，正式语境中情感色彩强烈。

lemmas.def_en: a person who is feeling grief (as grieving over someone who has died)

examples.en: The support counselor sat quietly beside the silent griever during the memorial.
examples.zh: 纪念仪式期间，心理疏导师静静地坐在沉默的悲痛者身旁。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 gravare（加重），经古法语进入英语，表示内心承受极大的悲伤负担。

lemmas.def_en: sexually attracted to both sexes
lemmas.def_zh: 两性的, 雌雄同体的

examples.en: The documentary explores the personal journeys and social challenges faced by bisexual youth.
examples.zh: 这部纪录片探讨了双性恋青年所经历的个人历程与社会挑战。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，在社会学中指“双性恋的”，在生物学中指“雌雄同株/同体的”，属于中性客观测绘词汇。

lemmas.def_en: a person who is sexually attracted to both sexes

examples.en: The community support group provides a safe and inclusive space for bisexuals to share their stories.
examples.zh: 该社区支持小组为双性恋群体提供了一个安全包容的空间来分享他们的故事。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指具有双性恋倾向的人或生物学上的雌雄同体生物，复数形式直接加 -s。

lemmas.def_en: showing characteristics of both sexes

examples.en: The documentary explores how attitudes toward bisexuality have shifted over decades.
examples.zh: 这部纪录片探讨了数十年来人们对双性恋态度的转变。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 bi-（双）+ sexual（性的），指兼具两性吸引或双重性倾向。

lemmas.def_en: give in, as to influence or pressure
lemmas.def_zh: 变宽厚, 变温和, 动怜悯之心

examples.en: After hours of persistent pleading from his daughter, the father finally relented and let her go to the concert.
examples.zh: 在女儿苦苦央求数小时后，父亲终于心软，同意让她去听音乐会。

lemmas.usage_note: 不及物动词，指态度由严厉变温和、心软让步，亦可形容恶劣天气减弱；常与 finally 或 eventually 连用。

lemmas.def_en: not to be placated or appeased or moved by entreaty
lemmas.def_zh: 无情的, 冷酷的, 残酷的

examples.en: The journalist earned widespread respect for her relentless pursuit of the truth behind the scandal.
examples.zh: 这位记者因对丑闻背后真相的不懈追查而赢得了广泛尊重。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，形容压力、攻击、烈日或追求“毫不留情的/持续且不松懈的”，常搭配 pursuit、pressure、heat。

lemmas.def_en: in a relentless manner
lemmas.def_zh: 不仁慈, 严酷, 无情, 坚韧, 不懈, 不屈不挠

examples.en: The team worked relentlessly through the night to meet the strict deadline.
examples.zh: 团队通宵达旦地不懈工作，以赶上严苛的截止日期。

lemmas.def_en: mercilessness characterized by an unwillingness to relent or let up

examples.en: Her sheer relentlessness in pursuing justice inspired the entire legal team.
examples.zh: 她在追求正义过程中表现出的不屈不挠激励了整个法律团队。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 re-（强化/回）+ lentus（柔软、迟缓），意为变温和、放缓苛刻态度。
family_guide.core_distinction: relent 为动词（妥协、变温和）；relentless 为派生形容词（不间断的、无情的）。

lemmas.def_en: contemplation of things past

examples.en: In retrospect, buying the property before the market peaked was the best financial decision he ever made.
examples.zh: 回想起来，在市场见顶前买下那处房产是他做过的最明智的财务决定。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，绝大多数情况下用于固定介词短语 in retrospect（回想起来，事后看来），作句首插入语或状语。

lemmas.def_en: an exhibition of a representative selection of an artist's life work

examples.en: The museum is hosting a major retrospective of the famous artist's career.
examples.zh: 该博物馆正在举办这位著名艺术家职业生涯的大型回顾展。

lemmas.def_en: reference to things past
lemmas.def_zh: 回顾, 追忆, 反省

examples.en: In quiet retrospection, she realized how much she had grown that year.
examples.zh: 在静心反思中，她意识到自己那一年成长了许多。

lemmas.def_en: in a manner contemplative of past events

examples.en: The newly passed tax regulation will not be applied retrospectively to past earnings.
examples.zh: 新通过的税收法规将不追溯适用于过去的收入。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 retro-（向后）+ spect（看），本义为“向后看”，引申为回顾或反顾。

lemmas.def_en: a score in baseball made by a runner touching all four bases safely
lemmas.def_zh: 符木, 记账, 得分, 比分, 计数器, 标签, 符合, 对应物

examples.en: The committee kept a running tally of donations received throughout the charity event.
examples.zh: 委员会对整个慈善活动期间收到的捐款进行了实时记录统计。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，指记录的账目、比分或计数总额；常见搭配包括 keep a tally of（保持记录）或 final tally（最终结果）。

lemmas.def_en: be compatible, similar or consistent; coincide in their characteristics
lemmas.def_zh: 记录, 点数, 计算, 加标签于, 使符合；记帐, 符合, 吻合, 记分

examples.en: His description of the accident did not tally with the footage captured by the security camera.
examples.zh: 他对事故的描述与监控录像拍下的画面并不相符。

lemmas.usage_note: 动词，及物时表示“点数、核对”，不及物时常与 with 搭配（tally with），表示数据、说法“相符、吻合”。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 talea（木棍），指古代在木棍上刻痕记账，引申为计数、账目及与记录吻合。

lemmas.def_en: take revenge for a perceived wrong

examples.en: The military vowed to retaliate against any cross-border drone incursions with decisive force.
examples.zh: 军方誓言将以决定性的武力对任何越境无人机入侵进行反击。

lemmas.usage_note: 不及物动词，指对攻击或侮辱进行报复；常见搭配为 retaliate against sb（对某人报复）或 retaliate with/by（以……反击）。

lemmas.def_en: action taken in return for an injury or offense

examples.en: The government imposed heavy tariffs on imports in retaliation for the trade sanctions.
examples.zh: 该国政府对进口商品加征重税，以作为对贸易制裁的报复。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，常用于正式或时政语境；高频搭配为 in retaliation for（作为对……的报复）和 fear of retaliation（害怕报复）。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or having the nature of retribution

examples.en: The government launched retaliatory air strikes following the border attack yesterday.
examples.zh: 在昨天的边境袭击发生后，政府发动了报复性空袭。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 re-（回）+ tali-（以牙还牙、同等对待）+ -ate，表示“以同样手段还击”。
family_guide.core_distinction: retaliate 是动词形式，表示反击；retaliation 是其名词形式，表示报复行为。

lemmas.def_en: remove with or as if with a ladle

examples.en: The dockworkers began to lade the cargo ship with crates of fresh fruit.
examples.zh: 码头工人们开始把一箱箱新鲜水果装上货船。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用于航运或海事语境，常与介词 with 连用，表示给船只等交通工具装载货物。

lemmas.def_en: remove with or as if with a ladle

examples.en: They had laden the vessel with timber before the severe storm struck.
examples.zh: 在暴风雨来临之前，他们已经给货船装满了木材。

lemmas.usage_note: 作为动词 lade 的过去分词，常在完成时或被动语态中构成谓语，表示已被装载。

lemmas.def_en: filled with a great quantity
lemmas.def_zh: 装满的, 负载的, 苦恼的

examples.en: The boughs of the apple tree were heavily laden with ripe fruit.
examples.zh: 苹果树的枝头沉甸甸地挂满了成熟的果实。

lemmas.usage_note: 作形容词用，常作后置修饰语或表语，搭配 with 表示满载重物或心怀沉重负担。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 hladan（装载、汲取），现代多用于航运装载货物或以分词形容词形式表“充满/承载”。
family_guide.core_distinction: lade 为原形动词（现少见），laden 可作 lade 的过去分词，更常独立作形容词表示“满载的、沉重的”。

lemmas.def_en: feelings of excessive pride

examples.en: His obsession with designer clothes stemmed purely from personal vanity.
examples.zh: 他对名牌服装的痴迷纯粹源于个人的虚荣心。

lemmas.usage_note: 指对自身外貌或成就的自负，也指空虚无价值的事物；常用搭配如 vanity project。
