examples.en: We were too tired to cook fresh dinner, so we just warmed up the leftovers in the fridge.
examples.zh: 我们累得不想做新饭，所以就热了热冰箱里的剩菜。

lemmas.usage_note: 通常用复数形式 leftovers，特指上一餐吃剩的饭菜；常与 eat、heat up 搭配，属于生活口语。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 leftover 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: matter that has been deposited by some natural process

examples.en: A thick layer of sediment had settled at the bottom of the ancient wine bottle.
examples.zh: 那个陈年酒瓶的底部沉淀了一层厚厚的杂质。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，指液体底部的沉淀物或地质沉积物；常与 riverbed、layer of 搭配，属科技与地理词汇。

lemmas.def_en: the phenomenon of sediment or gravel accumulating
deposit as a sediment

examples.en: The suspended particles slowly sediment out when the liquid is allowed to stand still.
examples.zh: 当液体静置时，悬浮颗粒会慢慢沉降出来。

lemmas.usage_note: 作动词（亦可作及物），指物质沉积或使沉降，在化学、地质及工程专业文本中作被动或不及物使用。

lemmas.def_zh: 沉渣的, 沉淀物的, 由沉淀物所生成的
lemmas.def_en: resembling or containing or formed by the accumulation of sediment

examples.en: Geologists discovered rare fossils preserved inside the layers of sedimentary rock.
examples.zh: 地质学家在沉积岩层中发现了保存完好的珍稀化石。

lemmas.usage_note: 专业科学词汇，专指由沉积作用形成的；核心搭配为 sedimentary rock（沉积岩），多见于地质学语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sediment 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an unshaved growth of hair on the upper lip

examples.en: The detective rubbed his gray mustache while carefully examining the mysterious note.
examples.zh: 侦探一边仔细检查那张神秘的纸条，一边摸着灰白的胡子。

lemmas.usage_note: 专指嘴唇上方的“八字胡”，英式常拼作 moustache；常与 grow/trim/shave a mustache 搭配，区分于下巴的 beard。

lemmas.def_zh: 髭, 小胡子, 触须
lemmas.def_en: an unshaved growth of hair on the upper lip

examples.en: he looked younger after he shaved off his mustache

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mustache 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 即将来临的, 逼近的
lemmas.def_en: close in time; about to occur

examples.en: Residents along the coast were evacuated due to the imminent threat of a hurricane.
examples.zh: 由于飓风迫在眉睫的威胁，沿海居民被紧急疏散。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用于形容不祥、危机或不可避免的事件即将发生；常修饰 danger、disaster 或 arrival，语体严肃。

lemmas.def_en: in an imminent manner

lemmas.def_zh: 逼近, 危急, 迫近的危险, 急迫
lemmas.def_en: the state of being imminent and liable to happen soon

examples.en: Sirens wailed across the city to warn citizens of the imminence of the storm.
examples.zh: 警报在全城响起，提醒市民暴风雨即将来临。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 imminent 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 轨道, 弹道, 轨线
lemmas.def_en: the path followed by an object moving through space

examples.en: Calculations showed that the missile changed its flight trajectory before reaching the target.
examples.zh: 计算表明导弹在到达目标前改变了飞行轨迹。

lemmas.usage_note: 除物理弹道外，常比喻“发展轨迹”，常见搭配 career/economic trajectory，正式度高，用于学术及政经分析。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 trajectory 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 范例, 式样, 词形变化表, 纵聚合关系语言项
lemmas.def_en: systematic arrangement of all the inflected forms of a word

examples.en: The discovery of quantum mechanics caused a major paradigm shift in modern physics.
examples.zh: 量子力学的发现引发了现代物理学的一场重大范式转变。

lemmas.usage_note: 指思维模式、研究范式或经典范例；核心搭配 paradigm shift（范式转变），高频用于学术理论与商业分析。

lemmas.def_zh: 模范的, 例证的, 纵聚合的, 词形变化的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to a grammatical paradigm

examples.en: This classic historic novel is often considered a paradigmatic example of gothic literature.
examples.zh: 这部经典的由历史小说常被视作哥特文学的典范之作。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 paradigm 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: material for starting a fire

examples.en: The dry pine needles made excellent tinder for starting their evening campfire.
examples.zh: 干燥的松针是生起傍晚营火的极佳引火物。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，本义为“引火物”，常比喻“一触即发的导火索/火药桶”，注意首字母大写时多特指同名交友软件。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tinder 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 芥末, 芥菜, 强烈的兴趣
lemmas.def_en: any of several cruciferous plants of the genus Brassica

examples.en: She spread a generous layer of spicy mustard onto her roast beef sandwich.
examples.zh: 她在烤牛肉三明治上抹了厚厚一层辣芥末。

lemmas.usage_note: 指“芥末/芥菜”，常用于习语 cut the mustard（符合标准/达到预期）或修饰颜色 mustard yellow，口语和饮食中常用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mustard 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: denoting a quantity consisting of one more than eight and one less than ten

examples.en: Chapter IX of the ancient manuscript describes the reign of the third emperor.
examples.zh: 这份古代手稿的第九章描述了第三位皇帝的统治。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作为罗马数字'9'的符号形式使用，多见于章节编号、钟表刻度或正式典籍的序号标记中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ix 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 刻痕于, 伤害, 镇压, 妨碍
lemmas.def_en: hinder or prevent (the efforts, plans, or desires) of

examples.en: The minister issued a public statement to scotch rumors about his sudden resignation.
examples.zh: 部长发表了一份公开声明，以平息有关他突然辞职的谣言。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面语动词，常搭配 scotch a rumor/plan，意为“彻底平息谣言或挫败计划”，不可与苏格兰威士忌混淆。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 scotch 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: small dark geese that breed in the north and migrate southward

examples.en: Global energy markets reacted sharply as Brent crude oil prices rose again today.
examples.zh: 随着布伦特原油价格今天再次上涨，全球能源市场反应剧烈。

lemmas.usage_note: 财经金融常用词，常以专有名词出现，固定搭配 Brent crude（布伦特原油），多用于大宗商品市场分析。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 brent 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or being a communications network in which the bandwidth can be divided and shared by multiple simultaneous signals (as for voice or data or video)

examples.en: The rural village finally gained access to high-speed broadband connections last month.
examples.zh: 这个偏远村庄上个月终于用上了高速宽带网络。

lemmas.usage_note: 科技通信常用词，多作定语修饰名词，常见搭配 broadband access/network/connection（宽带接入/网络）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 broadband 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 原子尘的降下, 辐射性微尘, 原子尘, 附带结果
lemmas.def_en: the radioactive particles that settle to the ground after a nuclear explosion

examples.en: The political fallout from the scandal forced the minister to resign immediately.
examples.zh: 这起丑闻带来的政治负面后果迫使该部长立即辞职。

lemmas.usage_note: 常引申指重大事件的“附带负面后果”，固定搭配 economic/political fallout from sth，避免与普通result混用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fallout 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: equally distant from the extremes

examples.en: We stopped for lunch at a midway rest area along the highway.
examples.zh: 我们在高速公路中途的一个休息区停下来吃午饭。

lemmas.usage_note: 作形容词常作前置定语或表语，常见搭配 midway point/stage（中途点/中段），强调空间或时间居中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 midway 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the 12th letter of the Greek alphabet

examples.en: The Greek letter mu is commonly used in physics to denote micro.
examples.zh: 希腊字母 mu 在物理学中通常用来表示“微”。

lemmas.usage_note: 希腊字母μ，在物理与工程学中常作为微米单位前缀或表示摩擦系数，多用于专业学术与科技文本。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mu 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a journey by a large group to escape from a hostile environment

examples.en: Rising housing costs prompted a mass exodus of young professionals from the city.
examples.zh: 不断上涨的房价促使大批年轻专业人士离开了这座城市。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面正式用语，常指大规模离开，固定搭配 a mass exodus of sb from... to...，带有宏大叙事色彩。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 exodus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the state of being total and complete

examples.en: I spent the weekend listening to the symphonic album in its entirety.
examples.zh: 我花了一整个周末完整地听完了整张交响乐专辑。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式书面语，绝大多数情况下用于介词短语 in its entirety（完整地、全部地），通常替代completely以增强庄重感。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 entirety 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: counting backward from an arbitrary number to indicate the time remaining before some event (such as launching a space vehicle)

examples.en: The crowd began the final countdown to midnight with great excitement.
examples.zh: 人群怀着激动的心情开始了午夜前的最后倒计时。

lemmas.usage_note: 可作具体发射倒计时或引申为临近时段，固定搭配 the countdown to sth / begin the countdown（进入倒计时）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 countdown 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: completely; used as intensifiers

examples.en: The stray golf ball landed plumb in the middle of our picnic blanket.
examples.zh: 那颗偏离轨道的流弹高尔夫球恰好落在了我们野餐垫的正中央。

lemmas.usage_note: 作副词，意为“完全地、恰好”，常与 in the middle、crazy 等搭配，多见于美式口语与非正式文体。

lemmas.def_zh: 使垂直, 探测；成垂直
lemmas.def_en: measure the depth of something

examples.en: The poet sought to plumb the depths of human sorrow through her poignant verses.
examples.zh: 这位诗人试图通过她凄切的诗句探索人类悲伤的深渊。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可指测量深度，常引申为深入探索复杂情感或奥秘；常搭配 the depths of，属于书面文雅表达。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 plumb 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 分裂, 崩溃, 解散, 解体
lemmas.def_en: the termination or disintegration of a relationship (between persons or nations)

examples.en: The breakup of the telecom monopoly led to much cheaper service rates.
examples.zh: 电信垄断企业的解体带来了更便宜的服务资费。

lemmas.usage_note: 合成名词，既可指恋人分手，也可指组织/国家解体，常见搭配 the breakup of a marriage/relationship/company。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 breakup 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 犯错, 堕落, 减退, 消失, 流逝；使失效
lemmas.def_en: pass into a specified state or condition

examples.en: His gym membership lapsed after he failed to renew it for three consecutive months.
examples.zh: 因为连续三个月没有续费，他的健身房会员资格失效了。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指合同、权利因期满而失效，或指习惯、状态逐渐陷入某种不良境界；常与 into 搭配，正式语体。

lemmas.def_zh: 过失, 流逝, 失效
lemmas.def_en: a mistake resulting from inattention

examples.en: A momentary lapse in concentration caused the driver to miss the highway exit.
examples.zh: 一瞬间的注意力不集中导致司机错过了高速公路出口。

lemmas.usage_note: 指短暂的过失、注意力疏忽或时间的流逝；高频搭配 a lapse of concentration、lapse of time，通俗正式皆宜。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lapse 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 窝, 穴, 插座, 眼窝
lemmas.def_en: a bony hollow into which a structure fits

examples.en: Make sure you plug the heavy appliance securely into the wall socket.
examples.zh: 确保将大功率电器牢固地插入墙上的插座中。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指“电源插座”（wall socket），亦可指身体“窝/穴”（eye socket）；接插头常与 plug into 搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 socket 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 资金筹集活动; 筹款人
lemmas.def_en: someone who solicits financial contributions

examples.en: The annual charity fundraiser gathered thousands of dollars for the local hospital.
examples.zh: 一年一度的慈善筹款活动为当地医院筹集了数千美元。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可指“筹款活动”（hold/host a fundraiser），也可指“筹款人”，注意依上下文区分活动或人。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fundraiser 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 解除武装, 裁军, 缓和；放下武器
lemmas.def_en: remove offensive capability from

examples.en: Her warm smile managed to disarm the angry customer immediately.
examples.zh: 她温暖的微笑立刻化解了那位愤怒顾客的敌意。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作及物或不及物动词，既指缴械、裁军，也引申指消除敌意；常搭配 disarm the militia 或 disarm critics。

lemmas.def_en: act of reducing or depriving of arms

examples.en: the disarmament of the aggressor nations must be complete

family_guide.root_logic: 以 disarm 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a road leading up to a private house

examples.en: A thick layer of fresh snow covered the driveway early this morning.
examples.zh: 今天清晨，厚厚的一层新雪覆盖了车道。

lemmas.usage_note: 特指连接住宅与公共道路的“私人车道”，常与 park in the driveway 搭配，非公共行驶道路。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 driveway 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a specific piece of work required to be done as a duty or for a specific fee

examples.en: Washing the dishes after dinner is my least favorite daily chore.
examples.zh: 晚饭后洗碗是我最不喜欢的日常家务。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用复数 household chores（家务杂事）；单数常比喻“令人厌烦但必须做的事”，如 a real chore。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chore 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 使复原, 使恢复, 使复立
lemmas.def_en: restore to the previous state or rank

examples.en: The board decided to reinstate the dismissed manager after reviewing the evidence.
examples.zh: 董事会在复查证据后，决定恢复这位被解雇经理的职务。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式及物动词，指恢复职位、制度或法律效力，常接 reinstate sb as... 或 reinstate a policy。

lemmas.def_zh: [经] 恢复, 补足(保险), 恢复原状
lemmas.def_en: the condition of being reinstated

examples.en: her reinstatement to her former office followed quickly

family_guide.root_logic: 以 reinstate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a flatbottom boat for carrying heavy loads (especially on canals)

examples.en: A heavy barge carrying tons of coal moved slowly down the canal.
examples.zh: 一艘运载着数吨煤炭的笨重驳船在运河上缓缓行驶。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指内河运输重型货物的平底驳船，常与 canal、cargo 连用，属交通航运用语。

lemmas.def_en: someone who operates a barge

lemmas.def_zh: 用船运输；蹒跚, 闯入
lemmas.def_en: push one's way

examples.en: He barged into the conference room without even knocking on the door.
examples.zh: 他甚至连门都没敲就莽撞地闯进了会议室。

lemmas.usage_note: 不及物动词，口语中常与 into 或 in 连用，表示莽撞地闯入或粗鲁打断，含贬义色彩。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 barge 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a chemical used to kill pests (as rodents or insects)

examples.en: Organic farmers avoid using any synthetic pesticide to protect the local environment.
examples.zh: 有机农户避免使用任何合成杀虫剂以保护当地环境。

lemmas.usage_note: 集合与可数均可，常与 spray/use pesticides 或 pesticide residue（农药残留）连用，偏科技与农业语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pesticide 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: be greater in scope or size than some standard

examples.en: Great art has the power to transcend cultural and linguistic barriers.
examples.zh: 伟大的艺术拥有跨越文化与语言障碍的力量。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面及物动词，指超出人类经验、理性或界限，常搭配 transcend boundaries、differences 或 limits。

lemmas.def_zh: 卓越的, 出类拔萃的, 超常的
lemmas.def_en: exceeding or surpassing usual limits especially in excellence

lemmas.def_zh: 超越, 卓越, 卓绝
lemmas.def_en: a state of being or existence above and beyond the limits of material experience

family_guide.root_logic: 以 transcend 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: strike with disgust or revulsion

examples.en: The terrible working conditions in the factory appalled the international inspectors.
examples.zh: 工厂极其恶劣的工作条件令国际核查人员感到震惊与骇然。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词（美式多作 appall），表示使极其震惊或反感，极常用于被动语态 be appalled by/at。

lemmas.def_en: to an appalling extent

examples.en: the prisoners were appallingly thin

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 令人震惊的；骇人听闻的；极糟糕的
lemmas.def_en: causing shock or dismay; horrific; of very bad quality
lemmas.usage_note: 既可指灾难性、令人恐怖的事件，口语中也常指质量或表现极差，如 appalling conditions / weather。

examples.en: The prisoners were kept in appalling conditions with little food or water.
examples.zh: 囚犯们被关在极其恶劣的环境中，几乎没有食物和水。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 appal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: make powerless and unable to function

examples.en: The unexpected transit strike threatened to paralyze the entire downtown area.
examples.zh: 突如其来的交通罢工可能导致整个市中心陷入瘫痪。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用被动语态，除生理“瘫痪”外，常比喻系统或交通“陷入瘫痪”（be paralyzed by traffic/fear）。

lemmas.def_zh: 使麻痹, 使瘫痪, 使无力, 使气馁, 终止
lemmas.def_en: make powerless and unable to function

examples.en: The bureaucracy paralyzes the entire operation

family_guide.root_logic: 以 paralyze 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a motor hotel

examples.en: We decided to stay at a cheap motel by the highway overnight.
examples.zh: 我们决定在公路旁的一家廉价汽车旅馆过夜。

lemmas.usage_note: 指汽车旅馆，常与 stay at a motel 搭配；专指路边为驾车者提供停车位的经济型住宿，不可与豪华 hotel 混用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 motel 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (astronomy) any of the small solid extraterrestrial bodies that hits the earth's atmosphere

examples.en: We looked up and saw a bright meteor streak across the midnight sky.
examples.zh: 我们抬头看到一颗明亮的流星划过午夜的夜空。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指划过大气层的流星，也可用作修饰语表示迅速崛起或消逝，如 meteor shower。

lemmas.def_zh: 流星的, 疾速的, 大气的
lemmas.def_en: of or pertaining to atmospheric phenomena, especially weather and weather conditions

examples.en: meteorological factors
meteorological chart

family_guide.root_logic: 以 meteor 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a gay festivity

examples.en: The charity held an annual gala to raise funds for local schools.
examples.zh: 该慈善机构举办了一场年度盛会，为当地学校筹集资金。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作名词或修饰词，如 a charity gala（慈善晚会）或 a gala dinner；多用于正式或喜庆的大型文艺演出与盛会。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gala 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an instance of questioning

examples.en: The hotel reception received an enquiry about room availability for next weekend.
examples.zh: 酒店前台收到了一份关于下周末是否有空房的咨询。

lemmas.usage_note: 英式英语常用拼写（美式常作 inquiry），指一般性询问，常搭配 make an enquiry about 或 receive enquiries。

lemmas.def_en: someone who asks a question
inquire about

examples.en: She called the hospital directly to enquire about her grandfather's medical condition.
examples.zh: 她直接致电医院询问她祖父的病情。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 enquiry 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 溅出, 踏着泥泞前进；使溢出, 使溅出, 弄脏
lemmas.def_en: cause or allow (a liquid substance) to run or flow from a container

examples.en: Take care not to slop hot soup over the edge of the bowl.
examples.zh: 小心别把热汤晃出来溅到碗边外面。

lemmas.usage_note: 可及物或不及物，指液体晃荡溢出或泼洒，常搭配 slop over、slop onto 或 slop around。

lemmas.def_zh: 泥泞的, 潮湿的, 粗心的
lemmas.def_en: lacking neatness or order

examples.en: The manager criticized the accountant for his sloppy work and frequent calculation errors.
examples.zh: 经理批评了该会计工作马虎且频出计算错误。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，常用于非正式语体，形容做事马虎粗心或衣着邋遢，常见搭配 sloppy work 或 sloppy handwriting。

lemmas.def_en: the wetness of ground that is covered or soaked with water

examples.en: the baseball game was canceled because of the wateriness of the outfield
the water's muddiness made it undrinkable

lemmas.def_en: in a sloppy manner

examples.en: this work was done rather sloppily

family_guide.root_logic: 以 slop 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: cause to burn or combust

examples.en: Dry leaves can easily combust when exposed to intense heat and sparks.
examples.zh: 干燥的树叶在暴露于高温和火星时极易燃烧。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式动词，及物或不及物皆可，指化学上的燃烧过程，或引申为暴怒；属科技或书面语体。

lemmas.def_en: a process in which a substance reacts with oxygen to give heat and light

examples.en: Oxygen is necessary to support combustion during the chemical process.
examples.zh: 在化学反应过程中，氧气对于支持燃烧是必不可少的。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，科学与工业用语，指燃烧反应，极常搭配 internal combustion engine（内燃机）。

lemmas.def_en: a substance that can be burned to provide heat or power
not capable of igniting and burning
supporting combustion

family_guide.root_logic: 以 combust 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an advocate of Marxism

examples.en: The professor introduced a Marxist perspective on nineteenth-century industrial labor history.
examples.zh: 教授介绍了关于19世纪工业劳工史的马克思主义视角。

lemmas.usage_note: 政治学术词，可作名词（马克思主义者）或形容词（如 Marxist theory/analysis）；首字母通常须大写以示规范。

lemmas.def_en: the economic and political theories of Karl Marx and Friedrich Engels that hold that human actions and institutions are economically determined and that class struggle is needed to create historical change and that capitalism will ultimately be superseded by communism

examples.en: The professor dedicated his entire academic career to the detailed study of Marxism.
examples.zh: 这位教授毕生致力于对马克思主义的深入学术研究。

lemmas.usage_note: 政治哲学专有名词，指“马克思主义”，常搭配 adhere to / study Marxism；书面语首字母必须大写。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 marxist 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a subdivision of a larger religious group

examples.en: A breakaway sect established its own isolated community in the mountains.
examples.zh: 一个脱离出来的宗派在深山中建立了自己孤立的社区。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指宗教宗派或政治小派系，常含排他或孤立之意，多与 religious 或 breakaway 连用。

lemmas.def_zh: 宗派的, 党派的, 偏狭的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or characteristic of a sect or sects

examples.en: The government struggled to defuse rising sectarian tensions between the two factions.
examples.zh: 政府竭力缓解两派之间不断升级的宗派紧张局势。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，修饰派系的、狭隘的争端，常搭配 sectarian violence、sectarian conflict 或 sectarian divide。

lemmas.def_en: not restricted to one sect or school or party; ; ; - Bertrand Russell

examples.en: religious training in a nonsectarian atmosphere
nonsectarian colleges

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sect 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of various organs that synthesize substances needed by the body and release it through ducts or directly into the bloodstream

examples.en: The thyroid gland plays a crucial role in regulating the body's metabolic rate.
examples.zh: 甲状腺在调节人体新陈代谢率方面起着至关重要的作用。

lemmas.usage_note: 解剖学与医学核心词汇，指分泌激素或液体的腺体，常用于 thyroid/sweat gland 等固定搭配。

lemmas.def_zh: 腺的, 含腺的, 天生的, 固有的, 肉体的
lemmas.def_en: relating to or affecting or functioning as a gland

examples.en: The doctor examined the patient to see if there was any glandular swelling.
examples.zh: 医生为病人做了检查，看是否存在腺体肿胀。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gland 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 欺诈的, 不正的, 不诚实的
lemmas.def_en: intended to deceive; ; ;  - S.T.Coleridge

examples.en: The company was fined heavily for submitting fraudulent insurance claims.
examples.zh: 该公司因提交虚假保险索赔而被处以巨额罚款。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式法律与商业用语，常修饰 transaction、claim、practice 等名词，表示通过欺诈手段获取利益的。

lemmas.def_en: in a dishonest and fraudulent manner

examples.en: this money was fraudulently obtained

lemmas.def_en: a fraudulent or duplicitous representation

examples.en: The audit exposed widespread fraudulence within the accounting department of the firm.
examples.zh: 审计揭露了该公​​司会计部门内部普遍存在的欺诈行为。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fraudulent 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: not exact

examples.en: The article was criticized for publishing inaccurate data regarding the economic forecast.
examples.zh: 该文章因发布有关经济预测的不准确数据而受到批评。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰 information、data、report 等，表示包含错误或不符合事实，侧重精度偏差或虚假内容。

lemmas.def_zh: 不精密地, 不准确地
lemmas.def_en: in an inaccurate manner

examples.en: this student works rather inaccurately and sloppily

family_guide.root_logic: 以 inaccurate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 虚度时光, 拉小提琴；拉小提琴, (无目的地)拨弄, 瞎搞
lemmas.def_en: avoid (one's assigned duties)

examples.en: He nervously fiddled with his pen while waiting for the interview to begin.
examples.zh: 在等待面试开始时，他紧张地摆弄着手中的笔。

lemmas.usage_note: 常接介词 with，表示无目的地摆弄把玩物件；在英式英语中也指伪造数据或虚度光阴。

lemmas.def_zh: 拉提琴的人, 游荡者, 骗子
lemmas.def_en: a musician who plays the violin

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fiddle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: one-hundredth of a right angle

examples.en: As a recent college grad, she is actively searching for entry-level jobs.
examples.zh: 作为一名刚毕业的大学生，她正在积极寻找入门级工作。

lemmas.usage_note: 美式非正式用语，常作名词修饰语如 grad student，泛指各级毕业生或校友。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 grad 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the act of giving an account describing incidents or a course of events

examples.en: She bought several skeins of wool yarn to knit a warm sweater for winter.
examples.zh: 她买了几绞羊毛纱线，准备为冬天织一件暖和的毛衣。

lemmas.usage_note: 指织造用的纱线；在非正式语体中也常指引人入胜的漫长历险故事，搭配 spin a yarn。

lemmas.def_en: tell or spin a yarn

examples.en: The old fishermen sat on the dock, yarning about their adventures on the high seas.
examples.zh: 老渔民们坐在码头上，滔滔不绝地讲述着公海上的冒险故事。

lemmas.usage_note: 非正式动词，指闲聊、漫谈或讲述奇闻轶事，常见于澳式或英式口语表达。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 yarn 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (mathematics) of or pertaining to the geometry of affine transformations

examples.en: An affine transformation preserves collinearity and the ratios of distances between points.
examples.zh: 仿射变换能保持共线性以及点之间的距离比率。

lemmas.usage_note: 主要用于数学及几何学专业语境，如 affine transformation（仿射变换），表示保持平行关系的几何性质。

lemmas.def_zh: 吸引, 姻亲关系, 类同
lemmas.def_en: (immunology) the attraction between an antigen and an antibody

examples.en: From an early age, she felt a natural affinity for classical music.
examples.zh: 她自幼便对古典音乐有一种天然的亲近感。

lemmas.usage_note: 常接介词 for/with/between，既可表示对某事物的天然喜好与共鸣，也可指物种或概念间的紧密相似性。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 affine 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: form into flakes

examples.en: The old white paint on the wooden door has started to flake off.
examples.zh: 木门上陈旧的白漆已经开始一片片剥落。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与 off/away 连用，表示油漆、皮肤等呈薄片状剥落或脱落；口语中 flake out 表示失约或昏睡。

lemmas.def_zh: 薄片的, 成片的, 薄而易剥落的
lemmas.def_en: made of or resembling flakes

examples.en: The chef baked a delicious French pastry with a light and flaky crust.
examples.zh: 厨师烤制了一款美味的法式糕点，外皮酥脆起酥。

lemmas.def_en: made of or resembling flakes

examples.en: flaky soap

lemmas.def_en: informal terms for insanity

family_guide.root_logic: 以 flake 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an abundant tasteless odorless multivalent nonmetallic element; best known in yellow crystals; occurs in many sulphide and sulphate minerals and even in native form (especially in volcanic regions)

examples.en: Volcanoes often emit large quantities of sulfur and other toxic gases into the atmosphere.
examples.zh: 火山经常向大气中喷发出大量的硫和其他有毒气体。

lemmas.usage_note: 化学与工业基础词汇，指化学元素硫，常与 dioxide、emission 等搭配用于环保及地质科学语境。

lemmas.def_zh: 硫磺的；含多量硫磺的；含（六价）硫的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or containing sulfur

examples.en: sulphuric esters

lemmas.def_en: of or related to or containing sulfur or derived from sulfur

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sulfur 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 骗, 瞒, 驾驶, 移动；当赛马的骑师
lemmas.def_en: defeat someone through trickery or deceit

examples.en: Several ambitious politicians are trying to jockey for power within the party.
examples.zh: 几位野心勃勃的政客正试图在党内争夺权力。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与 for 连用，jockey for position 指争夺有利地位，多用于政治、商业竞争等语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 jockey 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 骑兵, 骑警, 伞兵
lemmas.def_en: a soldier in a motorized army unit

examples.en: A state trooper pulled the speeding car over to the road shoulder.
examples.zh: 一名州警将超速行驶的汽车拦到了路肩上。

lemmas.usage_note: 指骑警或装甲兵；口语习语 a real trooper 形容某人坚韧不拔、任劳任怨，注意勿拼作 trouper。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 trooper 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 野马, (海军行伍出身的)军官
lemmas.def_en: small hardy range horse of the western plains descended from horses brought by the Spanish

examples.en: A wild mustang galloped freely across the vast and open dusty plains.
examples.zh: 一匹野马在广阔无垠的尘土飞扬的平原上自由奔驰。

lemmas.usage_note: 特指北美平原的野马，常见于西部文化与文学中；现代语境常借指强劲自由的象征或特定跑车。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mustang 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 使浸水, 使陷入, 淹没；潜入水中
lemmas.def_en: sink below the surface; go under or as if under water

examples.en: The floodwaters rose rapidly, submerging entire villages within a few hours.
examples.zh: 洪水迅速上涨，几小时内就淹没了整个村庄。

lemmas.usage_note: 既指把某物完全浸没于水中（及物），也可指沉入水下（不及物），引申表示完全被感情或思想淹没。

lemmas.def_en: an apparatus intended for use under water
sinking until covered completely with water

lemmas.def_zh: 下沉, 下潜, 淹没
lemmas.def_en: sinking until covered completely with water

family_guide.root_logic: 以 submerge 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 狂风, 大风, 定期租金
lemmas.def_en: a strong wind moving 45-90 knots; force 7 to 10 on Beaufort scale

examples.en: A fierce winter gale swept across the coast, knocking down several large trees.
examples.zh: 一场猛烈的冬季大风席卷了海岸，吹倒了好几棵大树。

lemmas.usage_note: 气象学指大风；日常极高频搭配 gales of laughter（阵阵哄堂大笑），描绘声音猛烈爆发。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gale 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 缰绳, 统治, 支配
lemmas.def_en: one of a pair of long straps (usually connected to the bit or the headpiece) used to control a horse

examples.en: The new CEO is ready to take over the reins of the struggling tech company.
examples.zh: 新任首席执行官已准备好接管这家陷入困境的科技公司的领导权。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作复数形式 reins，字面指控制马匹的缰绳，引申用于 take the reins（掌管大局）等政治或企业管理搭配。

lemmas.def_zh: 驾驭, 以缰绳控制, 控制；勒住马
lemmas.def_en: control and direct with or as if by reins

examples.en: The government is trying to rein in public spending to reduce the national deficit.
examples.zh: 政府正试图控制公共开支以减少国家财政赤字。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与 in 或 back 连用，rein in 表示勒马停步，引申为严格控制开支、情绪或通货膨胀等趋势。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rein 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 深化；使加深, 使强烈
lemmas.def_en: make more intense, stronger, or more marked; ,

examples.en: The sudden crisis only served to deepen the mistrust between the two rival nations.
examples.zh: 这场突如其来的危机只会加深敌对两国之间的不信任。

lemmas.usage_note: 可及物或不及物，多接抽象宾语如 deepen understanding/crisis，表示程度、情感或危机加深。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 deepen 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a broad highway designed for high-speed traffic

examples.en: Heavy traffic backed up for several miles on the freeway during morning rush hour.
examples.zh: 在早高峰期间，高速公路上的拥堵车辆绵延了数英里。

lemmas.usage_note: 美式英语常用，指全封闭的高速公路，常见搭配如 on the freeway；注意通常免费通行，不同于 tollway。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 freeway 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a structure consisting of a room or set of rooms at a single position along a vertical scale

examples.en: The new office building features a charming rooftop cafe on its fifth storey.
examples.zh: 这座新办公楼的五层设有一家迷人的屋顶咖啡馆。

lemmas.usage_note: 英式拼写（美式作 story），指建筑物楼层，常构成复合词如 a two-storey building，注意勿与 floor 混淆。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 storey 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 吉卜赛人, 吉卜赛语
lemmas.def_en: a laborer who moves from place to place as demanded by employment

examples.en: The old woman told our fortunes using traditional cards like a true gypsy.
examples.zh: 老妇人像个真正的吉卜赛人一样用传统纸牌为我们占卜命运。

lemmas.usage_note: 指吉普赛人或流浪者；由于部分语境含贬义或冒犯性，正式场合建议优先使用尊重性称谓 Roma。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gypsy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: small cake baked in a muffin tin

examples.en: She decorated each chocolate cupcake with creamy pink frosting and tiny rainbow sprinkles.
examples.zh: 她用奶油粉色糖霜和微小的彩虹糖粒装饰了每个巧克力纸杯蛋糕。

lemmas.usage_note: 日常口语词，指纸杯蛋糕，可数名词；非正式语境下有时用于称呼可爱亲近的人，注意语境分寸。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cupcake 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a public declaration of intentions (as issued by a political party or government)

examples.en: The political party published an ambitious manifesto promising major environmental and economic reforms.
examples.zh: 该政党发表了一份雄心勃勃的宣言，承诺进行重大的环境和经济改革。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式政治与社会语体，指宣言或政纲，高频搭配包括 publish/issue a manifesto 或 party manifesto。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 manifesto 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an armed thief who is (usually) a member of a band

examples.en: Legend says the notorious bandit hid his stolen gold deep inside the forest cave.
examples.zh: 传说那个臭名昭著的强盗将偷来的黄金藏在了森林洞穴的深处。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指盘踞在偏远地区的强盗或土匪，常见搭配 armed bandits，口语中 one-armed bandit 特指老虎机。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bandit 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any high mountain

examples.en: The climbers paused to admire the majestic view from the snow-covered alp.
examples.zh: 登山者停下脚步，赞叹从白雪覆盖的高山上看到的美景。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面或文学用语，指高山；通常大写复数 the Alps 专指欧洲阿尔卑斯山脉，单数泛指极高之山。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 alp 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a small waterfall or series of small waterfalls

examples.en: The announcement triggered a cascade of criticism from both politicians and the public.
examples.zh: 该声明引发了政界人士和公众接二连三的批评。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指阶梯状的小瀑布或大量垂落物，比喻义常与of连用表示接二连三发生的一连串事物。

lemmas.def_en: rush down in big quantities, like a cascade

examples.en: Water cascaded down the rocky cliff after the heavy storm.
examples.zh: 暴风雨过后，水流顺着岩石峭壁倾泻而下。

lemmas.usage_note: 作不及物或及物动词，指水、发丝等如瀑布般大量倾泻或垂落，也可形容信息、影响层层传递。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cascade 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 打倒, 推翻, 倾覆
lemmas.def_en: cause the downfall of; of rulers

examples.en: Rebel forces united with citizens in a daring attempt to overthrow the corrupt dictator.
examples.zh: 叛军与市民联合起来，大胆试图推翻腐败的独裁者。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式政论用词，指武力推翻政权或体制，常搭配 overthrow the government/regime，过去式为 overthrew。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 overthrow 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 无能力的, 无资格的, 机能不全的, 不胜任的
lemmas.def_en: legally not qualified or sufficient

examples.en: The manager proved to be entirely incompetent at handling delicate negotiations.
examples.zh: 这位经理被证明在处理棘手的谈判方面完全无法胜任。

lemmas.usage_note: 常后接to do或介词at/in，用于正式或职场语境，表示某人缺乏胜任某项工作所需的能力或资格。

lemmas.def_en: someone who is not competent to take effective action

examples.en: The company was run by a group of incompetents who drove it into bankruptcy.
examples.zh: 这家公司被一群不称职的人掌管，最终导致其破产。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，带有明显的贬义色彩，指无能力、不称职或缺乏某种资质的人。

lemmas.def_zh: 不胜任, 不够格, 不合格, 不适合, 无能力, 不熟练, 无资格
lemmas.def_en: lack of physical or intellectual ability or qualifications

examples.en: He was dismissed from his post due to sheer professional incompetence.
examples.zh: 他因完全不具备专业胜任能力而被免职。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数抽象名词，常与professional、gross连用，正式表达缺乏能力、不合格或失职状态。

lemmas.def_zh: 不胜任, 不够格, 不合格, 不适合, 无能力, 不熟练, 无资格
lemmas.def_en: lack of physical or intellectual ability or qualifications
in an incompetent manner

examples.en: he did the job rather incompetently

family_guide.root_logic: 以 incompetent 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a man who serves as a sailor

examples.en: The ancient mariner navigated his weathered ship through stormy seas using only the stars.
examples.zh: 那位老水手仅凭星星的指引，驾着饱经风霜的船穿过暴风雨海域。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面或文学色彩浓厚的词汇，指水手或航海家，日常口语通常用 sailor 或 seaman 代替。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mariner 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 风景, 景色, 舞台布景
lemmas.def_en: the painted structures of a stage set that are intended to suggest a particular locale

examples.en: We took a leisurely drive through the countryside to enjoy the breathtaking mountain scenery.
examples.zh: 我们在乡村悠闲地驾车行驶，以欣赏壮丽的山景。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词（切忌加复数），指天然风景，常用搭配 breathtaking/spectacular scenery，区别于可数的 view。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 scenery 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 知觉的, 感觉的, 传递感觉的
lemmas.def_en: of a nerve fiber or impulse originating outside and passing toward the central nervous system

examples.en: The vibrant flower market offered a rich sensory experience of colorful sights and scents.
examples.zh: 热闹的花市带来了色彩与香气交织的丰富感官体验。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰生理或神经学术语，如 sensory organ（感觉器官）、sensory overload（感官过载），属正式书面语。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sensory 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 考古学的, 考古学上的
lemmas.def_en: related to or dealing with or devoted to archaeology

examples.en: The team made significant discoveries during the archaeological excavation in the desert.
examples.zh: 该团队在沙漠的考古发掘中取得了重大发现。

lemmas.usage_note: 专用于学术或历史语境，常修饰site（遗址）、dig（发掘现场）、evidence（证据）等名词。

lemmas.def_en: an anthropologist who studies prehistoric people and their culture

examples.en: Archaeologists are painstakingly analyzing the ancient pottery fragments unearthed last month.
examples.zh: 考古学家们正在认真细致地分析上个月出土的古代陶器碎片。

lemmas.usage_note: 指专门从事考古研究的学者或工作者，为普通可数名词，常与marine、field等词搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 archaeological 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 跳跃, 弹起；使跳, 限制, 形成...的疆界
lemmas.def_en: move forward by leaps and bounds

examples.en: We watched the energetic puppy bound across the open grassy field with sheer joy.
examples.zh: 我们看着那只精力充沛的小狗满心欢喜地在开阔的草地上跳跃奔跑。

lemmas.usage_note: 作动词表跳跃时常接介词 across/into；作“形成界限”讲多用于被动语态 be bounded by（以…为界）。

lemmas.def_en: the limits of what is possible, acceptable, or intended
lemmas.usage_note: 通常用复数形式 bounds，常见短语 within the bounds of（在……的范围之内）、out of bounds（出界；禁止入内）。

examples.en: His rude behavior was beyond the bounds of acceptable conduct.
examples.zh: 他的粗鲁行为超出了可以接受的界限。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bounds 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or pertaining to or involving the heart and blood vessels

examples.en: Regular swimming and jogging can greatly improve your overall cardiovascular health and stamina.
examples.zh: 经常游泳和慢跑可以大大改善你的整体心血管健康和耐力。

lemmas.usage_note: 医学与健康类正式词，极高频搭配 cardiovascular disease（心血管疾病）及 cardiovascular fitness。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cardiovascular 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: elegant and stylish

examples.en: She wore an elegant black dress paired with chic accessories to the evening gala.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件优雅的黑裙，搭配别致的配饰去参加晚宴。

lemmas.usage_note: 源自法语，形容时尚别致且优雅，常用于口语和时尚杂志，修饰人或装束，如 look effortlessly chic。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 协会, 合伙, (国际性)财团
lemmas.def_en: an association of companies for some definite purpose

examples.en: Several tech giants formed a consortium to develop open-source artificial intelligence tools.
examples.zh: 几家科技巨头组成财团，共同开发开源人工智能工具。

lemmas.usage_note: 商务与法律正式用语，常指企业或机构联合体，常见搭配 form/lead a consortium，复数多为 consortia。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 consortium 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the act of reaching out

examples.en: The charity expanded its community outreach to provide hot meals for homeless families.
examples.zh: 该慈善机构扩大了社区外展服务，为无家可归的家庭提供热饭。

lemmas.usage_note: 指外展服务或公益延伸活动，常作定语修饰 program/worker，动宾搭配如 conduct community outreach。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 outreach 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: rice (with raw fish) wrapped in seaweed

examples.en: We ordered fresh salmon sushi and a bowl of warm miso soup for lunch.
examples.zh: 我们午餐点了新鲜的三文鱼寿司和一碗热味噌汤。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，特指加醋米饭搭配鱼肉等，常见搭配 sushi roll、sushi bar，注意勿与 sashimi（刺身）混淆。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sushi 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the act of taking revenge (harming someone in retaliation for something harmful that they have done) especially in the next life; --Romans 12:19; --James Garfield

examples.en: He swore vengeance against the rivals who had ruined his family's reputable business.
examples.zh: 他发誓要向毁掉家族显赫生意的竞争对手复仇。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式书面语，常见固定搭配 with a vengeance（猛烈地；变本加厉地）及 seek/exact vengeance on/against。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 vengeance 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [经] 展览会, 市集, 义卖
lemmas.def_en: a collection of things (goods or works of art etc.) for public display

examples.en: Thousands of international visitors attended the green energy expo to see new inventions.
examples.zh: 成千上万的国际访客参加了绿色能源博览会，参观新发明。

lemmas.usage_note: exposition 的口语化简称，常用于专有名词如 World Expo（世博会），动词搭配 hold/host an expo。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 expo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (surgery) tissue or organ transplanted from a donor to a recipient; in some cases the patient can be both donor and recipient

examples.en: The mayor was accused of using his public office for personal graft and corruption.
examples.zh: 市长被指控利用公职进行个人贪污受贿。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可指医学与园艺上的移植/嫁接物（可数），也指政界官场的贪腐敛财行径（不可数）。

lemmas.def_zh: 嫁接, 移植, 贪污
lemmas.def_en: cause to grow together parts from different plants

examples.en: Surgeons successfully grafted skin from the patient's thigh onto his arm.
examples.zh: 外科医生成功地将患者大腿上的皮肤移植到了其手臂上。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与介词onto或into搭配，用于生物学嫁接、组织移植，或比喻将一种系统生硬融入另一系统。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 graft 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a unit of force equal to the force exerted by gravity; used to indicate the force to which a body is subjected when it is accelerated

examples.en: Look at the pretty gee trotting across the field!
examples.zh: 看那匹漂亮的小马正在田野里小跑呢！

lemmas.usage_note: 非正式或口语用法，常在儿童语境中指马匹，也可作为俚语指特定的人或家伙。

lemmas.def_en: turn to the right side

examples.en: The farmer called out to gee the horses away from the ditch.
examples.zh: 农夫大声发出指令，使马匹向右转避开沟渠。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于骑术或驾驭役畜的口令，指使牲畜向右转弯，常与round连用或作及物动词使用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gee 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 蛾害, 蛾, 乌头叶菜豆
lemmas.def_en: typically crepuscular or nocturnal insect having a stout body and feathery or hairlike antennae

examples.en: A tiny gray moth fluttered around the bright porch lamp late at night.
examples.zh: 深夜里，一只灰色的小飞蛾在明亮的门廊灯周围扑棱翅膀。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与 fly like a moth to the flame（飞蛾扑火）搭配，修饰衣物防虫时用 moth-eaten（虫蛀的）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 moth 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 重写, 改写, 改写新闻, 书面答复；修改旧作
lemmas.def_en: write differently; alter the writing of

examples.en: The director asked the screenwriter to rewrite the final scene for more dramatic impact.
examples.zh: 导演要求编剧重写最后一幕，以增强戏剧张力。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指重新撰写、修改剧本或草稿，亦可用于抽象比喻如“改写历史”。

lemmas.def_en: someone who puts text into appropriate form for publication

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rewrite 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 象征, 徽章, 符号
lemmas.def_en: special design or visual object representing a quality, type, group, etc.

examples.en: The olive branch has long been recognized as an emblem of peace and reconciliation.
examples.zh: 橄榄枝长期以来一直被公认为和平与和解的象征。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用于书面语，常与of连用，表示象征性图案、会徽，或某种抽象品质与身份的标志物。

lemmas.def_en: serving as a visible symbol for something abstract

examples.en: The soaring skyscraper quickly became emblematic of the city's remarkable economic boom.
examples.zh: 这座高耸入云的摩天大楼很快成为了该市显著经济繁荣的象征。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 emblem 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a college or university building containing living quarters for students

examples.en: After evening classes ended, the exhausted students walked back to their shared dorm.
examples.zh: 晚课结束后，筋疲力尽的学生们走回了合宿宿舍。

lemmas.usage_note: 口语缩写（全称 dormitory），常搭配 live in a dorm 或 dorm room，多指大学学生宿舍。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dorm 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: to cause to do through pressure or necessity, by physical, moral or intellectual means :

examples.en: The rogue trader was haled into court to answer for his fraudulent activities.
examples.zh: 该不法交易商被强行传唤出庭，就其欺诈行为接受质询。

lemmas.usage_note: 多见于正式或法律文体，常与hale sb into/before court搭配，意为强制传讯或拖曳拉拽。

lemmas.def_zh: 强壮的, 矍铄的, 健壮的
lemmas.def_en: exhibiting or restored to vigorous good health

examples.en: At eighty-five, my grandfather is still hale and enjoys working in the garden.
examples.zh: 我祖父八十五岁了，身板依然矍铄，喜欢在花园里干活。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于固定习语hale and hearty中，专门形容老年人身板硬朗、精神矍铄、身体健康。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hale 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 酵素, 发酵, 动乱
lemmas.def_en: a state of agitation or turbulent change or development

examples.en: The entire nation was plunged into political ferment following the disputed election.
examples.zh: 有争议的选举之后，整个国家陷入了政治动荡之中。

lemmas.usage_note: 发音为/ˈfɜːrmənt/，既指发酵用的酵素，也常用于 political/social ferment 表达社会骚乱动荡。

lemmas.def_en: a state of agitation or turbulent change or development

examples.en: the political ferment produced new leadership
social unrest

lemmas.def_en: be in an agitated or excited state

examples.en: Rebel leaders tried to ferment unrest among the impoverished citizens.
examples.zh: 叛乱头目试图在贫困市民中煽动不满与动乱。

lemmas.usage_note: 发音为/fərˈment/，及物或不及物，指生物发酵过程，或比喻暗中煽动、酿造动乱或情绪。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ferment 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: cause to load (an operating system) and start the initial processes

examples.en: You need to reboot your laptop after installing the latest operating system update.
examples.zh: 安装最新的操作系统更新后，你需要重新启动笔记本电脑。

lemmas.usage_note: 既指电脑“重新启动”（reboot the system），也广泛引申为影视剧或品牌“重启/翻拍”。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 reboot 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: edible seeds or roots or stems or leaves or bulbs or tubers or nonsweet fruits of any of numerous herbaceous plant

examples.en: Being a dedicated veggie, she always checks food labels carefully before buying snacks.
examples.zh: 作为一名坚定的素食者，她买零食前总是仔细查看食品标签。

lemmas.usage_note: 非正式口语，可数名词常作复数 veggies（蔬菜），作单数或前置修饰语时常指素食主义者（或素食的）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 veggie 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 阻碍, 使困累, 妨碍, 牵制
lemmas.def_en: prevent the progress or free movement of

examples.en: Rescue efforts were severely hampered by heavy snow and poor visibility.
examples.zh: 大雪和极差的能见度严重阻碍了救援工作。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指行动、进程受外在困难或不利环境阻碍牵制，被动语态 hamper by 极为高频。

lemmas.def_zh: 食篮, 阻碍物, 食盒
lemmas.def_en: a restraint that confines or restricts freedom (especially something used to tie down or restrain a prisoner)

examples.en: They packed a generous picnic hamper with sandwiches and fruit for the day trip.
examples.zh: 他们准备了一个装满三明治和水果的丰盛野餐篮，以供一日游食用。

lemmas.usage_note: 主要在英式英语中指带盖的大篮子（如脏衣篮）或装满礼品食品的野餐礼盒（picnic hamper）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hamper 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: make psychologically or physically used (to something)

examples.en: It took her several months to accustom herself to the humid southern climate.
examples.zh: 她花了好几个月才使自己习惯南方潮湿的气候。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于 accustom oneself/sb to (doing) sth 结构，表示使某人习惯于新环境或常规，书面语常用被动语态 be accustomed to。

lemmas.def_zh: 不习惯的, 不惯的, 异乎惯例的, 不寻常的
lemmas.def_en: not habituated to; unfamiliar with

examples.en: unaccustomed to wearing suits

family_guide.root_logic: 以 accustom 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 骚扰, 寄生于, 大批出没
lemmas.def_en: invade in great numbers

examples.en: Termites had infested the wooden beams of the old farmhouse, causing severe structural damage.
examples.zh: 白蚁大批滋生侵蚀了这栋老农舍的木梁，造成了严重的结构损坏。

lemmas.usage_note: 通常作及物动词，指害虫、害兽或盗匪大批出没、滋生为患，常见被动结构 be infested with（充斥着……）。

lemmas.def_zh: 骚扰, 大批出没, 横行
lemmas.def_en: the state of being invaded or overrun by parasites

family_guide.root_logic: 以 infest 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 逃亡者, 亡命者, 难捕捉之物
lemmas.def_en: someone who flees from an uncongenial situation

examples.en: The fugitive managed to hide from local police in the dense forest for weeks.
examples.zh: 这名逃犯在茂密的森林里躲避当地警方的搜捕长达数周。

lemmas.usage_note: 指在逃犯或亡命徒，高频固定搭配 a fugitive from justice（逃避法律制裁的人/逃犯）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fugitive 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 绯红色的, 鲜红色的
lemmas.def_en: of a color at the end of the color spectrum (next to orange); resembling the color of blood or cherries or tomatoes or rubies

examples.en: She turned scarlet with embarrassment when she realized she had walked into the wrong meeting room.
examples.zh: 当意识到自己走错会议室时，她尴尬得满脸通红。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，指鲜红、猩红的，多修饰衣物、花卉或脸色；常见搭配如 scarlet fever（猩红热）、turn scarlet（脸涨得通红）。

lemmas.def_zh: 猩红色, 绯红色, 红衣
lemmas.def_en: a variable color that is vivid red but sometimes with an orange tinge

examples.en: The autumn leaves changed rapidly from golden yellow to a vivid scarlet.
examples.zh: 秋天的树叶迅速由金黄色转变成了鲜艳的猩红色。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，指猩红色、鲜红色；常与介词 in 搭配（如 dressed in scarlet），指身着鲜红色服装，具文学色彩。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 scarlet 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: rescue equipment consisting of a device that fills with air and retards your fall

examples.en: The pilot pulled the emergency cord just in time for the parachute to open.
examples.zh: 飞行员及时拉动了应急拉绳，降落伞得以顺利打开。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指降落伞；常见搭配 open/deploy a parachute（打开降落伞），商业上常引申为 golden parachute（黄金降落伞/高管离职补偿）。

lemmas.def_en: a person who jumps from aircraft using a parachute
jump from an airplane and descend with a parachute

examples.en: The special forces unit will parachute into the designated combat zone tonight.
examples.zh: 特种部队小队今晚将跳伞空降进入指定作战区域。

lemmas.usage_note: 动词，既指跳伞（不及物），也可引申指空降、空投（及物），常搭配 parachute into 用于政治或企业临危任命。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 parachute 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 核心, 中心, 精髓, 内核
lemmas.def_en: the inner and usually edible part of a seed or grain or nut or fruit stone

examples.en: His latest proposal contained a kernel of truth despite many impractical details.
examples.zh: 尽管有许多不切实际的细节，但他最新的提案仍包含核心事实。

lemmas.usage_note: 常搭配 a kernel of truth/idea，比喻核心要点；科技语境指系统内核，指果仁时为可数名词。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 kernel 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 强烈味道, 特殊的气味, 特性, 柄脚, 当的一声, 墨角藻
lemmas.def_en: a tart spicy quality

examples.en: The morning breeze carried the salty tang of the open ocean.
examples.zh: 晨风中夹带着辽阔海洋特有的咸腥气息。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作单数名词，指强烈刺激的气味、微酸辛辣的味道或特殊的风味气息；常与介词 of 连用（a tang of sea air/lemon）。

lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 有一点很淡的天然酸甜味
lemmas.def_en: a tart spicy quality

lemmas.def_zh: 有强烈盐味的, 气味刺鼻的, 有刺激性的
lemmas.def_en: tasting sour like a lemon

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tang 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: existing in act or fact

examples.en: The defense attorney pointed out several factual errors in the witness's testimony.
examples.zh: 辩护律师指出了证人证词中的几处事实性错误。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，指基于事实的、真实的，不含主观臆断；高频搭配包括 factual error（事实性错误）、factual basis（事实依据）。

lemmas.def_en: as a fact or based on fact

examples.en: they learn much, factually, about the problems of retirement and provision for old age, and, psychologically, in the sharing of their thoughts on retirement

lemmas.def_en: the quality of being actual or based on fact

examples.en: the realm of factuality must be distinguished from the realm of imagination

family_guide.root_logic: 以 factual 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the part of the alimentary canal between the stomach and the anus

examples.en: The doctor asked about his bowel habits to diagnose the persistent stomach pain.
examples.zh: 医生询问了他的肠道排便习惯，以诊断持续的胃痛。

lemmas.usage_note: 生理上常作可数（bowel movement 意为排便）；复数 the bowels of 可比喻建筑物或地球的深处、最底部。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bowel 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 枪弹, (枪炮)射击, 炮击, 射程
lemmas.def_en: the act of shooting a gun

examples.en: Neighbors reported hearing a loud gunshot coming from the abandoned warehouse midnight.
examples.zh: 邻居们报告说，半夜听到废弃仓库里传来一声巨大的枪响。

lemmas.usage_note: 常构成 gunshot wound/victim（枪伤/受害者）；也指枪声（hear a gunshot）或射程（within gunshot）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gunshot 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 指挥棒, 接力棒, 警棍
lemmas.def_en: a thin tapered rod used by a conductor to lead an orchestra or choir

examples.en: The runner dropped the baton during the final relay, costing the team the race.
examples.zh: 该名选手在最后的接力赛中掉了接力棒，导致队伍输掉了比赛。

lemmas.usage_note: 依语境指警棍、指挥棒或接力棒，高频比喻搭配为 pass the baton to sb.（将责任/权力交接给某人）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 baton 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a diplomat appointed by a government to protect its commercial interests and help its citizens in a foreign country

examples.en: The British consul visited the detained citizens to offer legal assistance.
examples.zh: 英国领事探访了被拘留的本国公民，以提供法律援助。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指国家派驻国外的领事官员，亦指古罗马时期的执政官；常见职位如 consul general（总领事）。

lemmas.def_zh: 领事, 领事任期, 领事馆
lemmas.def_en: diplomatic building that serves as the residence or workplace of a consul

examples.en: You need to submit your visa application directly to the Italian consulate.
examples.zh: 你需要将签证申请材料直接提交给意大利领事馆。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指领事馆及其全体官员或领事任期；常见搭配 apply at the consulate（在领事馆申请）及 consulate general（总领事馆）。

lemmas.def_zh: 领事的职位, 领事的任期
lemmas.def_en: the post of consul
having to do with a consul or his office or duties

examples.en: The embassy provides comprehensive consular assistance to nationals living abroad.
examples.zh: 该大使馆为旅居海外的本国国民提供全面的领事协助。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，意为领事的、领事馆的，专用于官方行政与外交语境；高频搭配有 consular services（领事服务）、consular official（领事官员）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 consul 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 使苦恼；生病, 处境困难
lemmas.def_en: be ill or unwell

examples.en: Doctors struggled for days to determine what ailed the young patient.
examples.zh: 医生们努力了好几天，才查明究竟是什么病痛在折磨这位年轻患者。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词常以 what ails sb/sth 形式出现表示“使困扰”；其现在分词常构成复合形容词 ailing（境况不佳的、生病的）。

lemmas.def_en: an often persistent bodily disorder or disease; a cause for complaining

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 生病的；衰退的；状况不佳的
lemmas.def_en: in poor health; experiencing difficulty, weakness, or failure
lemmas.usage_note: 除了形容人身体欠佳，广泛用于修饰经济、企业或机构，如 an ailing economy / company。

examples.en: The government introduced new measures to bail out the ailing economy.
examples.zh: 政府出台了新举措来挽救陷入衰退的经济。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ail 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 时髦的, 上流社会的, 流行的
lemmas.def_en: being or in accordance with current social fashions

examples.en: She works for a fashionable clothing brand located in the heart of downtown.
examples.zh: 她在市中心一家非常时髦的服装品牌公司工作。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰 clothes, area, trend；作表语常接 to do（it became fashionable to... 流行做某事）。

lemmas.def_zh: 不流行的, 不时髦的, 过时的
lemmas.def_en: not in accord with or not following current fashion

examples.en: unfashionable clothes
melodrama of a now unfashionable kind

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fashionable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 拨用, 挪用, 拨款
lemmas.def_en: money set aside (as by a legislature) for a specific purpose

examples.en: Congress approved a special appropriation of funds to rebuild the disaster-stricken area.
examples.zh: 国会批准了一笔专项拨款，用于重建受灾严重的地区。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式用语，指拨付款项（budgetary appropriations）或非法挪用；社会学高频词为 cultural appropriation。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 appropriation 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 散播, 传播, 宣传；广为传播
lemmas.def_en: cause to become widely known

examples.en: The health organization uses social media platforms to disseminate vital medical information to the public.
examples.zh: 该卫生组织利用社交媒体平台向公众广泛传播重要的医疗信息。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式书面语及物动词，指广泛散播、传播信息、理论、知识或观点；高频搭配 disseminate information/ideas/findings。

lemmas.def_zh: 散播, 传播, 普及
lemmas.def_en: the opening of a subject to widespread discussion and debate
someone who spreads the news

family_guide.root_logic: 以 disseminate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 典当, 抵押物, 人质, (象棋)兵, 马前卒, 工具
lemmas.def_en: an article deposited as security

examples.en: He soon realized he was merely an expendable pawn in their political power struggle.
examples.zh: 他很快意识到，自己在这场政治权力斗争中不过是个可随时弃用的棋子。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指国际象棋中的小兵，或比喻任人摆布的工具、傀儡；常见短语 a pawn in the game/political pawn。

lemmas.def_en: leave as a guarantee in return for money

examples.en: Desperate to pay his rent, he had to pawn his vintage gold watch.
examples.zh: 为了凑钱交房租，他迫不得已当掉了自己的古董金表。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指将贵重物品送进当铺典当以换取借款，常搭配 pawn sth for money；引申指押上自己的名誉或信用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pawn 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 升空的, 空运的, 空中传播的, 空降的
lemmas.def_en: moved or conveyed by or through air

examples.en: The plane was airborne within minutes of getting clearance from the control tower.
examples.zh: 飞机在获得控制塔许可后几分钟内就已升空。

lemmas.usage_note: 表示在空中的状态（常作表语 go/become airborne）或指空运的、空气传播的（如 airborne disease/troops）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 airborne 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 亚麻布, 亚麻线, 亚麻制品
lemmas.def_en: a fabric woven with fibers from the flax plant

examples.en: They sat on the porch enjoying cold drinks beneath crisp white linen umbrellas.
examples.zh: 他们坐在门廊下，在清爽的白色亚麻遮阳伞下享用冷饮。

lemmas.usage_note: 指亚麻织品或被单桌布等家纺（不可数）；常用习语 wash one's dirty linen in public（家丑外扬）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 linen 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: make more attractive by adding ornament, colour, etc.

examples.en: The grand ballroom was adorned with fragrant white lilies and crystal chandeliers.
examples.zh: 宏伟的宴会厅用芬芳的白百合和水晶吊灯装点得格外美丽。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常用于书面语，多与介词 with 搭配（adorn sth with sth），表示用装饰品美化。

lemmas.def_en: a decoration of color or interest that is added to relieve plainness

lemmas.def_zh: 无装饰的, 未装饰的, 不加渲染的, 朴素的
lemmas.def_en: not decorated with something to increase its beauty or distinction

family_guide.root_logic: 以 adorn 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 貌似真实的, 貌似合理的, 说得煞有其事的
lemmas.def_en: apparently reasonable and valid, and truthful

examples.en: She struggled to come up with a plausible excuse for her sudden absence.
examples.zh: 她绞尽脑汁想为自己的突然缺席找一个貌似合理的借口。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰 explanation, excuse 或 scenario，常带怀疑色彩，暗示表面合理但实际存疑。

lemmas.def_zh: 似有道理, 貌似可信
lemmas.def_en: apparent validity

family_guide.root_logic: 以 plausible 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a secret store of valuables or money

examples.en: The police discovered a secret stash of cash hidden beneath the floorboards.
examples.zh: 警方在地板底下发现了一处秘密藏匿的现金。

lemmas.usage_note: 非正式名词，指秘密藏匿的贵重物品、钱财或藏匿处，常与 of 搭配使用。

lemmas.def_en: save up as for future use

examples.en: He managed to stash away a portion of his monthly salary for emergencies.
examples.zh: 他设法把每月工资的一部分悄悄存起来以备不时之需。

lemmas.usage_note: 非正式动词，常与 away 搭配（stash sth away），表示为防备或私存而把某物妥善藏匿。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stash 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: imagine; conceive of; see in one's mind

examples.en: The architect envisions a sustainable city powered entirely by renewable solar energy.
examples.zh: 建筑师设想了一座完全由可再生太阳能供电的可持续城市。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式用语，指对未来的展望与设想；常接名词、代词或动名词，搭配 envision doing sth 或 envision a future。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 envision 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 敏捷的, 灵活的, 机敏的
lemmas.def_en: moving quickly and lightly

examples.en: With an agile leap, the stray cat landed silently on top of the high brick wall.
examples.zh: 那只流浪猫轻轻一跃，动作敏捷地无声落在了高高的砖墙上。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可指身体动作敏捷，也常指思维机敏（agile mind）或敏捷项目管理模式（Agile development）。

lemmas.def_zh: 敏捷, 灵活, 机敏
lemmas.def_en: the gracefulness of a person or animal that is quick and nimble

family_guide.root_logic: 以 agile 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: having or showing knowledge and skill and aptitude

examples.en: She is proficient in multiple programming languages, including Python and C++.
examples.zh: 她精通多种编程语言，包括 Python 和 C++。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式形容词，常与介词 in 或 at 连用，多用于简历或技能评价，表示经过训练达到的熟练程度。

lemmas.def_zh: 精通, 熟练, 精练
lemmas.def_en: the quality of having great facility and competence
in a proficient manner

examples.en: he dealt proficiently with the problem

family_guide.root_logic: 以 proficient 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a ringing sound

examples.en: The soft ding of the elevator signaled that they had finally reached the penthouse.
examples.zh: 电梯清脆的一声轻响，示意他们终于到达了顶层套房。

lemmas.usage_note: 拟声名词，指金属或铃铛发出的清脆响声；非正式语境中也可指车身轻微碰撞产生的凹痕。

lemmas.def_zh: 响, 连响, 反复告诫；反复告诉
lemmas.def_en: go `ding dong', like a bell

examples.en: The microwave dinged loudly to let us know that the dinner was ready.
examples.zh: 微波炉清脆地响了一声，提醒我们晚饭热好了。

lemmas.usage_note: 可作不及物或及物动词，指发出清脆铃声；亦可用于俚语表示反复叮嘱或扣减考核分数。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ding 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the pelt of a leopard

examples.en: The spotted leopard dragged its heavy prey up into the tall tree.
examples.zh: 那只花豹把沉重的猎物拖到了高高的树上。

lemmas.usage_note: 指豹、花豹；最常考英文谚语 a leopard can't change its spots，相当于汉语的“江山易改，本性难移”。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 leopard 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 推翻, 颠覆, 毁灭
lemmas.def_en: cause the downfall of; of rulers

examples.en: The rebel group was accused of plotting to subvert the established government.
examples.zh: 该叛乱组织被指控密谋颠覆现存政府。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，书面语，常与 authority, regime, values 搭配，指暗中动摇或推翻体制与观念。

lemmas.def_zh: 破坏分子, 颠覆分子
lemmas.def_en: a radical supporter of political or social revolution

lemmas.def_zh: 颠覆, 打倒, 破坏
lemmas.def_en: destroying someone's (or some group's) honesty or loyalty; undermining moral integrity

examples.en: corruption of a minor
the big city's subversion of rural innocence

lemmas.def_en: disloyalty by virtue of subversive behavior

family_guide.root_logic: 以 subvert 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: nut of any of various walnut trees having a wrinkled two-lobed seed with a hard shell

examples.en: He cracked a walnut with his bare hands and ate the kernel.
examples.zh: 他徒手捏碎了一个核桃，吃掉了果仁。

lemmas.usage_note: 指核桃或胡桃木，搭配如 crack a walnut，作材质时常作定语修饰 desk 等家具。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 walnut 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the top of a (usually flat) roof

examples.en: We enjoyed a stunning view of the city skyline from the rooftop.
examples.zh: 我们从屋顶上欣赏到了迷人的城市天际线景色。

lemmas.usage_note: 指屋顶表面，高频搭配 on the rooftop，比喻义常用 shout from the rooftops（大肆宣扬）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rooftop 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a boy or man

examples.en: He seems like a friendly bloke who is always willing to help.
examples.zh: 他看起来是个友善的家伙，总是乐于助人。

lemmas.usage_note: 英澳非正式口语词，等同于 guy/man，常搭配 a decent/top bloke（好人、正派人）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bloke 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 提出看法, 引起注意, 留意
lemmas.def_en: give heed (to)

examples.en: The speaker adverted briefly to the economic crisis before introducing the solution.
examples.zh: 发言人在介绍解决方案之前，简要提及了经济危机。

lemmas.usage_note: 极正式/古旧用法，不及物动词，常与 to 搭配，意为“注意、提及或谈及（某事）”。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 advert 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an imaginary creature represented as a white horse with a long horn growing from its forehead

examples.en: The fairy tale describes a pure white unicorn with a golden horn.
examples.zh: 这则童话描述了一只长着金色独角、通体雪白的独角兽。

lemmas.usage_note: 除神话独角兽外，商业中常指估值超10亿美元的初创公司（unicorn company/startup）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 unicorn 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 谚语, 格言, 箴言
lemmas.def_en: a condensed but memorable saying embodying some important fact of experience that is taken as true by many people

examples.en: As the old proverb goes, a journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
examples.zh: 正如古老谚语所云：千里之行，始于足下。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，常用于固定短语 as the proverb says/goes（正如谚语所言），用于引用民间智慧。

lemmas.def_zh: 谚语的, 谚语式的, 闻名的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or resembling or expressed in a proverb

examples.en: he kicked the proverbial bucket
the proverbial grasshopper

lemmas.def_zh: 如谚语所说, 众所周知
lemmas.def_en: in the manner of something that has become a byword

examples.en: this proverbially bitter plant, wormwood

family_guide.root_logic: 以 proverb 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 自由意志主义支持者, 行动自由者
lemmas.def_en: an advocate of libertarianism

examples.en: As a committed libertarian, he argued strongly against any unnecessary government regulation.
examples.zh: 作为一名坚定的自由意志主义者，他强烈反对任何不必要的政府监管。

lemmas.usage_note: 政治哲学用语，指“自由意志主义者”，主张极小化国家干预，常兼作定语修饰 policy。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 libertarian 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an infective disease caused by sporozoan parasites that are transmitted through the bite of an infected Anopheles mosquito; marked by paroxysms of chills and fever

examples.en: Travelers to tropical regions are strongly advised to take precautions against malaria.
examples.zh: 强烈建议前往热带地区的旅行者采取措施预防疟疾。

lemmas.usage_note: 医学不可数名词，常与 contract, catch 或 transmit 搭配，专指由蚊媒传播的疟疾。

lemmas.def_en: of or infected by or resembling malaria

examples.en: malarial fever

family_guide.root_logic: 以 malaria 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: frequent and watery bowel movements; can be a symptom of infection or food poisoning or colitis or a gastrointestinal tumor

examples.en: Contaminated drinking water was identified as the main cause of the severe diarrhea.
examples.zh: 受污染的饮用水被认定是导致严重腹泻的主要原因。

lemmas.usage_note: 医学及日常不可数名词，常与 have, suffer from 搭配，指消化不良或感染引起的腹泻症状。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to diarrhea

family_guide.root_logic: 以 diarrhea 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a mug intended for serving beer

examples.en: He raised a heavy ceramic stein filled with fresh Bavarian draft beer.
examples.zh: 他举起装满新鲜巴伐利亚生啤的沉重陶瓷啤酒杯。

lemmas.usage_note: 特指（尤指德国传统的陶瓷或厚玻璃制）大啤酒杯，常用 a stein of beer 表达整杯啤酒。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stein 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 剪, 剪取, 删除, 削减
lemmas.def_en: cut with or as if with scissors

examples.en: The runner scissored his legs rapidly to sprint across the finish line.
examples.zh: 跑步选手双腿飞快地交替迈动，冲过了终点线。

lemmas.usage_note: 动词表示“用剪刀剪”或像剪刀般交叉移动，如 scissor one's legs（双腿做剪刀式摆动）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 scissor 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 楼阁, 亭子, 大帐篷, 观众席
lemmas.def_en: large and often sumptuous tent

examples.en: We sought shelter from the sudden rain under the wooden park pavilion.
examples.zh: 我们在公园的木制凉亭下躲避突如其来的大雨。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指公园凉亭、球场看台或世博会展馆，搭配如 the national pavilion；多用于建筑与体育语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pavilion 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a drinking mug in the shape of a stout man wearing a three-cornered hat

examples.en: Grandpa proudly displayed an antique toby shaped like a smiling sailor on the shelf.
examples.zh: 爷爷自豪地把一个水手造型的古董人形水罐陈列在架子上。

lemmas.usage_note: 通常大写作 Toby，最常指人物造型的矮胖酒杯（Toby jug），属于英式英语专有名词，语境较窄。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 toby 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a bitter alkaloid found in coffee and tea that is responsible for their stimulating effects

examples.en: Too much caffeine in the afternoon always makes it difficult for him to sleep.
examples.zh: 下午摄入过多咖啡因总是让他难以入眠。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，常见搭配 high in caffeine、caffeine hit/intake；无咖啡因用 decaffeinated。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 caffeine 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: occurring at or characteristic of a formal investiture or induction

examples.en: The university president delivered an inspiring speech during the inaugural ceremony this morning.
examples.zh: 大学校长在今天上午的开幕典礼上发表了鼓舞人心的演讲。

lemmas.usage_note: 正规书面词，指就职的或首届的，高频搭配 inaugural address（就职演说）、inaugural flight（首航）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 inaugural 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: arrival that has been awaited (especially of something momentous)

examples.en: The advent of modern smartphones has fundamentally changed how people communicate with each other.
examples.zh: 现代智能手机的来临彻底改变了人们相互沟通的方式。

lemmas.usage_note: 极常用于固定结构 the advent of sth，指重要事件、时代或技术的来临，首字母大写时指基督教基督降临节。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 advent 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 友好, 好意, 善意, 亲善, (企业享有的)信誉, 声誉
lemmas.def_en: (accounting) an intangible asset valued according to the advantage or reputation a business has acquired (over and above its tangible assets)

examples.en: The company donated millions to charity as an expression of corporate goodwill.
examples.zh: 该公司向慈善机构捐赠了数百万，以此表达企业的善意。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数，既指友善态度（a gesture of goodwill），商业中又特指企业的“商誉”，常与 gesture/ambassador 连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 goodwill 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the bank of a river

examples.en: Couples enjoyed walking along the peaceful riverside while the warm sun was setting.
examples.zh: 夕阳西下时，情侣们喜欢沿着宁静的河畔散步。

lemmas.usage_note: 指河畔或河边地区，常作名词修饰语，如 riverside walk/restaurant，介词多与 along/by the riverside 连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 riverside 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 所有者, 业主, 所有权
lemmas.def_en: an unincorporated business owned by a single person who is responsible for its liabilities and entitled to its profits

examples.en: The developers decided to retain proprietary over the advanced software algorithm they created.
examples.zh: 开发人员决定保留他们所创先进软件算法的所有权。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词多指所有权、所有权人或专有药品（常作形容词），搭配如 proprietary rights，语体极为正式。

lemmas.def_en: (law) someone who owns (is legal possessor of) a business

examples.en: The friendly proprietor greeted every customer who walked into the small bookstore.
examples.zh: 热情的店主向走进这家小书店的每一位顾客打招呼。

lemmas.def_en: an unincorporated business owned by a single person who is responsible for its liabilities and entitled to its profits

family_guide.root_logic: 以 proprietary 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: make final; put the last touches on; put into final form

examples.en: The committee met yesterday to finalize the details of the new contract.
examples.zh: 委员会昨天开会敲定了新合同的最后细节。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于正式商务或行政语境，指最终敲定方案、合同或细节，常见搭配 finalize details/a contract。

lemmas.def_zh: 把(计划)最后定下来, 定稿
lemmas.def_en: make final; put the last touches on; put into final form

examples.en: let's finalize the proposal

lemmas.def_en: the act of finalizing

family_guide.root_logic: 以 finalize 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 辨别, 看清楚, 了解
lemmas.def_en: detect with the senses

examples.en: It was difficult to discern any real difference between the two approaches.
examples.zh: 很难看出这两种方法之间有什么实质性的区别。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面语动词，强调通过仔细观察或思考辨别出隐蔽的事物，常接 difference 或 that 从句。

lemmas.def_zh: 看得清的, 可看出的, 可辨别的, 辨别得出的
lemmas.def_en: perceptible by the senses or intellect

examples.en: things happen in the earth and sky with no discernible cause
the newspaper reports no discernible progress in the negotiations

lemmas.def_zh: 没有识别力的, 感觉迟钝的
lemmas.def_en: lacking discernment

lemmas.def_zh: [法] 认识, 识别, 洞察力
lemmas.def_en: the cognitive condition of someone who understands

examples.en: he has virtually no understanding of social cause and effect

family_guide.root_logic: 以 discern 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a small inlet

examples.en: The fishermen anchored their small wooden boat inside a sheltered rocky cove.
examples.zh: 渔民们将小木船停泊在一个有遮蔽的岩石小湾内。

lemmas.usage_note: 地理词汇，特指避风的小海湾，常见于地名或游憩描写中，如 a secluded cove（隐秘的小湾）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cove 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a war measure that isolates some area of importance to the enemy

examples.en: The navy imposed a total blockade to cut off the island's supplies.
examples.zh: 海军实施了全面封锁，以切断该岛的物资补给。

lemmas.usage_note: 政治军事或航运常用词，指对港口或通道的封锁，常与 impose, lift, break 等动词连用。

lemmas.def_en: hinder or prevent the progress or accomplishment of

examples.en: Protesters gathered in the streets and blockaded the main entrance to the ministry.
examples.zh: 抗议者聚集在街头，封锁了该部委的正门。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指派军队或障碍物堵截通行，常接 ports, roads 等作宾语，用于新闻或历史语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 blockade 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 波壮刃短剑（等于creese, 马来西亚和印尼的）
lemmas.def_en: a Malayan dagger with a wavy blade

examples.en: The museum displays an ancient Indonesian kris with an intricately carved wooden handle.
examples.zh: 该博物馆展出了一把带有精美雕刻木柄的古代印尼波刃短剑。

lemmas.usage_note: 专指东南亚（尤指马来群岛）波状刃短剑，具文化与仪式象征，常见于历史文化及冷兵器记叙中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 kris 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 嗥叫, 吠声, 号叫
lemmas.def_en: a long loud emotional utterance

examples.en: A sudden howl of laughter erupted from the back of the classroom.
examples.zh: 教室后排突然爆发出一阵哄堂大笑。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，指动物长嚎、风啸或人类发出的悲嚎、大笑，常搭配 a howl of pain/laughter。

lemmas.def_en: a joke that seems extremely funny

lemmas.def_zh: 狂吠, 咆哮, 呼啸；对...吼叫, 狂喊着说
lemmas.def_en: emit long loud cries

examples.en: The bitter winter wind continued to howl through the narrow mountain pass.
examples.zh: 凛冽的冬风持续在狭窄的山口呼啸而过。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可作不及物动词描写狂风呼啸或狼嚎，也可作及物动词后接引语，常搭配 howl in agony/at the moon。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 howl 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a book with paper covers

examples.en: She bought a cheap paperback at the train station to read during her journey.
examples.zh: 她在火车站买了一本便宜的平装书，打算旅途中阅读。

lemmas.usage_note: 指平装书，常与 hardback/hardcover 相对；常用搭配 in paperback 或 come out in paperback。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 paperback 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 有人情的, 人道的, 仁慈的
lemmas.def_en: pertaining to or concerned with the humanities

examples.en: The organization advocates for the humane treatment of animals in scientific research.
examples.zh: 该组织倡导在科学研究中人道地对待动物。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，强调符合人道主义、仁慈或减少痛苦，常修饰 treatment, conditions 或 society。

lemmas.def_zh: 仁慈地; 人道地; 富人情地; 慈悲地
lemmas.def_en: in a humane manner

examples.en: let's treat the prisoners of war humanely

lemmas.def_en: the quality of compassion or consideration for others (people or animals)

family_guide.root_logic: 以 humane 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: block consisting of a thick piece of something

examples.en: Workers carefully lifted the heavy marble slab and placed it onto the kitchen counter.
examples.zh: 工人们小心翼翼地抬起厚重的厚大理石板，放在厨房台面上。

lemmas.usage_note: 指厚而平整的块状物，固定搭配 a slab of marble/concrete/meat，常见于建筑工料或厚切食物描述。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 slab 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: annual or biennial or perennial herbs having showy flowers

examples.en: A single red poppy grew miraculously between the cracks of the concrete pavement.
examples.zh: 一朵红色的罂粟花奇迹般地生长在水泥路面的裂缝之间。

lemmas.usage_note: 指罂粟花，英联邦国家常佩戴以纪念阵亡将士（Remembrance poppy）；亦用于 poppy seeds（罂粟籽食用搭配）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 poppy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 苏丹(某些伊斯兰国家统治者的称号)
lemmas.def_en: the ruler of a Muslim country (especially of the former Ottoman Empire)

examples.en: The wealthy sultan ruled over the vast desert kingdom with absolute authority.
examples.zh: 富有的苏丹以绝对的权威统治着广袤的沙漠王国。

lemmas.usage_note: 专指伊斯兰国家君主（苏丹），作头衔时首字母大写（如 Sultan of Brunei），语体庄重正式。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sultan 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a loud low dull continuous noise

examples.en: We heard the distant rumble of thunder long before the storm arrived.
examples.zh: 在暴风雨来临之前很久，我们就听到了远处隆隆的雷声。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，指雷电、车辆或腹部发出的连续沉闷轰鸣声，常搭配 the rumble of thunder/traffic。

lemmas.def_en: a loud low dull continuous noise

examples.en: they heard the rumbling of thunder

lemmas.def_zh: 发隆隆声, 辘辘响；使隆隆响, 低沉地说
lemmas.def_en: make a low noise

examples.en: Heavy freight trucks rumble through the quiet town during the night.
examples.zh: 重型货车在夜间轰隆隆地驶过这个安静的城镇。

lemmas.usage_note: 动词，描写发出隆隆声响或机器颠簸前行，常与 past, along 等介词连用，也可指肚子咕咕叫。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rumble 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 摸索, 乱摸, 笨拙的处理, 漏接(球)；摸索, 笨手笨脚, 漏球
lemmas.def_en: feel about uncertainly or blindly

examples.en: He began to fumble through his messy backpack trying to find his apartment keys.
examples.zh: 他开始在杂乱的背包里摸索，试图找到公寓钥匙。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用搭配 fumble around/about for（摸索寻找）或 fumble for words（结结巴巴地找词），含笨拙之意。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fumble 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a card for sending messages by post without an envelope

examples.en: She wrote a brief message on the colorful postcard before dropping it into the mailbox.
examples.zh: 她在彩色的明信片上写下一段简短的留言，然后投进了邮筒。

lemmas.usage_note: 常搭配 send a postcard to sb 或 a picture postcard；作形容词 postcard-perfect 意为“如明信片般优美的”。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 postcard 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: expel from a community or group

examples.en: She tried hard to banish all doubts from her mind before stepping onto the stage.
examples.zh: 在走上舞台之前，她努力打消脑海中的一切疑虑。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面动词，既指官方将人放逐（banish sb from），也指彻底排除恐惧或杂念（banish fear/thoughts）。

lemmas.def_en: the state of being banished or ostracized (excluded from society by general consent)

examples.en: the association should get rid of its elderly members--not by euthanasia, of course, but by Coventry

family_guide.root_logic: 以 banish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: someone entrusted to hold the stakes for two or more persons betting against one another; must deliver the stakes to the winner

examples.en: The neutral stakeholder held all the prize money until the match concluded.
examples.zh: 中立的赌金保管者一直保管着奖金，直到比赛结束。

lemmas.usage_note: 商业与政策正式用语，指利益相关者，常搭配 engage/consult stakeholders 或 key stakeholders。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stakeholder 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 重量级拳击运动员, (非正式)有影响的要人
lemmas.def_en: an amateur boxer who weighs no more than 201 pounds

examples.en: He quickly became a political heavyweight whose opinions could sway elections.
examples.zh: 他迅速成为一位能左右选举结果的政界要人。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于引申义指行业或政治上的“重量级人物/巨头”；搭配如 political/industry heavyweight。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 heavyweight 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 转开, 避免, 防止
lemmas.def_en: prevent the occurrence of; prevent from happening

examples.en: Swift diplomatic action helped avert a potentially catastrophic war in the region.
examples.zh: 迅速的外交行动帮助避免了该地区一场潜在的灾难性战争。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式动词，常指转移视线（avert one's eyes），或通过提前干预防止灾难（avert a crisis/disaster）。

lemmas.def_zh: 厌恶, 讨厌的事, 讨厌的人
lemmas.def_en: a feeling of intense dislike

family_guide.root_logic: 以 avert 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a person authorized to conduct religious worship

examples.en: The village parson visited the sick and comforted the grieving families.
examples.zh: 村里的教区牧师探视病人并安慰悲痛的家庭。

lemmas.usage_note: 多指英国国教教区牧师，带传统或乡土色彩；注意不要与通用词 pastor 或 priest 混淆。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 parson 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 样子, 色度, 色彩, 叫声, 色调
lemmas.def_en: the quality of a color as determined by its dominant wavelength

examples.en: The sunset bathed the mountains in a rich golden hue.
examples.zh: 落日余晖给群山披上了一层浓郁的金黄色调。

lemmas.usage_note: 文学或艺术常用词，指色彩的色相、深浅，或引申为政治等观点的派别，常搭配 of every hue。

lemmas.def_en: take on color or become colored

examples.en: The rendering software can dynamically hue the lighting layers according to ambient cues.
examples.zh: 该渲染软件能够根据环境线索动态调整光照图层的色调。

lemmas.usage_note: 专业技术或图形学语境中罕用为动词，指赋予色调或调整色相，在图像处理算法中偶尔作及物动词使用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hue 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 周期的, 定期的, 间歇(性)的, 循环的, 用完整句的, 高碘的
lemmas.def_en: happening or recurring at regular intervals

examples.en: The machinery requires periodic maintenance to ensure optimal operating efficiency.
examples.zh: 该机器需要进行定期维护，以确保最佳的运行效率。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式形容词，指按规律周期性或间歇性发生的，常搭配 periodic reviews, checks 或 periodic table。

lemmas.def_zh: 定期性, 周期性, 频率, 周波
lemmas.def_en: the quality of recurring at regular intervals

family_guide.root_logic: 以 periodic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a noncommissioned officer in the Army or Air Force or Marines

examples.en: The young corporal led his small squad through the dense jungle.
examples.zh: 年轻的下士带领他的小分队穿过了茂密的丛林。

lemmas.usage_note: 专指军队或警察中的“下士”军衔，作称谓时首字母常大写，如 Corporal Smith。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 corporal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 增加, 增值, 盈余
lemmas.def_en: a process of becoming larger or longer or more numerous or more important

examples.en: Employees are entitled to an annual increment based on their overall performance.
examples.zh: 员工有权根据其综合表现获得年度加薪。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于正式语境，指薪资调整或数值规律性递增，高频搭配为 annual increment 或 in increments of。

lemmas.def_en: increasing gradually by regular degrees or additions

examples.en: lecturers enjoy...steady incremental growth in salary

family_guide.root_logic: 以 increment 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不好不坏的, 通常, 平凡的
lemmas.def_en: moderate to inferior in quality

examples.en: Despite massive marketing efforts, the film received mediocre reviews from critics.
examples.zh: 尽管进行了大规模营销，这部电影从影评人那里获得的评价却很平庸。

lemmas.usage_note: 常含轻微贬义，指质量、能力或表现平庸、缺乏亮点，常与 results、performance、talent 搭配。

lemmas.def_en: ordinariness as a consequence of being average and not outstanding

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mediocre 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 鼻涕虫, 刺蛾, 懒汉, 弹丸, 金属小块, 重击
lemmas.def_en: a projectile that is fired from a gun

examples.en: He poured a generous slug of bourbon into his glass before speaking.
examples.zh: 他在开口说话前，往玻璃杯里倒了满满一口波本威士忌。

lemmas.usage_note: 多指软体动物蛞蝓，口语中也常指一小口烈酒或投币机中的代币，搭配 a slug of whisky。

lemmas.def_zh: 打击力强的选手, 重击者
lemmas.def_en: (baseball) a ballplayer who is batting

lemmas.def_zh: 偷懒者, 游手好闲的人, 懒鬼
lemmas.def_en: an idle slothful person

examples.en: The harsh teacher warned the sluggard that laziness would ruin his future prospects.
examples.zh: 严厉的老师警告这个懒鬼，懒惰会毁掉他的前途。

lemmas.def_zh: 偷懒, 动作迟缓；重击
lemmas.def_en: strike heavily, especially with the fist or a bat

examples.en: The two boxers slugged each other mercilessly until the final bell rang.
examples.zh: 两名拳手毫不留情地互挥重拳，直到终场铃声响起。

lemmas.usage_note: 非正式用语，主要指挥拳重击某人，或全力击球，常与 slug it out（决一胜负）连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 slug 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the hard woody stems of bamboo plants; used in construction and crafts and fishing poles

examples.en: Pandas spend most of their waking hours munching on fresh bamboo.
examples.zh: 大熊猫醒着的大部分时间都在咀嚼新鲜的竹子。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数指竹材，可数指竹子植株；常用搭配 bamboo shoots（竹笋）或 bamboo shoot-like。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bamboo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 威士忌酒, 轻便马车
lemmas.def_en: a liquor made from fermented mash of grain

examples.en: He relaxed by the fire with a glass of aged whisky.
examples.zh: 他端着一杯陈年威士忌，坐在壁炉旁放松休息。

lemmas.usage_note: 苏格兰/加拿大产通常拼作 whisky，美爱产多写作 whiskey；搭配如 on the rocks（加冰威士忌）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 whisky 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: make brighter and prettier

examples.en: The developer plans to refurbish the historic hotel and reopen it next spring.
examples.zh: 开发商计划翻修这栋历史悠久的酒店，并于明年春天重新开业。

lemmas.usage_note: 指对房屋、建筑或二手设备进行翻新、整修使其焕然一新，常见于商业与地产语境。

lemmas.def_zh: 整修; 翻新; 重新磨亮
lemmas.def_en: the state of being restored to its former good condition

examples.en: the inn was a renovation of a Colonial house

family_guide.root_logic: 以 refurbish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a portable rectangular container for carrying clothes

examples.en: She packed her heavy suitcase the night before her early flight.
examples.zh: 她在早班机的前一晚收拾好了沉重的行李箱。

lemmas.usage_note: 指手提箱，为可数名词（注意不同于不可数的 luggage/baggage）；常用搭配 pack/unpack a suitcase。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 suitcase 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 火山口, 环行山, 弹坑
lemmas.def_en: a bowl-shaped geological formation at the top of a volcano

examples.en: A massive meteorite created a deep crater in the remote desert.
examples.zh: 一颗巨大的陨石在偏远的沙漠中砸出了一个深坑。

lemmas.usage_note: 指火山口或爆炸/撞击造成的坑，常与 volcanic 或 impact 搭配；引申作动词表示“急剧下跌、彻底失败”。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 crater 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a ceremonial dinner party for many people

examples.en: The prime minister attended a state banquet held in honour of the visiting delegates.
examples.zh: 首相出席了为欢迎来访代表团而举行的国宴。

lemmas.usage_note: 指正式、盛大的宴会或国宴，常用于外交、商务庆典语境，常见搭配 state banquet 或 host a banquet。

lemmas.def_en: provide a feast or banquet for

examples.en: The nobles banqueted on roasted pheasant and fine wine late into the night.
examples.zh: 贵族们尽情享用烤野鸡和美酒，宴饮直至深夜。

lemmas.usage_note: 较为文雅或过时的用法，作不及物动词指赴宴或大摆筵席，常与 on 连用表示尽情享用美食。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 banquet 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 勒死, 扼死, 压制, 使窒息, 抑制；被扼死, 被绞死, 窒息而死
lemmas.def_en: kill by squeezing the throat of so as to cut off the air

examples.en: Bureaucratic red tape threatens to strangle innovation in the startup sector.
examples.zh: 官僚主义的繁文缛节有扼杀初创领域创新的危险。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可指身体上的勒死、掐死，也常引申为抑制、扼杀经济或言论自由，常见 strangle the economy。

lemmas.def_zh: 勒杀, 绞死, 压缩
lemmas.def_en: the act of suffocating (someone) by constricting the windpipe

examples.en: no evidence that the choking was done by the accused

lemmas.def_zh: 扼杀者, 压制者, (英)阻气门, 阻塞门
lemmas.def_en: an epiphytic vine or tree whose aerial roots extend down the trunk of a supporting tree and coalesce around it eventually strangling the tree

family_guide.root_logic: 以 strangle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the state of being tense and feeling pain

examples.en: Sitting on the wooden bench caused her significant physical discomfort after hours.
examples.zh: 坐在木凳上数小时后，她感到身体极为不适。

lemmas.usage_note: 可表示身体上的不适或心理上的不安尴尬，常与 cause/experience 搭配，如 cause slight discomfort。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 discomfort 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 高地, 高原, (上升后的)稳定水平
lemmas.def_en: a relatively flat highland

examples.en: After months of rapid improvement, her test scores reached a plateau.
examples.zh: 在经过数月的快速提高后，她的考试成绩进入了平稳期。

lemmas.usage_note: 本义为高原，常引申指“瓶颈期、停滞期”，高频搭配 reach a plateau，作动词时意为“进入平稳期”。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 plateau 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a unit of electrical power in an AC circuit equal to the power dissipated when 1 volt produces a current of 1 ampere

examples.en: The IT company partnered with a local VAR to customize the software.
examples.zh: 这家IT公司与当地一家增值分销商合作定制该软件。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作专有名词大写，在足球中指“视频助理裁判”（VAR），在编程中常作为变量 variable 的缩写。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 var 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 翡翠, 绿宝石, 翠绿色
lemmas.def_en: a green transparent form of beryl; highly valued as a gemstone

examples.en: She wore an elegant necklace adorned with a brilliant emerald for the gala.
examples.zh: 她戴着一条饰有璀璨祖母绿的典雅项链参加晚会。

lemmas.usage_note: 指祖母绿或翡翠绿，常作定语修饰色调或景物，如 emerald green 或 the Emerald Isle（爱尔兰）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 emerald 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: specify as a condition or requirement in a contract or agreement; make an express demand or provision in an agreement

examples.en: The agreement stipulates that all disputes must be resolved through binding arbitration.
examples.zh: 该协议明确规定，所有争议必须通过具约束力的仲裁来解决。

lemmas.usage_note: 高度正式的法律与合同用语，指明确规定或订明条件，后常接 that 从句或直接宾语。

lemmas.def_zh: 约束, 约定, 契约
lemmas.def_en: (law) an agreement or concession made by parties in a judicial proceeding (or by their attorneys) relating to the business before the court; must be in writing unless they are part of the court record

examples.en: a stipulation of fact was made in order to avoid delay
